16.256.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi naṃdādityaṃ samāhitaḥ ..
naṃdena sthāpitaṃ pūrvaṃ tatraivāmitabuddhinā ..1..
16.256.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि नंदादित्यं समाहितः ..
नंदेन स्थापितं पूर्वं तत्रैवामितबुद्धिना ..1..
16.256.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go with composed mind to Nandāditya, O great goddess, / which was formerly established right there by Nanda of boundless intellect.

16.256.s:
naṃdo rājā purā hyāsītsarvalokasukhapradaḥ ..
na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhi nākāle maraṇaṃ nṛṇām.. 2 ..
16.256.d:
नंदो राजा पुरा ह्यासीत्सर्वलोकसुखप्रदः ..
न दुर्भिक्षं न च व्याधि नाकाले मरणं नृणाम्.. 2 ..
16.256.m: In ancient times there was King Nanda, who gave happiness to all people. / There was neither famine nor disease, nor untimely death for men.

16.256.s:
tasmiñchāsati dharmajñe na cāvṛṣṭikṛtaṃ bhayam ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya pūrvakarmānusārataḥ.. 3 ..
16.256.d:
तस्मिञ्छासति धर्मज्ञे न चावृष्टिकृतं भयम् ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य पूर्वकर्मानुसारतः.. 3 ..
16.256.m: While he, knower of dharma, ruled, there was no fear caused by drought. / But at a certain time, according to his past karma,

16.256.s:
kuṣṭhena mahatā vyāpto vairāgyaparamaṃ gataḥ..
tena rogābhibhūtena devadevo divākaraḥ..
pratiṣṭhito nadītīre sa ca rogādvimocitaḥ .. 4 ..
16.256.d:
कुष्ठेन महता व्याप्तो वैराग्यपरमं गतः..
तेन रोगाभिभूतेन देवदेवो दिवाकरः..
प्रतिष्ठितो नदीतीरे स च रोगाद्विमोचितः .. 4 ..
16.256.m: he was afflicted with severe leprosy and attained supreme dispassion. / Overcome by that disease, he installed the god of gods, the Sun, / on the bank of the river, and he was liberated from the disease.

16.256.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kimasau rogavānrājā sārvabhaumo mahīpatiḥ ..
tasya dharmaratasyāpi kasmādroga samudbhavaḥ .. 5 ..
16.256.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
किमसौ रोगवान्राजा सार्वभौमो महीपतिः ..
तस्य धर्मरतस्यापि कस्माद्रोग समुद्भवः .. 5 ..
16.256.m:
The Goddess said:
“Why did that king, a universal monarch, ruler of the earth, become diseased? / Even though he was devoted to dharma, why did disease arise in him?”

16.256.s:
..īśvara uvāca .. ..
eṣa dharmasadācāro naṃdo rājā pratāpavān ..
vyacaratsarvalokānsa vimānavaramāsthitaḥ .. 6..
16.256.d:
..ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एष धर्मसदाचारो नंदो राजा प्रतापवान् ..
व्यचरत्सर्वलोकान्स विमानवरमास्थितः .. 6..
16.256.m:
Īśvara said:
This powerful King Nanda, whose conduct was righteous, / wandered through all the worlds seated in an excellent aerial chariot.

16.256.s:
vimānaṃ tasya tuṣṭena dattaṃ vai viṣṇunā svayam ..
kāmagaṃ varavarṇena barhiṇena vināditam .. 7 ..
16.256.d:
विमानं तस्य तुष्टेन दत्तं वै विष्णुना स्वयम् ..
कामगं वरवर्णेन बर्हिणेन विनादितम् .. 7 ..
16.256.m: An aerial chariot had been given to him by Viṣṇu himself, who was pleased, / moving at will, resonant with peacocks of excellent color.

16.256.s:
sa kadācinnṛpaśreṣṭho vicaraṃstatra saṃsthitaḥ ..
gatavānmānasaṃ divyaṃ saro devagaṇānvitam.. 8 ..
16.256.d:
स कदाचिन्नृपश्रेष्ठो विचरंस्तत्र संस्थितः ..
गतवान्मानसं दिव्यं सरो देवगणान्वितम्.. 8 ..
16.256.m: Once, that best of kings, roaming about seated in it, / went to the divine lake Mānasa, accompanied by hosts of gods.

16.256.s:
tatrāpaśyadbṛhatpadmaṃ saromadhyagataṃ sitam ..
tatra cāṃguṣṭhamātraṃ tu sthitaṃ puruṣasattamam .. 9 ..
16.256.d:
तत्रापश्यद्बृहत्पद्मं सरोमध्यगतं सितम् ..
तत्र चांगुष्ठमात्रं तु स्थितं पुरुषसत्तमम् .. 9 ..
16.256.m: There he saw a large white lotus situated in the middle of the lake, / and in it stood a supreme person the size of a thumb,

16.256.s:
raktavāsobhirācchannaṃ dvibhujaṃ tigmatejasam ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sārathiṃ prāha padmametatsamāhara ..7.1.256.10..
16.256.d:
रक्तवासोभिराच्छन्नं द्विभुजं तिग्मतेजसम् ..
तं दृष्ट्वा सारथिं प्राह पद्ममेतत्समाहर ..7.1.256.10..
16.256.m: clothed in red garments, two-armed, of blazing splendor. / Seeing him, he said to his charioteer: ‘Bring this lotus!

16.256.s:
idaṃ tu śirasā bibhratsarvalokasya sannidhau ..
ślāghanīyo bhaviṣyāmi tasmādāhara mā ciram.. 11 ..
16.256.d:
इदं तु शिरसा बिभ्रत्सर्वलोकस्य सन्निधौ ..
श्लाघनीयो भविष्यामि तस्मादाहर मा चिरम्.. 11 ..
16.256.m: Bearing this on my head in the presence of all the world, / I shall be praised! Therefore bring it without delay!’

16.256.s:
evamuktastatastena sārathiḥ praviveśa ha ..
grahītumupacakrāma tatpadmaṃ varavarṇini..
spṛṣṭamātre tadā padme huṃkāraḥ samapadyata..12..
16.256.d:
एवमुक्तस्ततस्तेन सारथिः प्रविवेश ह ..
ग्रहीतुमुपचक्राम तत्पद्मं वरवर्णिनि..
स्पृष्टमात्रे तदा पद्मे हुंकारः समपद्यत..12..
16.256.m: Addressed thus by him, the charioteer entered [the water], / and began to seize that lotus, O fair-complexioned one. / As soon as the lotus was touched, a roar arose.

16.256.s:
rājā ca tatkṣaṇāttena śabdena samajāyata ..
kuṣṭhī vigatavarṇaśca balavīryavivarjitaḥ .. 13 ..
16.256.d:
राजा च तत्क्षणात्तेन शब्देन समजायत ..
कुष्ठी विगतवर्णश्च बलवीर्यविवर्जितः .. 13 ..
16.256.m: And instantly, by that sound, the king became / a leper, robbed of his color, deprived of strength and vigor.

16.256.s:
tathāgatamathātmānaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa puruṣarṣabhaḥ ..
tasthau tatraiva śokārtaḥ kimetaditi ciṃtayan .. 14 ..
16.256.d:
तथागतमथात्मानं दृष्ट्वा स पुरुषर्षभः ..
तस्थौ तत्रैव शोकार्तः किमेतदिति चिंतयन् .. 14 ..
16.256.m: Then, seeing himself reduced to such a state, that bull among men / stood right there, afflicted with grief, thinking: ‘What is this?’

16.256.s:
tasya ciṃtayato dhīmānājagāma mahātapāḥ ..
vasiṣṭho brahmaputrastu sa taṃ papraccha pārthivaḥ .. 15 ..
16.256.d:
तस्य चिंतयतो धीमानाजगाम महातपाः ..
वसिष्ठो ब्रह्मपुत्रस्तु स तं पप्रच्छ पार्थिवः .. 15 ..
16.256.m: While he was reflecting, the wise Vasiṣṭha of great austerity, / the son of Brahmā, arrived; and the king questioned him:

16.256.s:
eṣa me bhagavañjāto dehasyāsya viparyayaḥ ..
kuṣṭharogābhibhūtātmā nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe .. 16 ..
16.256.d:
एष मे भगवञ्जातो देहस्यास्य विपर्ययः ..
कुष्ठरोगाभिभूतात्मा नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे .. 16 ..
16.256.m: ‘O venerable one, this disaster has befallen my body. / Overcome by leprosy, I have no desire to live!

16.256.s:
upāyaṃ brūhi me brahmanvyādhitasya cikitsitam ..
utāho vratamanyadvā dānaṃ yajñamathāpi vā .. 17 ..
16.256.d:
उपायं ब्रूहि मे ब्रह्मन्व्याधितस्य चिकित्सितम् ..
उताहो व्रतमन्यद्वा दानं यज्ञमथापि वा .. 17 ..
16.256.m: Tell me a means, O brahmin, a cure for me who am diseased, / or else another observance, a gift, or even a sacrifice!’

16.256.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
etadbrahmodbhavaṃ nāma padmaṃ trailokyaviśrutam ..
dṛṣṭamātreṇa cānena dṛṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarva devatāḥ .. 18 ..
16.256.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
एतद्ब्रह्मोद्भवं नाम पद्मं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् ..
दृष्टमात्रेण चानेन दृष्टाः स्युः सर्व देवताः .. 18 ..
16.256.m:
Vasiṣṭha said:
‘This lotus is known as Brahmodbhava, renowned in the three worlds. / As soon as it is seen, all the deities are seen.

16.256.s:
etaddhi dṛśyate dhanyaiḥ padmaṃ kaiḥ kvāpi pārthiva ..
etasmindṛṣṭamātre tu yo jalaṃ viśate naraḥ .. 19 ..
16.256.d:
एतद्धि दृश्यते धन्यैः पद्मं कैः क्वापि पार्थिव ..
एतस्मिन्दृष्टमात्रे तु यो जलं विशते नरः .. 19 ..
16.256.m: This lotus is seen only by certain fortunate persons anywhere, O king. / As soon as it is seen, whatever man enters the water

16.256.s:
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ padaṃ nirvāṇa māpnuyāt ..
eṣa dṛṣṭvā tu te sūto hartuṃ toye praviṣṭavān .. 7.1.256.20 ..
16.256.d:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः पदं निर्वाण माप्नुयात् ..
एष दृष्ट्वा तु ते सूतो हर्तुं तोये प्रविष्टवान् .. 7.1.256.20 ..
16.256.m: becomes freed from all sins and attains the state of nirvāṇa. / Having seen it, your charioteer entered the water to seize it.

16.256.s:
tava vākyena rājeṃdra mṛto'sau rogavānbhavet ..
brahmaputro'pyahaṃ tena paśyāmi parameśvaram .. 21 ..
16.256.d:
तव वाक्येन राजेंद्र मृतोऽसौ रोगवान्भवेत् ..
ब्रह्मपुत्रोऽप्यहं तेन पश्यामि परमेश्वरम् .. 21 ..
16.256.m: By your command, O king of kings, he would have died and become diseased; / but because I am Brahmā’s son, I behold the Supreme Lord.

16.256.s:
ahanyahani cāgacchaṃstvaṃ punardṛṣṭavānasi ..
vāṃchaṃti devatā nityamamuṃ hṛdi manoratham .. 22 ..
16.256.d:
अहन्यहनि चागच्छंस्त्वं पुनर्दृष्टवानसि ..
वांछंति देवता नित्यममुं हृदि मनोरथम् .. 22 ..
16.256.m: Coming day after day, you have seen it again. / The deities constantly harbor this desire in their hearts:

16.256.s:
mānase brahmapadmaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā snātvā kadā vayam ..
prāpsyāmaḥ paramaṃ brahma yadgatvā na punarbhavet..23..
16.256.d:
मानसे ब्रह्मपद्मं तु दृष्ट्वा स्नात्वा कदा वयम् ..
प्राप्स्यामः परमं ब्रह्म यद्गत्वा न पुनर्भवेत्..23..
16.256.m: “When shall we, having seen the lotus of Brahmā in Mānasa and bathed, / attain the supreme Brahman, having reached which there is no rebirth?”

16.256.s:
idaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ bhūyo dvitīyaṃ śṛṇu pārthiva ..
kuṣṭhasya yattvayā prāptaṃ hartukāmena paṃkajam .. .. 24 ..
16.256.d:
इदं च कारणं भूयो द्वितीयं शृणु पार्थिव ..
कुष्ठस्य यत्त्वया प्राप्तं हर्तुकामेन पंकजम् .. .. 24 ..
16.256.m: Hear further the second reason, O king, / for the leprosy that you incurred through wishing to take the lotus.

16.256.s:
pradyotanastu garbhe'sminsvayameva vyavasthitaḥ ..
tavaiṣā buddhirabhavaddṛṣṭvedaṃ varapaṃkajam .. 25 ..
16.256.d:
प्रद्योतनस्तु गर्भेऽस्मिन्स्वयमेव व्यवस्थितः ..
तवैषा बुद्धिरभवद्दृष्ट्वेदं वरपंकजम् .. 25 ..
16.256.m: The Sun himself is present inside its womb. / This thought occurred to you upon seeing this excellent lotus:

16.256.s:
dhārayāmi śirasyenaṃ lokamadhye vibhūṣaṇam ..
idaṃ cintayataḥ pāpamevaṃ devena darśitam .. 26 ..
16.256.d:
धारयामि शिरस्येनं लोकमध्ये विभूषणम् ..
इदं चिन्तयतः पापमेवं देवेन दर्शितम् .. 26 ..
16.256.m: “I shall wear it on my head as an ornament in the midst of the world.” / For you who thought this sin, it was thus shown by the god.

16.256.s:
tataḥ sarvaprayatnena tamārādhaya bhāskaram ..
prasādāddevadevasya mokṣyase nātra saṃśayaḥ ..27..
16.256.d:
ततः सर्वप्रयत्नेन तमाराधय भास्करम् ..
प्रसादाद्देवदेवस्य मोक्ष्यसे नात्र संशयः ..27..
16.256.m: Therefore, worship that Sun with all effort. / Through the grace of the god of gods, you will be freed; there is no doubt about this.

16.256.s:
prabhāsaṃ gaccha rājeṃdra tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam ..
tatra siddhirbhavecchīghramārttānāṃ prāṇināṃ bhuvi .. 28 ..
16.256.d:
प्रभासं गच्छ राजेंद्र तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् ..
तत्र सिद्धिर्भवेच्छीघ्रमार्त्तानां प्राणिनां भुवि .. 28 ..
16.256.m: Go to Prabhāsa, O king of kings, the sacred ford famous in the three worlds! / There, attainment quickly comes to afflicted creatures on earth.’

16.256.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ ..
prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya māheśvaryāstaṭe śubhe .. 29 ..
16.256.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः ..
प्रभासं क्षेत्रमासाद्य माहेश्वर्यास्तटे शुभे .. 29 ..
16.256.m:
Īśvara said:
Having heard those words of the great-souled Vasiṣṭha, / he reached the sacred field of Prabhāsa, on the auspicious bank of the Māheśvarī,

16.256.s:
naṃdādityaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya gaṃdhadhūpānulepanaiḥ ..
pūjayāmāsa taṃ devi puṣpairuccāvacaistathā .. 7.1.256.30 ..
16.256.d:
नंदादित्यं प्रतिष्ठाप्य गंधधूपानुलेपनैः ..
पूजयामास तं देवि पुष्पैरुच्चावचैस्तथा .. 7.1.256.30 ..
16.256.m: established Nandāditya, and worshipped him, O goddess, / with perfumes, incenses, unguents, and diverse flowers.

16.256.s: tasya tuṣṭo divānātho varado'hamathābravīt .. 31 ..
16.256.d: तस्य तुष्टो दिवानाथो वरदोऽहमथाब्रवीत् .. 31 ..
16.256.m: The Lord of Day, pleased with him, then said: ‘I am the giver of boons.’

16.256.s:
.. nanda uvāca .. ..
kuṣṭhena mahatā vyāptaṃ paśya māṃ surasattama ..
yathā'yaṃ nāśamāyāti tathā kuru divākara .. 32 ..
16.256.d:
.. नन्द उवाच .. ..
कुष्ठेन महता व्याप्तं पश्य मां सुरसत्तम ..
यथाऽयं नाशमायाति तथा कुरु दिवाकर .. 32 ..
16.256.m:
Nanda said:
‘Behold me afflicted with severe leprosy, O best among gods! / Act in such a way, O Sun, that it is destroyed!

16.256.s: sānnidhyaṃ kuru deveśa sthāne'sminnityadā vibho .. 33 ..
16.256.d: सान्निध्यं कुरु देवेश स्थानेऽस्मिन्नित्यदा विभो .. 33 ..
16.256.m: Make your presence always in this place, O Lord of gods, O pervasive one!’

16.256.s:
.. sūrya uvāca .. ..
nīrogastvaṃ mahārāja sadya eva bhaviṣyasi ..
atra ye māṃ samāgatya drakṣyaṃti ca narā bhuvi .. 34 ..
16.256.d:
.. सूर्य उवाच .. ..
नीरोगस्त्वं महाराज सद्य एव भविष्यसि ..
अत्र ये मां समागत्य द्रक्ष्यंति च नरा भुवि .. 34 ..
16.256.m:
Sūrya said:
‘You will become free of disease this very moment, O great king! / And whatever men on earth, having come here, will behold me,

16.256.s:
saptamyāṃ sūryavāreṇa yāsyaṃti paramāṃ gatim..
atra me sūryavāreṇa sāṃnidhyaṃ saptamīdine ..
bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho gamiṣye tvaṃ sukhī bhava .. 35 ..
16.256.d:
सप्तम्यां सूर्यवारेण यास्यंति परमां गतिम्..
अत्र मे सूर्यवारेण सांनिध्यं सप्तमीदिने ..
भविष्यति न संदेहो गमिष्ये त्वं सुखी भव .. 35 ..
16.256.m: on a Sunday falling on the seventh lunar day, they will attain the highest state. / Here, on the seventh lunar day with a Sunday, my presence / will be felt, without doubt. I shall depart; be happy!"

16.256.s: evamuktvā sahasrāṃśustatraivāṃtaradhīyata .. 36 ..
16.256.d: एवमुक्त्वा सहस्रांशुस्तत्रैवांतरधीयत .. 36 ..
16.256.m: Having spoken thus, the thousand-rayed Sun vanished right there.

16.256.s:
nīrogatvamavā pyāsau kṛtvā rājyamanuttamam ..
jagāma paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ ..
tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ prayatnataḥ .. 37 ..
16.256.d:
नीरोगत्वमवा प्यासौ कृत्वा राज्यमनुत्तमम् ..
जगाम परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो दिवाकरः ..
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा कृत्वा श्राद्धं प्रयत्नतः .. 37 ..
16.256.m: Attaining freedom from disease and exercising unsurpassed rule, / he went to the supreme abode where the divine Sun dwells. / Having bathed at that sacred ford and performed a śrāddha with diligence,

16.256.s:
naṃdādityaṃ punardṛṣṭvā na punarmarttyatāṃ vrajeta..
pradadyātkapilāṃ tatra brāhmaṇe vedapārage .. 38 ..
16.256.d:
नंदादित्यं पुनर्दृष्ट्वा न पुनर्मर्त्त्यतां व्रजेत..
प्रदद्यात्कपिलां तत्र ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे .. 38 ..
16.256.m: and seeing Nandāditya once again, one will not return to mortal existence. / One should donate a brown cow there to a brahmin who has mastered the Vedas,

16.256.s:
ahorātroṣito bhūtvā ghṛtadhenumathāpi vā ..
na tasya guṇituṃ śakyā saṃkhyā puṇyasya kenacit .. 39 ..
16.256.d:
अहोरात्रोषितो भूत्वा घृतधेनुमथापि वा ..
न तस्य गुणितुं शक्या संख्या पुण्यस्य केनचित् .. 39 ..
16.256.m: or, having fasted for a day and night, a cow of clarified butter. / The measure of his merit cannot be calculated by anyone.

16.256.s:
ityevaṃ devadevasya māhātmyaṃ dīptadīdhiteḥ ..
kathitaṃ tava suśroṇi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 7.1.256.40 ..
16.256.d:
इत्येवं देवदेवस्य माहात्म्यं दीप्तदीधितेः ..
कथितं तव सुश्रोणि सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 7.1.256.40 ..
16.256.m: Thus has the māhātmya of the god of gods, of blazing brilliance, / been told to you, O fair-hipped lady, destroying all sins.

16.256.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nandādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭpañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ..256..
16.256.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये नन्दादित्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्पञ्चाशदुत्तरद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ..256..
16.256.m: Thus ends the two hundred and fifty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Nandāditya', in the first [sub-section], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.257.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tritakūpamiti smṛtam..
naṃdādityasya pūrveṇa yojanatritayena tu .. 1 ..
16.257.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि त्रितकूपमिति स्मृतम्..
नंदादित्यस्य पूर्वेण योजनत्रितयेन तु .. 1 ..
16.257.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should proceed, O great goddess, to what is known as Tritakūpa, / three yojanas to the east of Nandāditya.

16.257.s:
purā babhūva rājendraḥ saurāṣṭraviṣaye sudhīḥ ..
ātreya iti vikhyāto vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ ..2..
16.257.d:
पुरा बभूव राजेन्द्रः सौराष्ट्रविषये सुधीः ..
आत्रेय इति विख्यातो वेदवेदांगपारगः ..2..
16.257.m: Formerly in the country of Saurāṣṭra there was an intelligent lord of kings / known as Ātreya, who had mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

16.257.s:
tasya putratrayaṃ jajña ṛtukālābhigāminaḥ ..
ekataścadvitaścaiva tritaścaiveti bhāmini ..3..
16.257.d:
तस्य पुत्रत्रयं जज्ञ ऋतुकालाभिगामिनः ..
एकतश्चद्वितश्चैव त्रितश्चैवेति भामिनि ..3..
16.257.m: To him, approaching his wife at the fertile season, three sons were born, / Ekata, Dvita, and Trita, O lovely lady.

16.257.s:
tritasteṣāṃ kaniṣṭho'bhūdvedavedāṃgapāragaḥ ..
sarvaireva guṇairyukto mūrkho jyeṣṭhau babhūvatuḥ .. 4 ..
16.257.d:
त्रितस्तेषां कनिष्ठोऽभूद्वेदवेदांगपारगः ..
सर्वैरेव गुणैर्युक्तो मूर्खो ज्येष्ठौ बभूवतुः .. 4 ..
16.257.m: Trita was the youngest among them, a master of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, / endowed with all virtues; the two eldest were foolish.

16.257.s:
kasyacittvathakālasya ātreyo dvija sattamaḥ ..
tapaḥ kṛtvā tu vipulaṃ kāladharmamupeyivān.. 5 ..
16.257.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथकालस्य आत्रेयो द्विज सत्तमः ..
तपः कृत्वा तु विपुलं कालधर्ममुपेयिवान्.. 5 ..
16.257.m: Then, after some time, Ātreya, best of the twice-born, / having performed extensive austerity, succumbed to the law of time.

16.257.s:
tatasteṣāṃ trito rājā babhūva guṇavattaraḥ ..
dhuramākarṣayāmāsa putro'yaṃ tasya yā purā .. 6..
16.257.d:
ततस्तेषां त्रितो राजा बभूव गुणवत्तरः ..
धुरमाकर्षयामास पुत्रोऽयं तस्य या पुरा .. 6..
16.257.m: Then Trita, the king among them, became superior in virtue; / as his son, he took up the burden that [the father] had carried earlier.

16.257.s:
tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā kathaṃ yajñaṃ karomyaham ..
sannimaṃtrya dvijaśreṣṭhānyajñakarmasvadhiṣṭhitān .. 7 ..
16.257.d:
तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना कथं यज्ञं करोम्यहम् ..
सन्निमंत्र्य द्विजश्रेष्ठान्यज्ञकर्मस्वधिष्ठितान् .. 7 ..
16.257.m: The thought arose in his mind: 'How shall I perform a sacrifice, / having invited the foremost brahmins established in sacrificial rites,

16.257.s:
indrādīṃśca surānsarvānāvāhya vidhipūrvakam ..
dakṣiṇārthaṃ dvijendrāṇāṃ prabhāsaṃ sa jagāma ha ..
gṛhītvā bhrātarau jyeṣṭhau gavārthaṃ prasthito dvijaḥ .. 8 ..
16.257.d:
इन्द्रादींश्च सुरान्सर्वानावाह्य विधिपूर्वकम् ..
दक्षिणार्थं द्विजेन्द्राणां प्रभासं स जगाम ह ..
गृहीत्वा भ्रातरौ ज्येष्ठौ गवार्थं प्रस्थितो द्विजः .. 8 ..
16.257.m: and having invoked all the gods, Indra and the others, according to the rule?' / For the sacrificial fees of the foremost brahmins, he went to Prabhāsa; / taking his two elder brothers, the twice-born set forth to obtain cows.

16.257.s:
yasya yasya gṛhe yāti sa trito vedapāragaḥ ..
tatra tatra varāṃ pūjāṃ lebhe gāścaiva puṣkalāḥ .. 9 ..
16.257.d:
यस्य यस्य गृहे याति स त्रितो वेदपारगः ..
तत्र तत्र वरां पूजां लेभे गाश्चैव पुष्कलाः .. 9 ..
16.257.m: To whichever house Trita, the master of the Vedas, went, / there he received excellent honor and abundant cows.

16.257.s:
evaṃ sa godhanaṃ prāpya bhrātṛbhyāṃ sahitastadā ..
gṛhāya prasthito devi nirvṛtiṃ paramāṃ gataḥ .. 7.1.257.10 ..
16.257.d:
एवं स गोधनं प्राप्य भ्रातृभ्यां सहितस्तदा ..
गृहाय प्रस्थितो देवि निर्वृतिं परमां गतः .. 7.1.257.10 ..
16.257.m: Having thus obtained wealth in cows, accompanied by his two brothers, / he set out for home, O goddess, having attained supreme contentment.

16.257.s:
tritastābhyāṃ puro yāti pṛṣṭhato bhrātarau ca tau ..
godhanaṃ cālayaṃtaste prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatāḥ .. 11 ..
16.257.d:
त्रितस्ताभ्यां पुरो याति पृष्ठतो भ्रातरौ च तौ ..
गोधनं चालयंतस्ते प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागताः .. 11 ..
16.257.m: Trita walked ahead of the two, and the two brothers behind, / driving the cattle, arrived at the sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.257.s:
atha tadgodhanaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūri dānārthamāhṛtam ..
bhrātṛbhyāṃ tritaye ceti pāpā matirajāyata .. 12 ..
16.257.d:
अथ तद्गोधनं दृष्ट्वा भूरि दानार्थमाहृतम् ..
भ्रातृभ्यां त्रितये चेति पापा मतिरजायत .. 12 ..
16.257.m: Then, seeing that abundance of cattle brought for the sake of donation, / a sinful thought arose in the two brothers regarding Trita:

16.257.s:
parasparamūcatustau bhrātarau duṣṭacetasau ..
trito yajñeṣu kuśalo vedeṣu kuśalastathā.. 13 ..
16.257.d:
परस्परमूचतुस्तौ भ्रातरौ दुष्टचेतसौ ..
त्रितो यज्ञेषु कुशलो वेदेषु कुशलस्तथा.. 13 ..
16.257.m: Those two brothers, evil-minded, said to each other: / 'Trita is skilled in sacrifices and skilled in the Vedas;

16.257.s:
mānyaḥ pūjyaśca sarvatra āvāṃ mūrkhau nirarthakau ..
etaddhi godhanaṃ sarvaṃ trito dāsyati sanmakhe .. 14 ..
16.257.d:
मान्यः पूज्यश्च सर्वत्र आवां मूर्खौ निरर्थकौ ..
एतद्धि गोधनं सर्वं त्रितो दास्यति सन्मखे .. 14 ..
16.257.m: he is respected and honored everywhere, while we two are foolish and useless. / Indeed, Trita will give away all this cattle at the holy sacrifice;

16.257.s:
asmākaṃ pitṛparyāto yadāptaṃ tatsamaṃ bhavet..
tasmādatraiva yukto'sya vadho vai tritayajñinaḥ .. 15 ..
16.257.d:
अस्माकं पितृपर्यातो यदाप्तं तत्समं भवेत्..
तस्मादत्रैव युक्तोऽस्य वधो वै त्रितयज्ञिनः .. 15 ..
16.257.m: what has come down from our ancestors should be shared equally. / Therefore, the murder of this Trita, the sacrificer, is truly appropriate right here.'

16.257.s:
evaṃ tau niścayaṃ kṛtvā prasthitau bhrātarāvubhau ..
tritastu purato yāti nirvikalpa ṛjuḥ sudhīḥ ..16..
16.257.d:
एवं तौ निश्चयं कृत्वा प्रस्थितौ भ्रातरावुभौ ..
त्रितस्तु पुरतो याति निर्विकल्प ऋजुः सुधीः ..16..
16.257.m: Having made this resolve, both brothers set forth; / but Trita walked ahead, free from doubt, straightforward, and intelligent.

16.257.s:
anu tatra samuttasthau vyāghro raudratarākṛtiḥ ..
vyāditāsyo ravaṃ devi vyanadbhairavaṃ tataḥ .. 17 ..
16.257.d:
अनु तत्र समुत्तस्थौ व्याघ्रो रौद्रतराकृतिः ..
व्यादितास्यो रवं देवि व्यनद्भैरवं ततः .. 17 ..
16.257.m: Next, a tiger of most ferocious appearance arose there; / with gaping jaws, O goddess, it then uttered a terrifying roar.

16.257.s:
tasya śabdena tā gāvo naṣṭā jagmurdiśo daśa ..
andhakūpo mahāṃstatra pradeśe dāruṇo'bhavat .. 18 ..
16.257.d:
तस्य शब्देन ता गावो नष्टा जग्मुर्दिशो दश ..
अन्धकूपो महांस्तत्र प्रदेशे दारुणोऽभवत् .. 18 ..
16.257.m: At its sound, those cows scattered and fled in the ten directions. / In that place there was a large, dreadful, blind well.

16.257.s:
ekato dāruṇo vyāghraḥ kūpo'nyatra sudāruṇaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā te bhrātaraḥ sarve bhayodvignāḥ pradudruvuḥ..19 ..
16.257.d:
एकतो दारुणो व्याघ्रः कूपोऽन्यत्र सुदारुणः ..
दृष्ट्वा ते भ्रातरः सर्वे भयोद्विग्नाः प्रदुद्रुवुः..19 ..
16.257.m: On one side was the dreadful tiger, elsewhere the exceedingly terrible well; / seeing them, all the brothers fled, agitated with fear.

16.257.s:
atha te viṣamaṃ prāpya taṭaṃ kūpasya bhāmini ..
sthitā yāvadgato vyāghrastato gaṃtuṃ mano dadhuḥ .. 7.1.257.20 ..
16.257.d:
अथ ते विषमं प्राप्य तटं कूपस्य भामिनि ..
स्थिता यावद्गतो व्याघ्रस्ततो गंतुं मनो दधुः .. 7.1.257.20 ..
16.257.m: Then, reaching the uneven edge of the well, O lovely lady, / they stood until the tiger was gone, and then set their minds on departing.

16.257.s:
atha tābhyāṃ trito devi bhrātṛbhyāṃ nṛpasattama ..
prakṣipto dāruṇe kūpe jīrṇe toyavivarjite .. 21 ..
16.257.d:
अथ ताभ्यां त्रितो देवि भ्रातृभ्यां नृपसत्तम ..
प्रक्षिप्तो दारुणे कूपे जीर्णे तोयविवर्जिते .. 21 ..
16.257.m: Then Trita, O goddess, best of kings, was thrown by the two brothers / into the dreadful, dilapidated, waterless well.

16.257.s:
tatastadgodhanaṃ gṛhya prasthitau hṛṣṭamānasau ..
tritastu patitastatra kūpe jalavivarjite .. 22 ..
16.257.d:
ततस्तद्गोधनं गृह्य प्रस्थितौ हृष्टमानसौ ..
त्रितस्तु पतितस्तत्र कूपे जलविवर्जिते .. 22 ..
16.257.m: Then, taking that wealth in cows, they departed with delighted minds; / but Trita had fallen there into the well devoid of water.

16.257.s:
cintayāmāsa medhāvī nāhaṃ śocāmi jīvitum ..
mayāhūtā dvijaśreṣṭhā yajñārthaṃ vedapāragāḥ ..
indrādyāśca surāḥ sarve sa kratuḥ syānna me tvataḥ .. 23 ..
16.257.d:
चिन्तयामास मेधावी नाहं शोचामि जीवितुम् ..
मयाहूता द्विजश्रेष्ठा यज्ञार्थं वेदपारगाः ..
इन्द्राद्याश्च सुराः सर्वे स क्रतुः स्यान्न मे त्वतः .. 23 ..
16.257.m: The wise one thought: 'I do not grieve for my life. / The foremost brahmins, masters of the Vedas, were invited by me for the sacrifice, / along with all the gods, Indra and the others; lest my sacrifice be undone, [I must act].'

16.257.s:
sa evaṃ cintayāmāsa vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ ..
mānasaṃ yajñamārabhya tatraiva varavarṇini .. 24 ..
16.257.d:
स एवं चिन्तयामास वेदवेदांगपारगः ..
मानसं यज्ञमारभ्य तत्रैव वरवर्णिनि .. 24 ..
16.257.m: Thus the master of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas reflected, / and beginning a mental sacrifice right there, O woman of excellent complexion,

16.257.s:
svayameva sa sūktāni proktvā proktvā dvijottamaḥ ..
kṛtavānbālukāhomaṃ tena tuṣṭāśca devatāḥ .. 25 ..
16.257.d:
स्वयमेव स सूक्तानि प्रोक्त्वा प्रोक्त्वा द्विजोत्तमः ..
कृतवान्बालुकाहोमं तेन तुष्टाश्च देवताः .. 25 ..
16.257.m: the best of the twice-born recited hymns himself again and again / and offered oblations of sand; and by that the deities were pleased.

16.257.s:
śraddhāṃ tasya viditvā tu bhūyastṛptāstu devatāḥ ..
āgatya brāhmaṇaṃ procuḥ kūpamadhye vyavasthitam .. .. 26 ..
16.257.d:
श्रद्धां तस्य विदित्वा तु भूयस्तृप्तास्तु देवताः ..
आगत्य ब्राह्मणं प्रोचुः कूपमध्ये व्यवस्थितम् .. .. 26 ..
16.257.m: Knowing his faith, the deities were exceedingly satisfied; / arriving, they addressed the brahmin standing inside the well.

16.257.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
bhobho vipra tvayā nūnaṃ sarve saṃtarpitā vayam ..
mānasena tu yajñena tasmādbrūhi manogatam .. 27 ..
16.257.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
भोभो विप्र त्वया नूनं सर्वे संतर्पिता वयम् ..
मानसेन तु यज्ञेन तस्माद्ब्रूहि मनोगतम् .. 27 ..
16.257.m: The gods said: / 'O brahmin, truly we all have been thoroughly gratified by you / through this mental sacrifice; therefore, speak what is in your heart!'

16.257.s:
.. brāhmaṇa uvāca .. ..
yadi devāḥ prasannā me kūpānniṣkamaṇe tvaham ..
yaṣṭā svaṃ maṃdiraṃ gatvā devayajñaṃ karomyaham.. 28 ..
16.257.d:
.. ब्राह्मण उवाच .. ..
यदि देवाः प्रसन्ना मे कूपान्निष्कमणे त्वहम् ..
यष्टा स्वं मंदिरं गत्वा देवयज्ञं करोम्यहम्.. 28 ..
16.257.m: The brahmin said: / 'If the gods are pleased with me, may I emerge from the well; / having gone to my own home, I shall perform the sacrifice to the gods.'

16.257.s:
.. īśvara uvāca ..
atha devaiḥ samādiṣṭā tasminkūpe sarasvatī ..
nirgatya vasudhāṃ bhittvā pūrayāmāsa vāriṇā .. 29 ..
16.257.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच ..
अथ देवैः समादिष्टा तस्मिन्कूपे सरस्वती ..
निर्गत्य वसुधां भित्त्वा पूरयामास वारिणा .. 29 ..
16.257.m: Īśvara said: / Then, commanded by the gods, Sarasvatī / burst through the earth into that well and filled it with water.

16.257.s:
atha niṣkramya vipro'sau yātaḥ svabhavanaṃ prati ..
tataḥ prabhṛti deveśi tritakūpaḥ sa ucyate .. 7.1.257.30 ..
16.257.d:
अथ निष्क्रम्य विप्रोऽसौ यातः स्वभवनं प्रति ..
ततः प्रभृति देवेशि त्रितकूपः स उच्यते .. 7.1.257.30 ..
16.257.m: Then that brahmin emerged and went toward his own house. / From then on, O ruler of the gods, that [well] is called Tritakūpa.

16.257.s:
snātvā tatra śucirbhūtvā tvatha saṃtarpayetpitṝn ..
aśvamedhamavāpnoti sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ .. 31 ..
16.257.d:
स्नात्वा तत्र शुचिर्भूत्वा त्वथ संतर्पयेत्पितॄन् ..
अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति सर्वपापविवर्जितः .. 31 ..
16.257.m: Having bathed there and become pure, one should gratify the ancestors; / rid of all sins, he obtains [the fruit of] a horse sacrifice.

16.257.s:
tila dānaṃ tu deveśi tatra śastaṃ sakāñcanam ..
pitṝṇāṃ vallabhaṃ tīrthaṃ nityaṃ caiva tu bhāmini .. 32 ..
16.257.d:
तिल दानं तु देवेशि तत्र शस्तं सकाञ्चनम् ..
पितॄणां वल्लभं तीर्थं नित्यं चैव तु भामिनि .. 32 ..
16.257.m: A gift of sesamum seeds along with gold is commended there, O ruler of the gods; / this sacred ford is always dear to the ancestors, O lovely lady.

16.257.s:
agniṣvāttā barhiṣada āyaṃtuna iti smṛtāḥ ..
ye divyāḥ pitaro devi teṣāṃ sāṃnidhyamatra hi .. 33 ..
16.257.d:
अग्निष्वात्ता बर्हिषद आयंतुन इति स्मृताः ..
ये दिव्याः पितरो देवि तेषां सांनिध्यमत्र हि .. 33 ..
16.257.m: Those celebrated as Agniṣvāttas and Barhiṣads, / who are divine ancestors, O goddess—their presence is indeed here.

16.257.s:
darśanādapi tīrthasya tasya vai surasattame ..
mucyante prāṇinaḥ pāpādājanmamaraṇāṃtikāt .. .. 34 ..
16.257.d:
दर्शनादपि तीर्थस्य तस्य वै सुरसत्तमे ..
मुच्यन्ते प्राणिनः पापादाजन्ममरणांतिकात् .. .. 34 ..
16.257.m: Merely from the darśana of that sacred ford, O best among the gods, / living beings are freed from sin accumulated from birth until death.

16.257.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra snānaṃ samācaret ..
prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya yadīcchecchreya ātmanaḥ .. 35 ..
16.257.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तत्र स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
प्रभासं क्षेत्रमासाद्य यदीच्छेच्छ्रेय आत्मनः .. 35 ..
16.257.m:
Therefore, with every effort one should perform ritual ablution there,
having reached Prabhāsa kṣetra, if one desires one's own welfare.

16.257.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye tritakūpamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptapañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 257..
16.257.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये त्रितकूपमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तपञ्चाशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 257..
16.257.m: Thus ends the two hundred fifty-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Tritakūpa', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.258.s:
.. .. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi śaśāpānamiti smṛtam ..
tasyaiva dakṣiṇe tīrthaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 1 ..
16.258.d:
.. .. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि शशापानमिति स्मृतम् ..
तस्यैव दक्षिणे तीर्थं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.258.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go, O great goddess, to what is known as Śaśāpāna,
a sacred ford just to the south of it that destroys all sins,

16.258.s:
yasminsnātvā naraḥ samyaṅnāpamṛtyubhayaṃ labhet ..
śṛṇu yasmāttadutpattiṃ vadato mama vallabhe .. 2 ..
16.258.d:
यस्मिन्स्नात्वा नरः सम्यङ्नापमृत्युभयं लभेत् ..
शृणु यस्मात्तदुत्पत्तिं वदतो मम वल्लभे .. 2 ..
16.258.m:
bathing in which a person would thoroughly obtain freedom from fear of untimely death.
Hear from me as I speak of its origin, O beloved.

16.258.s:
mathitvā sāgaraṃ devā gṛhītvā'mṛtamuttamam ..
satvarāstatra te gatvā papuścaiva yathepsayā .. 3 ..
16.258.d:
मथित्वा सागरं देवा गृहीत्वाऽमृतमुत्तमम् ..
सत्वरास्तत्र ते गत्वा पपुश्चैव यथेप्सया .. 3 ..
16.258.m:
Having churned the ocean, the gods took the supreme nectar;
hastily going there, they drank it as they wished.

16.258.s:
pibatāṃ tatra pīyūṣaṃ devānāṃ varavarṇini ..
biṃdavaḥ patitā bhūmau śataśotha sahasraśaḥ .. 4 ..
16.258.d:
पिबतां तत्र पीयूषं देवानां वरवर्णिनि ..
बिंदवः पतिता भूमौ शतशोथ सहस्रशः .. 4 ..
16.258.m:
As the gods were drinking the nectar there, O woman of excellent complexion,
drops fell upon the earth by the hundreds and by the thousands.

16.258.s:
etasminneva kāle tu śaśakastatra cāgataḥ ..
praviṣṭaḥ salile tatra tṛṣārto varavarṇini .. 5 ..
16.258.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु शशकस्तत्र चागतः ..
प्रविष्टः सलिले तत्र तृषार्तो वरवर्णिनि .. 5 ..
16.258.m:
At that very time, a hare came there;
tormented by thirst, O woman of excellent complexion, it entered into that water.

16.258.s:
amaratvamanuprāpto varddhate salilālaye ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tridaśāḥ sarve sparddhamānā muhurmuhuḥ ..
jñātvāmṛtānvitaṃ toyaṃ maṃtraṃ cakrurbhayānvitāḥ .. 6 ..
16.258.d:
अमरत्वमनुप्राप्तो वर्द्धते सलिलालये ..
तं दृष्ट्वा त्रिदशाः सर्वे स्पर्द्धमाना मुहुर्मुहुः ..
ज्ञात्वामृतान्वितं तोयं मंत्रं चक्रुर्भयान्विताः .. 6 ..
16.258.m:
Having attained immortality, it grew within the reservoir of water.
Seeing it, all the gods, continually competing,
realising the water was mixed with nectar, held counsel, filled with fear:

16.258.s:
amṛtaṃ patitaṃ bhūmau bhakṣayiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ ..
tato'marttyā bhaviṣyaṃti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 7 ..
16.258.d:
अमृतं पतितं भूमौ भक्षयिष्यंति मानवाः ..
ततोऽमर्त्त्या भविष्यंति नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 7 ..
16.258.m:
'Nectar has fallen upon the earth; human beings will consume it.
Then they will become immortal; no doubt should be entertained here.

16.258.s:
tiryagyonyāṃ samutpannaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ śaśako hyayam ..
asmābhiḥ sparddhate tasmāttato bhayamupasthitam .. 8 ..
16.258.d:
तिर्यग्योन्यां समुत्पन्नः कृपणः शशको ह्ययम् ..
अस्माभिः स्पर्द्धते तस्मात्ततो भयमुपस्थितम् .. 8 ..
16.258.m:
Indeed, this wretched hare, born in an animal womb,
competes with us; therefore, a danger has presented itself.'

16.258.s:
atha prāpto niśānātho vyādhinā sa pariplutaḥ ..
abravīttridaśānsarvānamṛtaṃ me prayacchata .. 9 ..
16.258.d:
अथ प्राप्तो निशानाथो व्याधिना स परिप्लुतः ..
अब्रवीत्त्रिदशान्सर्वानमृतं मे प्रयच्छत .. 9 ..
16.258.m:
Then the lord of the night arrived, overwhelmed with disease.
He said to all the gods, 'Grant me nectar.

16.258.s:
kṛcchreṇa mahatā prāpto nāhaṃ śakto visarpitum ..
athocustridaśāḥ sarve sarvamasmābhirbhakṣitam .. 7.1.258.10 ..
16.258.d:
कृच्छ्रेण महता प्राप्तो नाहं शक्तो विसर्पितुम् ..
अथोचुस्त्रिदशाः सर्वे सर्वमस्माभिर्भक्षितम् .. 7.1.258.10 ..
16.258.m:
I have arrived with great difficulty; I am not able to move about.'
Then all the gods said, 'All of it has been consumed by us.

16.258.s:
vismṛtastvaṃ niśānātha cirātkasmādihāgataḥ ..
kuruṣva vacanaṃ caṃdra asmākaṃ timirāpaha .. .. 11 ..
16.258.d:
विस्मृतस्त्वं निशानाथ चिरात्कस्मादिहागतः ..
कुरुष्व वचनं चंद्र अस्माकं तिमिरापह .. .. 11 ..
16.258.m:
You were forgotten, O lord of the night; why have you arrived here after a long time?
Follow our advice, O Moon, dispeller of darkness!

16.258.s:
asmiñjale'mṛtaṃ bhūri patitaṃ pibatāṃ hi naḥ ..
tatpibasva niśānātha sarvametajjalāśayam .. 12 ..
16.258.d:
अस्मिञ्जलेऽमृतं भूरि पतितं पिबतां हि नः ..
तत्पिबस्व निशानाथ सर्वमेतज्जलाशयम् .. 12 ..
16.258.m:
Much nectar fell into this water while we were drinking.
Therefore drink, O lord of the night, this entire reservoir of water!

16.258.s:
arddhaṃ nipatitaṃ cātra satyametanniśāmaya ..
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śītaraśmistvarānvitaḥ .. 13 ..
16.258.d:
अर्द्धं निपतितं चात्र सत्यमेतन्निशामय ..
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा शीतरश्मिस्त्वरान्वितः .. 13 ..
16.258.m:
Half of it has fallen in here; know this to be true.'
Hearing their words, the cool-rayed [Moon], filled with haste,

16.258.s:
tṛṣārto vā'pibattoyaṃ śaśakena samanvitam ..
asthiśeṣaṃ tu tattasya kāyaṃ pīyūṣabhakṣaṇāt .. 14 ..
16.258.d:
तृषार्तो वाऽपिबत्तोयं शशकेन समन्वितम् ..
अस्थिशेषं तु तत्तस्य कायं पीयूषभक्षणात् .. 14 ..
16.258.m:
being tormented by thirst, drank the water along with the hare.
His body, which had been reduced to mere bones, from consuming the nectar

16.258.s:
tatkṣaṇātpuṣṭimagamatkāṃtyā paramayā yutaḥ ..
dhātuṣu kṣīyamāṇeṣu puṣṭo hi sudhayā hi saḥ .. 15 ..
16.258.d:
तत्क्षणात्पुष्टिमगमत्कांत्या परमया युतः ..
धातुषु क्षीयमाणेषु पुष्टो हि सुधया हि सः .. 15 ..
16.258.m:
instantly attained nourishment, endowed with supreme lustre.
Indeed, when his bodily elements were wasting away, he was nourished by the ambrosia.

16.258.s:
sa cāpi śaśakastasya na mṛto jaṭharaṃ gataḥ ..
adyāpi dṛśyate tatra dehe pīyūṣabhakṣaṇāt ..16..
16.258.d:
स चापि शशकस्तस्य न मृतो जठरं गतः ..
अद्यापि दृश्यते तत्र देहे पीयूषभक्षणात् ..16..
16.258.m:
And that hare too, having gone into his belly, did not die;
even today it is seen there in his body because of consuming the nectar.

16.258.s:
tatkṣaṇāttuṣṭimagamatkāṃtyā paramayā yutaḥ ..
abruvankhanyatāmetadyathā bhūyo jalaṃ bhavet .. .. 17 ..
16.258.d:
तत्क्षणात्तुष्टिमगमत्कांत्या परमया युतः ..
अब्रुवन्खन्यतामेतद्यथा भूयो जलं भवेत् .. .. 17 ..
16.258.m:
Instantly he attained satisfaction, endowed with supreme lustre.
They said, 'Let this be dug so that water may be [present] once more.

16.258.s:
asmākaṃ saṃgamādetacchuṣkaṃ śvabhraṃ jalāśayam ..
tadyuktaṃ ca kṛtaṃ karma naitatsādhuviceṣṭitam .. 18 ..
16.258.d:
अस्माकं संगमादेतच्छुष्कं श्वभ्रं जलाशयम् ..
तद्युक्तं च कृतं कर्म नैतत्साधुविचेष्टितम् .. 18 ..
16.258.m:
Because of our meeting, this reservoir of water has become a dry ditch.
That was a deedsome act, [yet] this conduct is not good.'

16.258.s:
tato'khanaṃśca te sarve yāvattoyavinirgamaḥ ..
athābruvaṃstataḥ sarve harṣeṇa mahatānvitāḥ .. 19 ..
16.258.d:
ततोऽखनंश्च ते सर्वे यावत्तोयविनिर्गमः ..
अथाब्रुवंस्ततः सर्वे हर्षेण महतान्विताः .. 19 ..
16.258.m:
Then they all dug until there was an emergence of water.
Thereupon they all spoke, endowed with great joy:

16.258.s:
yasmācchaśena saṃyuktaṃ pītametajjalāśayam ..
caṃdreṇa hi śaśāpānaṃ tasmādetadbhaviṣyati .. .. 7.1.258.20 ..
16.258.d:
यस्माच्छशेन संयुक्तं पीतमेतज्जलाशयम् ..
चंद्रेण हि शशापानं तस्मादेतद्भविष्यति .. .. 7.1.258.20 ..
16.258.m:
'Because this reservoir of water was drunk together with the hare
by the Moon, therefore this will be known as Śaśāpāna.

16.258.s:
atrāgatya naraḥ snānaṃ yaḥ kariṣyati bhaktitaḥ ..
sa yāsyati paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ .. 21 ..
16.258.d:
अत्रागत्य नरः स्नानं यः करिष्यति भक्तितः ..
स यास्यति परं स्थानं यत्र देवो महेश्वरः .. 21 ..
16.258.m:
The person who, having come here, will perform ritual ablution with devotion,
he shall go to the supreme abode where the divine Maheśvara resides.

16.258.s:
atrānnaṃ saṃpradāsyaṃti brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samā hitāḥ ..
sarvayajñaphalaṃ teṣāṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 22 ..
16.258.d:
अत्रान्नं संप्रदास्यंति ब्राह्मणेभ्यः समा हिताः ..
सर्वयज्ञफलं तेषां भविष्यति न संशयः .. 22 ..
16.258.m:
Those who, composed in mind, will give food to brahmins here,
the fruit of all sacrifices shall belong to them, there is no doubt.

16.258.s:
asmindṛṣṭe surāḥ sarve dṛṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ ..
evamuktvā surāḥ sarve jagmuścaiva surālayam.. 23 ..
16.258.d:
अस्मिन्दृष्टे सुराः सर्वे दृष्टाः स्युः सर्वदेवताः ..
एवमुक्त्वा सुराः सर्वे जग्मुश्चैव सुरालयम्.. 23 ..
16.258.m:
When this is seen, all the gods, all the deities, would be seen.'
Having spoken thus, all the gods went indeed to the abode of the gods.

16.258.s:
atha kālena mahatā prāptā tatra sarasvatī ..
vaḍavāgniṃ samādāya tayānuplāvitaṃ punaḥ ..24..
16.258.d:
अथ कालेन महता प्राप्ता तत्र सरस्वती ..
वडवाग्निं समादाय तयानुप्लावितं पुनः ..24..
16.258.m:
Then after a long time, Sarasvatī arrived there;
carrying the submarine fire, it was flooded by her once again.

16.258.s:
tato medhyataraṃ jātaṃ tīrthaṃ ca varavarṇini ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra snānaṃ samācaret .. 25 ..
16.258.d:
ततो मेध्यतरं जातं तीर्थं च वरवर्णिनि ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तत्र स्नानं समाचरेत् .. 25 ..
16.258.m:
Then it became an exceedingly pure sacred ford, O woman of excellent complexion.
Therefore, with every effort one should perform ritual ablution there.

16.258.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śaśāpānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāpañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 258 .. .. cha ..
16.258.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शशापानमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टापञ्चाशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 258 .. .. छ ..
16.258.m: Thus ends the two hundred fifty-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Śaśāpāna', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.259.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi parṇādityaṃ sureśvaram ..
prācīsarasvatīkūle taṭe cottarataḥ sthitam.. 1 ..
16.259.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि पर्णादित्यं सुरेश्वरम् ..
प्राचीसरस्वतीकूले तटे चोत्तरतः स्थितम्.. 1 ..
16.259.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go, O great goddess, to Parṇāditya, the lord of gods,
situated on the northern bank, on the shore of the eastern Sarasvatī.

16.259.s:
purā tretāyuge devi parṇādonāma vai dvijaḥ ..
prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya tapastepe sudāruṇam ..
ārādhayāmāsa raviṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ .. 2 ..
16.259.d:
पुरा त्रेतायुगे देवि पर्णादोनाम वै द्विजः ..
प्रभासं क्षेत्रमासाद्य तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम् ..
आराधयामास रविं भक्त्या परमया युतः .. 2 ..

16.259.s:
tarpayitvā tataḥ sūryaṃ dhūpamālyavilepanaiḥ ..
vedoktaiḥ stavanaiḥ sūktairdivārātraṃ samāhitaḥ .. 3 ..
16.259.d:
तर्पयित्वा ततः सूर्यं धूपमाल्यविलेपनैः ..
वेदोक्तैः स्तवनैः सूक्तैर्दिवारात्रं समाहितः .. 3 ..
16.259.m:
Having then propitiated the Sun with incense, garlands, and ointments,
with Vedic praises and hymns, he remained composed day and night.

16.259.s:
evaṃ ca dhyāyatastasya kālena mahatā tataḥ ..
tutoṣa bhagavānsūryo vākyametaduvāca ha .. 4 ..
16.259.d:
एवं च ध्यायतस्तस्य कालेन महता ततः ..
तुतोष भगवान्सूर्यो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 4 ..
16.259.m:
As he was meditating thus, after a long time,
the blessed Sun was pleased and spoke this speech:

16.259.s:
parituṣṭo'smi viprendra tapasānena suvrata ..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te nityaṃ yanmanasepsitam.. 5 ..
16.259.d:
परितुष्टोऽस्मि विप्रेन्द्र तपसानेन सुव्रत ..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते नित्यं यन्मनसेप्सितम्.. 5 ..
16.259.m:
'I am well pleased, O best of brahmins, by this austerity, O one of good vows.
Choose a boon—may it be well with you—whatever is always desired in your heart.'

16.259.s:
.. brāhmaṇa uvāca .. ..
eṣa eva varaḥ kāmo yattuṣṭo bhagavānsvayam ..
darśanaṃ tava deveśa svapneṣvapi ca durllabham.. 6 ..
16.259.d:
.. ब्राह्मण उवाच .. ..
एष एव वरः कामो यत्तुष्टो भगवान्स्वयम् ..
दर्शनं तव देवेश स्वप्नेष्वपि च दुर्ल्लभम्.. 6 ..
16.259.m:
The brahmin said:
'This itself is the boon and wish: that the Blessed Lord himself is pleased.
Darśana of you, O lord of gods, is difficult to attain even in dreams.

16.259.s:
avaśyaṃ yadi dātavyo varo mama divākara ..
atra saṃnihato deva sadā tvaṃ bhava bhāskara .. 7 ..
16.259.d:
अवश्यं यदि दातव्यो वरो मम दिवाकर ..
अत्र संनिहतो देव सदा त्वं भव भास्कर .. 7 ..
16.259.m:
If a boon must certainly be given to me, O Maker of Day,
be ever present here, O divine Bhāskara!

16.259.s:
tava prasādātte yāṃtu tava lokaṃ divā kara ..
evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā hyantardhānaṃ gato raviḥ .. 8 ..
16.259.d:
तव प्रसादात्ते यांतु तव लोकं दिवा कर ..
एवं भविष्यतीत्युक्त्वा ह्यन्तर्धानं गतो रविः .. 8 ..
16.259.m:
By your grace, may they go to your world, O Maker of Day!'
Having said, 'So it shall be,' the Sun vanished.

16.259.s:
parṇādo'pi sthitastatra tasyārādhanatatparaḥ ..
tatra bhādrapade māse ṣaṣṭhyāṃ snānaṃ samācaret ..
parṇādityaṃ tataḥ paśyenna sa duḥkhamavāpnuyāt .. 9 ..
16.259.d:
पर्णादोऽपि स्थितस्तत्र तस्याराधनतत्परः ..
तत्र भाद्रपदे मासे षष्ठ्यां स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
पर्णादित्यं ततः पश्येन्न स दुःखमवाप्नुयात् .. 9 ..

16.259.s:
gośatasya prayāge tu samyagdattasya yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ labhate martyaḥ parṇādityasya darśanāt .. 7.1.259.10 ..
16.259.d:
गोशतस्य प्रयागे तु सम्यग्दत्तस्य यत्फलम् ..
तत्फलं लभते मर्त्यः पर्णादित्यस्य दर्शनात् .. 7.1.259.10 ..
16.259.m:
Whatever fruit is attained from a hundred cows properly given at Prayāga,
a mortal obtains that fruit from the darśana of Parṇāditya.

16.259.s:
ye sevaṃte mahākuṣṭhaṃ pāṃgulyaṃ ca vivarcikāḥ ..
parṇādityaṃ na jānaṃti nūnaṃ te maṃdabuddhayaḥ .. 11 ..
16.259.d:
ये सेवंते महाकुष्ठं पांगुल्यं च विवर्चिकाः ..
पर्णादित्यं न जानंति नूनं ते मंदबुद्धयः .. 11 ..
16.259.m:
Those who suffer from severe leprosy, lameness, and scabs,
and do not know of Parṇāditya—surely they are dull of intellect.

16.259.s: iti śrīskānde mahapurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye parṇādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..259..
16.259.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महपुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पर्णादित्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनषष्ट्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..259..
16.259.m: Thus ends the two hundred fifty-ninth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Parṇāditya', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.260.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ siddheśvaraṃ param ..
tasyaiva paścime bhāge siddhaiḥ saṃsthāpitaṃ purā ..1 ..
16.260.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवं सिद्धेश्वरं परम् ..
तस्यैव पश्चिमे भागे सिद्धैः संस्थापितं पुरा ..1 ..
16.260.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the supreme god Siddheśvara, / established in ancient times by the Siddhas in its western part.

16.260.s:
siddhā nāma surāḥ pūrvaṃ tatrāgatya varānane ..
liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsuḥ siddhyarthaṃ sarvavastuṣu .. 2..
16.260.d:
सिद्धा नाम सुराः पूर्वं तत्रागत्य वरानने ..
लिंगं संस्थापयामासुः सिद्ध्यर्थं सर्ववस्तुषु .. 2..
16.260.m: In ancient times, the gods known as Siddhas came there, O fair-faced woman, / and installed the liṅga for the sake of attaining perfection in all things.

16.260.s:
tatastuṣṭo mahādevi teṣāṃ dṛṣṭvā tapo mahat ..
aṇimādikamaiśvaryaṃ teṣāṃ sarvaṃ dadau śivaḥ .. 3 ..
16.260.d:
ततस्तुष्टो महादेवि तेषां दृष्ट्वा तपो महत् ..
अणिमादिकमैश्वर्यं तेषां सर्वं ददौ शिवः .. 3 ..
16.260.m: Then, pleased upon seeing their great austerity, O great goddess, / Śiva granted them all sovereign powers, beginning with the power of becoming atomic.

16.260.s: abravīdatra me nityaṃ sānidhyaṃ ca bhaviṣyati .. 4 ..
16.260.d: अब्रवीदत्र मे नित्यं सानिध्यं च भविष्यति .. 4 ..
16.260.m: He said: “And here my presence will be perpetual.

16.260.s:
caitre śuklacaturddaśyāṃ yo'tra māṃ pūjayiṣyati ..
sa yāsyati paraṃ sthānaṃ prasādānmama puṇyakṛt .. 5 ..
16.260.d:
चैत्रे शुक्लचतुर्द्दश्यां योऽत्र मां पूजयिष्यति ..
स यास्यति परं स्थानं प्रसादान्मम पुण्यकृत् .. 5 ..
16.260.m: Whoever worships me here on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, / that merit-maker shall go to the supreme abode through my grace.”

16.260.s:
evamuktvā'tha bhagavāñjagāmādarśanaṃ tataḥ ..
siddhāścaiva tadā''gatya pūjayaṃti maheśvaram .. 6 ..
16.260.d:
एवमुक्त्वाऽथ भगवाञ्जगामादर्शनं ततः ..
सिद्धाश्चैव तदा'ऽगत्य पूजयंति महेश्वरम् .. 6 ..
16.260.m: Having spoken thus, the Lord then vanished from sight; / and the Siddhas, having come, worship Maheśvara.

16.260.s:
yastamārādhayedbhaktyā saṃsiddhiṃ labhate'dbhutām..
īpsitāṃ ca suraśreṣṭhe tasmāttaṃ pūjayetsadā .. 7 ..
16.260.d:
यस्तमाराधयेद्भक्त्या संसिद्धिं लभतेऽद्भुताम्..
ईप्सितां च सुरश्रेष्ठे तस्मात्तं पूजयेत्सदा .. 7 ..
16.260.m: Whoever worships him with devotion attains wondrous perfection, / and what is desired, O best among the gods; therefore, one should always worship him.

16.260.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 260 ..
16.260.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सिद्धेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षष्ट्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 260 ..
16.260.m: Thus ends the two hundred and sixtieth chapter, entitled “The Description of the Māhātmya of Siddheśvara,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.261.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi yatra nyaṃkumatī nadī ..
maryādārthaṃ samānītā kṣetraśāṃtyai ca śaṃbhunā .. 1 ..
16.261.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि यत्र न्यंकुमती नदी ..
मर्यादार्थं समानीता क्षेत्रशांत्यै च शंभुना .. 1 ..
16.261.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to where the Nyaṅkumatī river is, / brought by Śambhu to mark the boundary and for the peace of the sacred field.

16.261.s:
tasyaiva dakṣiṇe bhāge sarvapāpapraṇāśinī ..
tasyāṃ snātvā ca vai samyagyaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ ..
sa pitṝṃstārayetsarvānnarakānnātra saṃśayaḥ .. 2 ..
16.261.d:
तस्यैव दक्षिणे भागे सर्वपापप्रणाशिनी ..
तस्यां स्नात्वा च वै सम्यग्यः श्राद्धं कुरुते नरः ..
स पितॄंस्तारयेत्सर्वान्नरकान्नात्र संशयः .. 2 ..
16.261.m: In its southern part, it destroys all sins. / Having properly bathed in it, whatever man performs a śrāddha / delivers all his ancestors from hell, without doubt.

16.261.s:
vaiśākhe śuklapakṣe tu tṛtīyāyāṃ ca bhāmini ..
snātvā tu tarpayedbhaktyā tiladarbhajalaiḥ priye ..
śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavettena gaṃgāyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 3 ..
16.261.d:
वैशाखे शुक्लपक्षे तु तृतीयायां च भामिनि ..
स्नात्वा तु तर्पयेद्भक्त्या तिलदर्भजलैः प्रिये ..
श्राद्धं कृतं भवेत्तेन गंगायां नात्र संशयः .. 3 ..
16.261.m: In the month of Vaiśākha, on the third day of the bright fortnight, O passionate woman, / having bathed and offered libations with devotion using water, sesame seeds, and darbha grass, O beloved, / by him a śrāddha has been performed at the Gaṅgā, without doubt.

16.261.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nyaṃkumatīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 261 ..
16.261.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये न्यंकुमतीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकषष्ट्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 261 ..
16.261.m: Thus ends the two hundred and sixty-first chapter, entitled “The Description of the Māhātmya of Nyaṅkumatī,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.262.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi varāhaṃ tatra saṃsthitam ..
goṣpadāddakṣiṇe bhāge sthitaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam .. 1 ..
16.262.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि वराहं तत्र संस्थितम् ..
गोष्पदाद्दक्षिणे भागे स्थितं पापप्रणाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.262.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to Varāha situated there, / situated in the southern part from Goṣpada, destroying sin.

16.262.s:
ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ ..
sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvairgacchedviṣṇupadaṃ mahat .. 2 ..
16.262.d:
एकादश्यां सिते पक्षे यस्तं पूजयते नरः ..
स मुक्तः पातकैः सर्वैर्गच्छेद्विष्णुपदं महत् .. 2 ..
16.262.m: Whatever man worships him on the eleventh day of the bright fortnight, / freed from all sins, he shall go to the great abode of Viṣṇu.

16.262.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye varāhasvāmimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dviṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 262 ..
16.262.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये वराहस्वामिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विषष्ट्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 262 ..
16.262.m: Thus ends the two hundred and sixty-second chapter, entitled “The Description of the Māhātmya of Varāhasvāmin,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.263.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi cchāyāliṃgamiti smṛtam ..
uttare nyaṃkumatyāśca bahvāścaryaṃ mahatphalam .. 1 ..
16.263.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि च्छायालिंगमिति स्मृतम् ..
उत्तरे न्यंकुमत्याश्च बह्वाश्चर्यं महत्फलम् .. 1 ..
16.263.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the one known as the Chāyāliṅga, / north of the Nyaṅkumatī, full of great wonders and yielding great fruit.

16.263.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi mucyate paṃcapātakaiḥ ..
sārddhadvādaśahastaṃ tu yojanatritayena tu ..
na paśyaṃti mahādevi pāpiṣṭhā ye tu mānavāḥ .. 2 ..
16.263.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो देवि मुच्यते पंचपातकैः ..
सार्द्धद्वादशहस्तं तु योजनत्रितयेन तु ..
न पश्यंति महादेवि पापिष्ठा ये तु मानवाः .. 2 ..
16.263.m: Having seen it, O goddess, a mortal is freed from the five grave sins. / Measuring twelve cubits and a half, across three yojanas, / most sinful mortals do not behold it, O great goddess.

16.263.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye chāyāliṃga māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 263 ..
16.263.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये छायालिंग माहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिषष्ट्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 263 ..
16.263.m: Thus ends the two hundred and sixty-third chapter, entitled “The Description of the Māhātmya of the Chāyāliṅga,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.264.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatraiva saṃsthitā devi guphā pātakanāśinī ..
ṛṣīṇāṃ saṃsthitiryatra siddhānāṃ puṇyacetasām .. 1 ..
16.264.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तत्रैव संस्थिता देवि गुफा पातकनाशिनी ..
ऋषीणां संस्थितिर्यत्र सिद्धानां पुण्यचेतसाम् .. 1 ..
16.264.m: Īśvara said: / Right there, O goddess, is situated the cave that destroys sins, / where is the dwelling of the seers and the holy-minded Siddhas.

16.264.s:
tatra gatvā mahādevi guphāṃ yaḥ paśyate naraḥ ..
sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaścāṃdrāyaṇaphalaṃ labhet.. 2 ..
16.264.d:
तत्र गत्वा महादेवि गुफां यः पश्यते नरः ..
स मुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यश्चांद्रायणफलं लभेत्.. 2 ..
16.264.m: Going there, O great goddess, whatever man beholds the cave / is freed from all sins and attains the fruit of the cāndrāyaṇa penance.

16.264.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye naṃdinīguphāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥṣaṣṭyu ttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 264 ..
16.264.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये नंदिनीगुफामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुःषष्ट्यु त्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 264 ..
16.264.m: Thus ends the two hundred and sixty-fourth chapter, entitled “The Description of the Māhātmya of the Cave of Nandinī,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.265.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi aiśānyāṃ diśi saṃsthitām ..
devīṃ kanakanaṃdākhyāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradām.. 1 ..
16.265.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि ऐशान्यां दिशि संस्थिताम् ..
देवीं कनकनंदाख्यां सर्वकामफलप्रदाम्.. 1 ..
16.265.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the goddess named Kanakanandā, / situated in the north-eastern direction, granting the fruit of all desires.

16.265.s:
tatra śuklatṛtīyāyāṃ caitre māsi vidhānataḥ ..
yātrāṃ kuryācca matimānsarvakāmamavāpnuyāt .. 2 ..
16.265.d:
तत्र शुक्लतृतीयायां चैत्रे मासि विधानतः ..
यात्रां कुर्याच्च मतिमान्सर्वकाममवाप्नुयात् .. 2 ..
16.265.m: There, on the third day of the bright fortnight in the month of Caitra, / a wise person should make a pilgrimage according to rule and obtain all desires.

16.265.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kanakanaṃdāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ.. .. 265 ..
16.265.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महा पुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कनकनंदामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पंचषष्ट्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः.. .. 265 ..
16.265.m: Thus ends the two hundred and sixty-fifth chapter, entitled “The Description of the Māhātmya of Kanakanandā,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.266.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi kumbhīśvaramanuttamam ..
śarabhasthānataḥ pūrve nātidūre vyavasthitam ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ..1..
16.266.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि कुम्भीश्वरमनुत्तमम् ..
शरभस्थानतः पूर्वे नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् ..
तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो देवि मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः ..1..
16.266.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the unexcelled Kumbhīśvara, / situated to the east of Śarabhasthāna, not very far away. / Having seen him, O goddess, a mortal is freed from all sins.

16.266.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kuṃbhīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 266 ..
16.266.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कुंभीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्षष्ट्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 266 ..
16.266.m: Thus ends the two hundred and sixty-sixth chapter, entitled “The Description of the Māhātmya of Kumbhīśvara,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.267.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi sthānaṃ gaṃgāpatheti ca ..
yatra gaṃgā mahāsrotā gaṃgeśvaraḥ śivastathā .. 1 ..
16.267.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि स्थानं गंगापथेति च ..
यत्र गंगा महास्रोता गंगेश्वरः शिवस्तथा .. 1 ..
16.267.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the place called Gaṅgāpatha, / where the Gaṅgā of great currents is, as well as Śiva as Gaṅgeśvara.

16.267.s:
samudragāminī devi sā gaṃgā pāpanāśinī ..
uttāneti bhuvi khyātā nadī trailokyabhūṣaṇā .. 2 ..
16.267.d:
समुद्रगामिनी देवि सा गंगा पापनाशिनी ..
उत्तानेति भुवि ख्याता नदी त्रैलोक्यभूषणा .. 2 ..
16.267.m: That Gaṅgā flowing to the ocean, O goddess, destroys sin; / known on earth as Uttānā, it is an ornament of the three worlds.

16.267.s:
tatra snātvā mahādevi gaṃgeśaṃ yastu pūjayet..
muktaḥ syātpātakairghorairaśvamedhāyutaṃ labhet.. 3 ..
16.267.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा महादेवि गंगेशं यस्तु पूजयेत्..
मुक्तः स्यात्पातकैर्घोरैरश्वमेधायुतं लभेत्.. 3 ..
16.267.m: Having bathed there, O great goddess, whoever worships Gaṅgeśa / would be freed from terrible sins and obtain [the fruit of] ten thousand horse sacrifices.

16.267.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gaṅgāpathagaṃgeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 267 ..
16.267.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गङ्गापथगंगेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तषष्ट्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 267 ..
16.267.m: Thus ends the two hundred and sixty-seventh chapter, entitled “The Description of the Māhātmya of Gaṅgāpatha and Gaṅgeśvara,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.268.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi camasodbhedamuttamam ..
yatra brahmā'karotsatraṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ priye .. 1 ..
16.268.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि चमसोद्भेदमुत्तमम् ..
यत्र ब्रह्माऽकरोत्सत्रं वर्षाणामयुतं प्रिये .. 1 ..
16.268.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the excellent Camasodbheda, / where Brahmā performed a sacrificial session lasting ten thousand years, O beloved.

16.268.s:
camasaiḥ pītavantaste somaṃ devā maharṣayaḥ ..
camasodbhedanāmeti tena khyātaṃ dharātale .. 2 ..
16.268.d:
चमसैः पीतवन्तस्ते सोमं देवा महर्षयः ..
चमसोद्भेदनामेति तेन ख्यातं धरातले .. 2 ..
16.268.m: With camasa vessels those gods and great seers drank soma; / therefore it is famed on the surface of the earth by the name Camasodbheda.

16.268.s:
tatra snātvā sarasvatyāṃ piṃḍadānaṃ dadāti yaḥ ..
gayākoṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ vaiśākhyāṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ .. 3 ..
16.268.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा सरस्वत्यां पिंडदानं ददाति यः ..
गयाकोटिगुणं पुण्यं वैशाख्यां प्राप्नुयान्नरः .. 3 ..
16.268.m: Having bathed there in the Sarasvatī, whatever man gives an offering of rice-balls / on the full moon of Vaiśākha, attains a merit ten million times that of Gayā.

16.268.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye camasodbhedamāhātmya varṇanaṃnāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ... 268 ..
16.268.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये चमसोद्भेदमाहात्म्य वर्णनंनामाष्टषष्ट्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ... 268 ..
16.268.m: Thus ends the two hundred and sixty-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Camasodbheda,' in the first [part], the 'Glory of Prabhāsa-kṣetra,' of the seventh section, Prabhāsa-khaṇḍa, in the Skandapurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

16.269.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi vidurasyāśramaṃ mahat ..
yatrākarottapo raudraṃ viduro dharma mūrttimān .. 1 ..
16.269.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि विदुरस्याश्रमं महत् ..
यत्राकरोत्तपो रौद्रं विदुरो धर्म मूर्त्तिमान् .. 1 ..
16.269.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the great hermitage of Vidura, / where Vidura, righteousness embodied, performed terrible austerity, 1

16.269.s:
pratiṣṭhāpya mahādevaṃ liṃgaṃ tribhuvaneśvaram ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ..2..
16.269.d:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य महादेवं लिंगं त्रिभुवनेश्वरम् ..
तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो देवि सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ..2..
16.269.m: having installed Mahādeva, the liṅga that is lord of the three worlds. / Seeing him, O goddess, a mortal obtains all desires. 2

16.269.s:
vidurāṭṭālakaṃ nāma gaṇagaṃdharvasevitam ..
dvādaśasthānakaṃ sthānaṃ nālpapuṇyena labhyate .. 3 ..
16.269.d:
विदुराट्टालकं नाम गणगंधर्वसेवितम् ..
द्वादशस्थानकं स्थानं नाल्पपुण्येन लभ्यते .. 3 ..
16.269.m: Named Vidurāṭṭālaka, it is served by the hosts of attendants and Gandharvas. / A station of twelve stations, it is not gained with small merit. 3

16.269.s:
nāvarṣaṇaṃ bhavettatra kadācidapi pārvati ..
liṃgāni tatra divyāni paśyetpāpopaśāṃtaye .. 4 ..
16.269.d:
नावर्षणं भवेत्तत्र कदाचिदपि पार्वति ..
लिंगानि तत्र दिव्यानि पश्येत्पापोपशांतये .. 4 ..
16.269.m: Drought never occurs there at any time, O Pārvatī. / One should look upon the divine liṅgas there for the pacification of sins. 4

16.269.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vidurāśrama māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonasaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..269..
16.269.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये विदुराश्रम माहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनसप्तत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..269..
16.269.m: Thus ends the two hundred and sixty-ninth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Vidura's Hermitage,' in the first [part], the 'Glory of Prabhāsa-kṣetra,' of the seventh section, Prabhāsa-khaṇḍa, in the Skandapurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

16.270.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi yatra prācī sarasvatī ..
tatra sthāne sthitaṃ liṃgaṃ maṃkīśvaramiti śrutam .. 1 ..
16.270.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि यत्र प्राची सरस्वती ..
तत्र स्थाने स्थितं लिंगं मंकीश्वरमिति श्रुतम् .. 1 ..
16.270.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to where the eastward-flowing Sarasvatī is. / In that place stands the liṅga known as Maṅkīśvara. 1

16.270.s:
tasyotpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapātakanāśinīm ..
śṛṇu devi mahābhāge hyāścaryaṃ yadabhūtpurā .. 2 ..
16.270.d:
तस्योत्पत्तिं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वपातकनाशिनीम् ..
शृणु देवि महाभागे ह्याश्चर्यं यदभूत्पुरा .. 2 ..
16.270.m: I shall relate its origin, which destroys all sins. / Hear, O blessed goddess, what a wonder occurred formerly! 2

16.270.s:
ṛṣirmaṃkaṇako nāma sa tepe paramaṃ tapaḥ ..
prācīmetya yatāhāro nityaṃ svādhyāyatatparaḥ.. 3 ..
16.270.d:
ऋषिर्मंकणको नाम स तेपे परमं तपः ..
प्राचीमेत्य यताहारो नित्यं स्वाध्यायतत्परः.. 3 ..
16.270.m: A seer named Maṅkaṇaka performed supreme austerity. / Coming to the eastward-flowing [river], with restrained food, he was constantly dedicated to sacred study. 3

16.270.s:
bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi tasyātītāni bhāmini ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya viddhādasya varānane .. 4 ..
16.270.d:
बहुवर्षसहस्राणि तस्यातीतानि भामिनि ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य विद्धादस्य वरानने .. 4 ..
16.270.m: Many thousands of years passed for him, O radiant woman. / But at some time, O fair-faced one, when he was pierced, 4

16.270.s:
karācchākaraso jātaḥ kuśāgreṇeti naḥ śrutam ..
sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāścaryaṃ vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ..5..
16.270.d:
कराच्छाकरसो जातः कुशाग्रेणेति नः श्रुतम् ..
स तं दृष्ट्वा महाश्चर्यं विस्मयं परमं गतः..5..
16.270.m: vegetable sap issued from his hand due to a blade of kuśa grass—so it is heard by us. / Seeing that great wonder, he was seized with supreme amazement. 5

16.270.s:
mene siddhiṃ parāṃ prāpto harṣānnṛtyamathākarot ..
tasminsaṃnṛtyamāne ca jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam .. 6 ..
16.270.d:
मेने सिद्धिं परां प्राप्तो हर्षान्नृत्यमथाकरोत् ..
तस्मिन्संनृत्यमाने च जगत्स्थावरजंगमम् .. 6 ..
16.270.m: Believing he had attained the highest perfection, he then danced out of joy. / And as he danced, the universe of mobile and immobile beings 6

16.270.s:
anarttata varārohe prabhāvāttasya vai muneḥ ..
tato devā maheṃdrādyā brahmaviṣṇupurassarāḥ ..
ūcustripurahaṃtāraṃ nāyaṃ nṛtyettathā kuru .. 7 ..
16.270.d:
अनर्त्तत वरारोहे प्रभावात्तस्य वै मुनेः ..
ततो देवा महेंद्राद्या ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरस्सराः ..
ऊचुस्त्रिपुरहंतारं नायं नृत्येत्तथा कुरु .. 7 ..
16.270.m: danced, O woman of shapely hips, through the power of that sage indeed. / Then the gods led by Mahendra, with Brahmā and Viṣṇu at their head, / said to the slayer of Tripura: 'Act so that he does not dance! 7

16.270.s:
calitāḥ parvatāḥ sthānātkṣubhito makarālayaḥ ..
dharaṇī khaṇḍaśo deva vṛkṣāśca nidhanaṃ gatāḥ .. 8 ..
16.270.d:
चलिताः पर्वताः स्थानात्क्षुभितो मकरालयः ..
धरणी खण्डशो देव वृक्षाश्च निधनं गताः .. 8 ..
16.270.m: The mountains have moved from their place; the ocean is agitated; / the earth is in pieces, O god, and the trees have met destruction. 8

16.270.s:
utpathāśca mahānadyo grahā unmārgasaṃsthitāḥ ..
trailokyaṃ vyākulībhūtaṃ yāvatprāpnoti saṃkṣayam ..9..
16.270.d:
उत्पथाश्च महानद्यो ग्रहा उन्मार्गसंस्थिताः ..
त्रैलोक्यं व्याकुलीभूतं यावत्प्राप्नोति संक्षयम् ..9..
16.270.m: The great rivers have gone astray, and the planets are wandering off course. / The three worlds have been confounded, and will soon meet destruction! 9

16.270.s: tāvannivārayasvainaṃ nānyaḥ śakto nivāraṇe .. 7.1.270.10 ..
16.270.d: तावन्निवारयस्वैनं नान्यः शक्तो निवारणे .. 7.1.270.10 ..
16.270.m: Therefore restrain him; no other is capable of restraining [him].' 10

16.270.s:
sa tatheti pratijñāya gatvā tasya samīpataḥ ..
dvijarūpaṃ samāsthāya tamṛṣiṃ vākyamabravīt .. 11 ..
16.270.d:
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय गत्वा तस्य समीपतः ..
द्विजरूपं समास्थाय तमृषिं वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 11 ..
16.270.m: Saying 'So be it,' he approached him. / Assuming the form of a twice-born, he spoke these words to the seer: 11

16.270.s:
ko harṣaviṣayaḥ kasmāttvayaitannṛtyate dvija ..
tasmātkāryaṃ vadāśu tvaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ dvijaḥ .. 12 ..
16.270.d:
को हर्षविषयः कस्मात्त्वयैतन्नृत्यते द्विज ..
तस्मात्कार्यं वदाशु त्वं परं कौतूहलं द्विजः .. 12 ..
16.270.m: 'What is this ground for joy? Why are you dancing thus, O twice-born? / Therefore speak quickly of the matter; the twice-born is filled with extreme curiosity.' 12

16.270.s:
.. ṛṣiruvāca .. ..
kiṃ na paśyasi me brahmankarācchākara saṃ cyutam..
ata eva hi me nṛtyaṃ siddho'haṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 13 ..
16.270.d:
.. ऋषिरुवाच .. ..
किं न पश्यसि मे ब्रह्मन्कराच्छाकर सं च्युतम्..
अत एव हि मे नृत्यं सिद्धोऽहं नात्र संशयः .. 13 ..
16.270.m: The seer said: / 'Do you not see, O brahmin, the vegetable sap flowing from my hand? / This is why I am dancing; I have attained perfection, there is no doubt about this.' 13

16.270.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhagavāṃstripurāṃtakaḥ ..
aṃguṣṭhaṃ tāḍayāmāsa aṃgulyagreṇa bhāmini .. 14 ..
16.270.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भगवांस्त्रिपुरांतकः ..
अंगुष्ठं ताडयामास अंगुल्यग्रेण भामिनि .. 14 ..
16.270.m: Īśvara said: / Hearing those words of his, the blessed destroyer of Tripura / struck his own thumb with the tip of a finger, O radiant one. 14

16.270.s:
tato vinirgataṃ bhasma tatkṣaṇāddhimapāṃḍuram ..
athābravītprahasyainaṃ bhagavānbhūtabhāvanaḥ .. 15 ..
16.270.d:
ततो विनिर्गतं भस्म तत्क्षणाद्धिमपांडुरम् ..
अथाब्रवीत्प्रहस्यैनं भगवान्भूतभावनः .. 15 ..
16.270.m: Thereupon ashes issued forth instantly, white as snow. / Then, laughing, the blessed creator of beings said to him: 15

16.270.s:
paśya meṃ'guṣṭhato brahmanbhūri bhasma vinirgatam ..
na nṛtye'haṃ na me harṣastathāpi munisattama .. 16 ..
16.270.d:
पश्य मेंऽगुष्ठतो ब्रह्मन्भूरि भस्म विनिर्गतम् ..
न नृत्येऽहं न मे हर्षस्तथापि मुनिसत्तम .. 16 ..
16.270.m: 'Look, O brahmin, copious ash has issued from my thumb! / Yet I do not dance, nor do I have joy, O best of sages.' 16

16.270.s:
taddṛṣṭvā sumahāścaryaṃ vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ..
abravītprāṃjalirbhūtvā harṣagadgadayā girā .. 17 ..
16.270.d:
तद्दृष्ट्वा सुमहाश्चर्यं विस्मयं परमं गतः ..
अब्रवीत्प्रांजलिर्भूत्वा हर्षगद्गदया गिरा .. 17 ..
16.270.m: Seeing that very great wonder, he was seized with supreme amazement. / With joined palms, he spoke in a voice choked with joy: 17

16.270.s:
nānyaṃ devamahaṃ manye .tvāṃ muktvā vṛṣabhadhvajam ..
nānyasya vidyate śaktirīdṛśī dharaṇītale .. 18 .. ..
16.270.d:
नान्यं देवमहं मन्ये .त्वां मुक्त्वा वृषभध्वजम् ..
नान्यस्य विद्यते शक्तिरीदृशी धरणीतले .. 18 .. ..
16.270.m: 'I consider no other god [to exist] besides you, whose emblem is the bull. / No one else possesses such power on the face of the earth.' 18

16.270.s:
.. bhagavānuvāca .. ..
jñāto'smi muniśārdūla tvayā vedavidāṃ vara ..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te nityaṃ yanmanasepsitam .. 19 ..
16.270.d:
.. भगवानुवाच .. ..
ज्ञातोऽस्मि मुनिशार्दूल त्वया वेदविदां वर ..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते नित्यं यन्मनसेप्सितम् .. 19 ..
16.270.m: The Blessed One said: / 'I have been recognized by you, O tiger among sages, best among knowers of the Veda! / Choose a boon—may it be well with you—whatever your heart constantly desires.' 19

16.270.s:
.. ṛṣiruvāca .. ..
prasādāddevadevasya nṛtyena mahatā vibho ..
yathā na syāttapohānistathā nītirvidhīyatām .. 7.1.270.20 ..
16.270.d:
.. ऋषिरुवाच .. ..
प्रसादाद्देवदेवस्य नृत्येन महता विभो ..
यथा न स्यात्तपोहानिस्तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम् .. 7.1.270.20 ..
16.270.m: The seer said: / 'By the grace of the God of gods, O all-pervading lord, let a means be ordained / so that through this great dancing there may be no loss of austerity.' 20

16.270.s:
.. śaṃbhuruvāca .. ..
tapaste varddhatāṃ vipra matprasādātsahasradhā ..
prācīmanviha vatsyāmi tvayā sārddhamahaṃ sadā .. 21 ..
16.270.d:
.. शंभुरुवाच .. ..
तपस्ते वर्द्धतां विप्र मत्प्रसादात्सहस्रधा ..
प्राचीमन्विह वत्स्यामि त्वया सार्द्धमहं सदा .. 21 ..
16.270.m: Śambhu said: / 'May your austerity increase a thousandfold by my grace, O vipra! / Following the eastward-flowing [river], I shall constantly dwell here together with you. 21

16.270.s:
sarasvatī mahāpuṇyā kṣetre cāsminviśeṣataḥ ..
sarasvatyuttare tīre yastyajedātmanastanum .. 22 ..
16.270.d:
सरस्वती महापुण्या क्षेत्रे चास्मिन्विशेषतः ..
सरस्वत्युत्तरे तीरे यस्त्यजेदात्मनस्तनुम् .. 22 ..
16.270.m: Sarasvatī is of great merit, and especially in this sacred field. / Whoever abandons his body on the northern bank of Sarasvatī, 22

16.270.s:
prācīne hyṛṣiśārdūla na cehāgacchate punaḥ ..
āpluto vājimedhasya phalaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam .. 23 ..
16.270.d:
प्राचीने ह्यृषिशार्दूल न चेहागच्छते पुनः ..
आप्लुतो वाजिमेधस्य फलं प्राप्नोति पुष्कलम् .. 23 ..
16.270.m: on the eastern side, O tiger among sages, does not return here again. / Having bathed, one obtains the bountiful fruit of a horse-sacrifice. 23

16.270.s:
niyamaiścopa vāsaiśca śoṣayandehamātmanaḥ..
jalāhārā vāyubhakṣāḥ parṇāhārāśca tāpasāḥ ..
tathā ca sthaṃḍilaśayā ye cānye niyatāḥ pṛthak ...24..
16.270.d:
नियमैश्चोप वासैश्च शोषयन्देहमात्मनः..
जलाहारा वायुभक्षाः पर्णाहाराश्च तापसाः ..
तथा च स्थंडिलशया ये चान्ये नियताः पृथक् ...24..
16.270.m: Drying up their bodies by observances and fasts, / living on water, eating wind, subsisting on leaves—such ascetics— / and likewise those who sleep on the bare ground, and whatever other various restrained persons [there may be]— 24

16.270.s:
ye snānamācariṣyaṃti tīrthe'sminniyamānvitāḥ ..
te yāṃti paramāṃ siddhiṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramaṃ padam .. 25 ..
16.270.d:
ये स्नानमाचरिष्यंति तीर्थेऽस्मिन्नियमान्विताः ..
ते यांति परमां सिद्धिं ब्रह्मणः परमं पदम् .. 25 ..
16.270.m: those who perform ablutions in this sacred ford, endowed with observances, / attain the highest perfection, the supreme abode of Brahmā. 25

16.270.s:
asmiṃstīrthe tu yo dānaṃ truṭimātraṃ ca kāṃcanam ..
dadāti dvijamukhyāya merutulyaṃ bhavetphalam ..26..
16.270.d:
अस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु यो दानं त्रुटिमात्रं च कांचनम् ..
ददाति द्विजमुख्याय मेरुतुल्यं भवेत्फलम् ..26..
16.270.m: And whoever gives even a particle of gold in this sacred ford / to an eminent twice-born, its fruit becomes equal to Mount Meru. 26

16.270.s:
asmiṃstīrthe tu ye śrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃtīha mānavāḥ..
ekaviṃśatkulopetāḥ svargaṃ yāsyaṃti te dhruvam ..27..
16.270.d:
अस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु ये श्राद्धं करिष्यंतीह मानवाः..
एकविंशत्कुलोपेताः स्वर्गं यास्यंति ते ध्रुवम् ..27..
16.270.m: And whatever mortals perform an ancestral rite in this sacred ford, / they will surely go to heaven accompanied by twenty-one generations. 27

16.270.s:
pitṝṇāṃ vallabhaṃ tīrthaṃ piṃḍenaikena tarpitāḥ ..
brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyaṃti suputreṇeha tāritāḥ .. 28 ..
16.270.d:
पितॄणां वल्लभं तीर्थं पिंडेनैकेन तर्पिताः ..
ब्रह्मलोकं गमिष्यंति सुपुत्रेणेह तारिताः .. 28 ..
16.270.m: This sacred ford is beloved by the ancestors; gratified by a single funeral cake, / delivered here by a good son, they will go to the world of Brahmā. 28

16.270.s: bhūyaścānnaṃ prayacchaṃti mokṣamārgaṃ vrajaṃti te .. 29 ..
16.270.d: भूयश्चान्नं प्रयच्छंति मोक्षमार्गं व्रजंति ते .. 29 ..
16.270.m: And they who continuously give food set out on the path of liberation. 29

16.270.s:
atra ye śubha karmāṇaḥ prabhāsasthāṃ sarasvatīm ..
paśyaṃti tepi yāsyaṃti svargalokaṃ dvijottamāḥ ..7.1.270.30..
16.270.d:
अत्र ये शुभ कर्माणः प्रभासस्थां सरस्वतीम् ..
पश्यंति तेपि यास्यंति स्वर्गलोकं द्विजोत्तमाः ..7.1.270.30..
16.270.m: Here, those of auspicious deeds who gaze upon Sarasvatī situated in Prabhāsa, / they too will go to the heavenly world, O best of the twice-born. 30

16.270.s:
ye punastatra bhāvena narāḥ snānaparāyaṇāḥ ..
brahmalokaṃ samāsādya te ramiṣyaṃti sarvadā .. 31 ..
16.270.d:
ये पुनस्तत्र भावेन नराः स्नानपरायणाः ..
ब्रह्मलोकं समासाद्य ते रमिष्यंति सर्वदा .. 31 ..
16.270.m: Moreover, those people who are devoted to bathing there with faith, / having reached the world of Brahmā, they will rejoice forever. 31

16.270.s:
dadhi pradadyādyo'pīha brāhmaṇāya manoramam ..
so'pyagnilokamāsādya bhuṃkte bhogānsuśobhanān .. 32 ..
16.270.d:
दधि प्रदद्याद्योऽपीह ब्राह्मणाय मनोरमम् ..
सोऽप्यग्निलोकमासाद्य भुंक्ते भोगान्सुशोभनान् .. 32 ..
16.270.m: Whoever gives delightful curds to a brahmin here, / he too, having reached the world of Agni, enjoys exceedingly splendid pleasures. 32

16.270.s:
ūrṇāprāvaraṇaṃ yo'pi bhaktyā dadyāddvijottame ..
so'pi yāti parāṃ siddhiṃ martyairanyaiḥ sudurlabhām .. 33 ..
16.270.d:
ऊर्णाप्रावरणं योऽपि भक्त्या दद्याद्द्विजोत्तमे ..
सोऽपि याति परां सिद्धिं मर्त्यैरन्यैः सुदुर्लभाम् .. 33 ..
16.270.m: Whoever also gives a woollen garment to an eminent twice-born with devotion, / he too attains supreme perfection, extremely hard to attain by other mortals. 33

16.270.s:
ye cātra malanāśāya viśeyurmānavā jalam ..
gopradānaphalaṃ teṣāṃ sukhena phalamādiśet .. 34 ..
16.270.d:
ये चात्र मलनाशाय विशेयुर्मानवा जलम् ..
गोप्रदानफलं तेषां सुखेन फलमादिशेत् .. 34 ..
16.270.m: And those mortals who enter the water here for the destruction of impurities— / one may readily assign to them the fruit of giving a cow. 34

16.270.s:
bhāvena hi naraḥ kaścittatra snānaṃ samācaret ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate .. 35 ..
16.270.d:
भावेन हि नरः कश्चित्तत्र स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोके महीयते .. 35 ..
16.270.m: If any person performs an ablution there with devotion, / freed from all sins, he is glorified in the world of Viṣṇu.' 35

16.270.s:
tarpaṇātpiṃḍadānācca narakeṣvapi saṃsthitāḥ ..
svargaṃ prayāṃti pitaraḥ suputreṇeha tāritāḥ .. 36 ..
16.270.d:
तर्पणात्पिंडदानाच्च नरकेष्वपि संस्थिताः ..
स्वर्गं प्रयांति पितरः सुपुत्रेणेह तारिताः .. 36 ..
16.270.m: From libation and offering the funeral cake, even those dwelling in hells, / the ancestors, carried across by a good son here, go to heaven.

16.270.s:
te labhaṃte'kṣayāṃllokā nbrahmaviṣṇvīśaśabditān ..
bhūyastvannaṃ prayacchanti mokṣamārgaṃ labhaṃti te .. 37 ..
16.270.d:
ते लभंतेऽक्षयांल्लोका न्ब्रह्मविष्ण्वीशशब्दितान् ..
भूयस्त्वन्नं प्रयच्छन्ति मोक्षमार्गं लभंति ते .. 37 ..
16.270.m: They attain imperishable worlds named after Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Īśa; / moreover, they grant food [to their descendants], and they attain the path to liberation.

16.270.s:
svarganiśreṇisaṃbhūtā prabhāse tu sarasvatī ..
nāpuṇyavadbhiḥ saṃprāptuṃ puṃbhiḥ śakyā mahānadī .. 38 ..
16.270.d:
स्वर्गनिश्रेणिसंभूता प्रभासे तु सरस्वती ..
नापुण्यवद्भिः संप्राप्तुं पुंभिः शक्या महानदी .. 38 ..
16.270.m: The Sarasvatī, arising as a ladder to heaven in Prabhāsa, / this great river, cannot be attained by men devoid of merit.

16.270.s:
prācī sarasvatī caiva anyatraiva tu durlabhā ..
viśeṣeṇa kurukṣetre prabhāse puṣkare tathā .. 39 ..
16.270.d:
प्राची सरस्वती चैव अन्यत्रैव तु दुर्लभा ..
विशेषेण कुरुक्षेत्रे प्रभासे पुष्करे तथा .. 39 ..
16.270.m: Indeed, an eastward-flowing Sarasvatī is rare elsewhere, / [found] especially in Kurukṣetra, Prabhāsa, and likewise Puṣkara.

16.270.s:
prācīṃ sarasvatīṃ prāpya yonyattīrthaṃ hi mārgate ..
sa karasthaṃ samutsṛjya kūrpareṇa samācaret .. 7.1.270.40 ..
16.270.d:
प्राचीं सरस्वतीं प्राप्य योन्यत्तीर्थं हि मार्गते ..
स करस्थं समुत्सृज्य कूर्परेण समाचरेत् .. 7.1.270.40 ..
16.270.m: Whoever, having reached the eastward-flowing Sarasvatī, seeks another sacred ford, / casts away what is held in the hand and tries to act with the elbow.

16.270.s:
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ snānaṃ ca vihitaṃ sadā ..
piṇyākeṃgudakenāpi piṃḍaṃ tatra dadāti yaḥ ..
pitṝṇāmakṣayaṃ bhūyātpitṛlokaṃ sa gacchati .. 41 ..
16.270.d:
कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां स्नानं च विहितं सदा ..
पिण्याकेंगुदकेनापि पिंडं तत्र ददाति यः ..
पितॄणामक्षयं भूयात्पितृलोकं स गच्छति .. 41 ..
16.270.m: A ritual ablution on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight is always prescribed there; / whoever offers a funeral cake there, even with oil-cake or inguda-oil, / for him it will be inexhaustible for the ancestors, and he goes to the world of the ancestors.

16.270.s:
sarasvatīvāsasamā kuto ratiḥ sarasvatīvāsasamāḥ kuto guṇāḥ ..
sarasvatīṃ prāpya gatā divaṃ narāḥ punaḥ smariṣyaṃti nadīṃ sarasvatīm .. 42 ..
16.270.d:
सरस्वतीवाससमा कुतो रतिः सरस्वतीवाससमाः कुतो गुणाः ..
सरस्वतीं प्राप्य गता दिवं नराः पुनः स्मरिष्यंति नदीं सरस्वतीम् .. 42 ..
16.270.m: Whence is there delight equal to dwelling by the Sarasvatī? Whence virtues equal to dwelling by the Sarasvatī? / Having reached the Sarasvatī, men who have gone to heaven will remember the river Sarasvatī again.

16.270.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
uktvaivaṃ bhagavāndevastatraivāṃtaradhīyata ..
sāṃnidhyamakarottatra tataḥprabhṛti śaṃkaraḥ .. 43 ..
16.270.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
उक्त्वैवं भगवान्देवस्तत्रैवांतरधीयत ..
सांनिध्यमकरोत्तत्र ततःप्रभृति शंकरः .. 43 ..
16.270.m: Īśvara said: / Having spoken thus, the blessed god vanished right there; / from that time forward, Śaṃkara took up his presence there.

16.270.s:
atra gāthā purā gītā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ..
snehārdreṇa ca cittena dharmaputraṃ prati priye .. 44 ..
16.270.d:
अत्र गाथा पुरा गीता विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ..
स्नेहार्द्रेण च चित्तेन धर्मपुत्रं प्रति प्रिये .. 44 ..
16.270.m: In this regard, a song was formerly sung by all-powerful Viṣṇu, / with a heart wet with affection, addressed to the son of Dharma, O dear one:

16.270.s:
mā gaṃgāṃ vraja kauṃteya mā prayāgaṃ ca puṣkaram ..
tatra gaccha kuruśreṣṭha yatra prācī sarasvatī .. 45 ..
16.270.d:
मा गंगां व्रज कौंतेय मा प्रयागं च पुष्करम् ..
तत्र गच्छ कुरुश्रेष्ठ यत्र प्राची सरस्वती .. 45 ..
16.270.m: “Do not go to the Gaṅgā, O son of Kuntī; do not go to Prayāga and Puṣkara; / go there, O best of the Kurus, where the Sarasvatī flows eastward.”

16.270.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ..
māhātmyaṃ ca sarasvatyā bhūyaḥ kiṃ śrotumicchasi .. 46 ..
16.270.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ..
माहात्म्यं च सरस्वत्या भूयः किं श्रोतुमिच्छसि .. 46 ..
16.270.m: All this has been told to you, which you asked of me, / as well as the māhātmya of Sarasvatī; what more do you wish to hear?

16.270.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye prācīsarasvatīmaṃkīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 270 ..
16.270.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये प्राचीसरस्वतीमंकीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 270 ..
