16.270.m: Thus ends the two hundred and seventieth chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Prācīsarasvatī and Maṅkīśvara,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandapurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

16.271.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasyaiva saṃnikṛṣṭe tu liṃgaṃ jvāleśvaraṃ smṛtam ..
śaraḥ pāśupato yatra jvalanvai tripurāriṇā .. 1 ..
16.271.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्यैव संनिकृष्टे तु लिंगं ज्वालेश्वरं स्मृतम् ..
शरः पाशुपतो यत्र ज्वलन्वै त्रिपुरारिणा .. 1 ..
16.271.m: Īśvara said: / Close to that very place is known the liṅga Jvāleśvara, / where the blazing Pāśupata arrow [was discharged] by the foe of Tripura.

16.271.s:
pātito yatpradeśe tu tena jvāleśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 2 ..
16.271.d:
पातितो यत्प्रदेशे तु तेन ज्वालेश्वरः स्मृतः ..
तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो देवि मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 2 ..
16.271.m: In the region where it was brought down, it is therefore known as Jvāleśvara; / having seen it, O goddess, a mortal is freed from all sins.

16.271.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśātisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye jvāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikasaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 271 ..
16.271.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशातिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये ज्वालेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकसप्तत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 271 ..
16.271.m: Thus ends the two hundred and seventy-first chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Jvāleśvara,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandapurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

16.272.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyetprācī devyāstu saṃnidhau..
liṃgatrayaṃ samākhyātaṃ tripurāṇāṃ mahātmanām ..1..
16.272.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तत्रैव संस्थितं पश्येत्प्राची देव्यास्तु संनिधौ..
लिंगत्रयं समाख्यातं त्रिपुराणां महात्मनाम् ..1..
16.272.m: Īśvara said: / One should see, stationed right there in the vicinity of the goddess Prācī, / a triad of liṅgas described as belonging to the high-souled Tripuras:

16.272.s:
vidyunmālī tārakākhyaḥ kapolākhyastathaiva ca ..
taiśca pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate ..2 ..
16.272.d:
विद्युन्माली तारकाख्यः कपोलाख्यस्तथैव च ..
तैश्च प्रतिष्ठितं लिंगं दृष्ट्वा पापैः प्रमुच्यते ..2 ..
16.272.m: Vidyunmālin, the one named Tāraka, and likewise the one named Kapola; / having seen the liṅga[s] established by them, one is released from sins.

16.272.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye tripuraliṃgatrayamāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma dvisaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..272..
16.272.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये त्रिपुरलिंगत्रयमाहात्म्य वर्णनंनाम द्विसप्तत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..272..
16.272.m: Thus ends the two hundred and seventy-second chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of the Triad of Tripura Liṅgas,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandapurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

16.273.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi śaṃḍatīrthamanuttamam ..
sarvapāpopaśamanaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam .. 1 ..
16.273.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि शंडतीर्थमनुत्तमम् ..
सर्वपापोपशमनं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् .. 1 ..
16.273.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the unexcelled Śaṇḍatīrtha, / which calms all sins and grants the fruit of all desires.

16.273.s:
tasyotpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ priye ..
purā paṃcaśirā āsīdbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ .. 2 ..
16.273.d:
तस्योत्पत्तिं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमनाः प्रिये ..
पुरा पंचशिरा आसीद्ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः .. 2 ..
16.273.m: I shall declare its origin; listen with single-minded focus, O dear one. / Formerly, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, was five-headed.

16.273.s:
śirastasya mayā chinnaṃ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāṃtare ..
tatra gaṃdhavatī jātā brahmaṇaḥ sā ca śoṇitaiḥ .. 3 ..
16.273.d:
शिरस्तस्य मया छिन्नं कस्मिंश्चित्कारणांतरे ..
तत्र गंधवती जाता ब्रह्मणः सा च शोणितैः .. 3 ..
16.273.m: His head was cut off by me for a certain cause; / there the Gandhavatī arose, and that was from Brahmā's blood.

16.273.s:
tatrodgatā mahātālāstena tālavanaṃ smṛtam ..
atha karatale lagnaṃ kapālaṃ brahmaṇo mama .. 4 ..
16.273.d:
तत्रोद्गता महातालास्तेन तालवनं स्मृतम् ..
अथ करतले लग्नं कपालं ब्रह्मणो मम .. 4 ..
16.273.m: There great palm trees grew up; therefore it is known as Tālavana; / then the skull of Brahmā clung to the palm of my hand.

16.273.s:
śarīraṃ kṛṣṇatāṃ yātaṃ mama caiva vṛṣasya ca ..
atha tīrthānyanekāni gatohaṃ pāpaśaṃkayā .. 5 ..
16.273.d:
शरीरं कृष्णतां यातं मम चैव वृषस्य च ..
अथ तीर्थान्यनेकानि गतोहं पापशंकया .. 5 ..
16.273.m: The body of mine and also of the bull became black; / then, in dread of the sin, I went to many sacred fords.

16.273.s:
na kvacidvrajate pāpaṃ tataḥ prabhāsamāgataḥ ..
kṣetre tatra mayā dṛṣṭā prācī devī sarasvatī .. 6 ..
16.273.d:
न क्वचिद्व्रजते पापं ततः प्रभासमागतः ..
क्षेत्रे तत्र मया दृष्टा प्राची देवी सरस्वती .. 6 ..
16.273.m: Nowhere did the sin depart; then I came to Prabhāsa; / there in the sacred field I saw the goddess Prācī Sarasvatī.

16.273.s:
tatra me vṛṣabhaḥ snātuṃ praviṣṭo jalamadhyataḥ ..
tatkṣaṇācchvetatā prāpto muktohamapi hatyayā .. 7 ..
16.273.d:
तत्र मे वृषभः स्नातुं प्रविष्टो जलमध्यतः ..
तत्क्षणाच्छ्वेतता प्राप्तो मुक्तोहमपि हत्यया .. 7 ..
16.273.m: There my bull entered the middle of the water to bathe; / at that moment he attained whiteness, and I too was freed from the killing [of the brahmin].

16.273.s:
karamadhye ca me lagnaṃ kapālaṃ patitaṃ tadā ..
kapālamocanaścāsau liṃgarūpī sthito'bhavat .. 8 ..
16.273.d:
करमध्ये च मे लग्नं कपालं पतितं तदा ..
कपालमोचनश्चासौ लिंगरूपी स्थितोऽभवत् .. 8 ..
16.273.m: And the skull clinging to the middle of my hand then fell off; / and it, as Kapālamocana, remained in the form of a liṅga.

16.273.s:
tatrāpi yo dadecchrāddhaṃ prācīdevyāstu saṃnidhau ..
mātṛkaṃ paitṛkaṃ caiva tṛptaṃ kulaśataṃ tathā .. 9 ..
16.273.d:
तत्रापि यो ददेच्छ्राद्धं प्राचीदेव्यास्तु संनिधौ ..
मातृकं पैतृकं चैव तृप्तं कुलशतं तथा .. 9 ..
16.273.m: Whoever performs a śrāddha there too, in the presence of the goddess Prācī, / on the mother's and the father's side, a hundred generations are gratified,

16.273.s:
bhavecca tasya tṛptistu yāvatkalpāstu saptatiḥ ..
māsa āśvayuje devi kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī ..
tatra dadyāttu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtimāśritaḥ .. 7.1.273.10 ..
16.273.d:
भवेच्च तस्य तृप्तिस्तु यावत्कल्पास्तु सप्ततिः ..
मास आश्वयुजे देवि कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशी ..
तत्र दद्यात्तु यः श्राद्धं दक्षिणामूर्तिमाश्रितः .. 7.1.273.10 ..
16.273.m: and their gratification shall last for as long as seventy kalpas. / In the month of Āśvayuja, O goddess, on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, / whoever gives a śrāddha there, having taken refuge in Dakṣiṇāmūrti,

16.273.s:
yathāvittopacāreṇa supātre ca yathāvidhi ..
yāvadyugasahasraṃ tu tṛptāḥ syuste pitāmahāḥ .. 11 ..
16.273.d:
यथावित्तोपचारेण सुपात्रे च यथाविधि ..
यावद्युगसहस्रं तु तृप्ताः स्युस्ते पितामहाः .. 11 ..
16.273.m: according to one's wealth and ritual accessories, to a worthy recipient according to the rule, / for as long as a thousand yugas his ancestors shall be gratified.

16.273.s:
annasuvarṇadānaṃ ca dadhikaṃbalameva ca ..
tatra deyaṃ vidhānena sarvapāpopaśuddhaye .. 12 ..
16.273.d:
अन्नसुवर्णदानं च दधिकंबलमेव च ..
तत्र देयं विधानेन सर्वपापोपशुद्धये .. 12 ..
16.273.m: A gift of food and gold, and curd and a blanket, / is to be given there according to the rule for the purification of all sins.

16.273.s:
kṛṣṇarūpī vṛṣo devi yadā śvetatvamāgataḥ ..
śaṃḍatīrthamitikhyātaṃ tena trailokyapūjitam .. 13 ..
16.273.d:
कृष्णरूपी वृषो देवि यदा श्वेतत्वमागतः ..
शंडतीर्थमितिख्यातं तेन त्रैलोक्यपूजितम् .. 13 ..
16.273.m: When the bull of black form attained whiteness, O goddess, / it was therefore renowned as Śaṇḍatīrtha, worshipped in the three worlds.

16.273.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śaṃḍatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trisaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 273 .. .. cha ..
16.273.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शंडतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिसप्तत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 273 .. .. छ ..
16.273.m: Thus ends the two hundred and seventy-third chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Śaṇḍatīrtha,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandapurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

16.274.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi sūryaprācīṃ mahāprabhām ..
sarvapāpopaśamanīṃ sarvakāmaphalapradām .. 1 ..
16.274.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि सूर्यप्राचीं महाप्रभाम् ..
सर्वपापोपशमनीं सर्वकामफलप्रदाम् .. 1 ..
16.274.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the glorious Sūryaprācī, / which calms all sins and grants the fruit of all desires.
Having bathed there, O great goddess, one is released from the five great sins.

16.274.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sūryaprācīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥsapta tyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 274 ..
16.274.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सूर्यप्राचीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुःसप्त त्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 274 ..
16.274.m: Thus ends the two hundred and seventy-fourth chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Sūryaprācī,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skandapurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

16.275.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ caiva trilocanam ..
ṛṣitīrthasamīpe tu sarvapātakanāśanam ..
nyaṅkumatyuttare kūla ṛṣibhiḥ pūjitaṃ purā .. 1 ..
16.275.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवं चैव त्रिलोचनम् ..
ऋषितीर्थसमीपे तु सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
न्यङ्कुमत्युत्तरे कूल ऋषिभिः पूजितं पुरा .. 1 ..
16.275.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the three-eyed god, / near Ṛṣitīrtha, the destroyer of all sins, / on the northern bank of the Nyaṅkumatī, worshipped by the seers of old,

16.275.s:
trinetrā matsyakā yatra jalaṃ sphaṭikasannibham ..
tatra snātvā naro devi mucyate brahmahatyayā .. 2 ..
16.275.d:
त्रिनेत्रा मत्स्यका यत्र जलं स्फटिकसन्निभम् ..
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो देवि मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया .. 2 ..
16.275.m: where the small fish are three-eyed and the water resembles crystal; / having bathed there, O mortal, a person is freed from the murder of a brahmin.

16.275.s:
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturddaśyāṃ māse bhādrapade tathā ..
upavāsaṃ tu kurvīta rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tathā .. 3 ..
16.275.d:
कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्द्दश्यां मासे भाद्रपदे तथा ..
उपवासं तु कुर्वीत रात्रौ जागरणं तथा .. 3 ..
16.275.m: And on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight in the month of Bhādrapada, / one should observe a fast and keep a vigil through the night.

16.275.s:
prātaḥ śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta vidhivatpūjayecchivam ..
rudraloke vaseddevi varṣāṇāmayutatrayam .. 4 ..
16.275.d:
प्रातः श्राद्धं प्रकुर्वीत विधिवत्पूजयेच्छिवम् ..
रुद्रलोके वसेद्देवि वर्षाणामयुतत्रयम् .. 4 ..
16.275.m: In the morning, one should perform a śrāddha and properly worship Śiva; / O goddess, one shall dwell in the realm of Rudra for thirty thousand years.

16.275.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye trinetreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcasaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ.. 275 ..
16.275.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये त्रिनेत्रेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चसप्तत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः.. 275 ..
16.275.m: Thus ends the two hundred seventy-fifth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Trinetreśvara,' in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.276.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi ṛṣitīrthasya sannidhau ..
kāmikaṃ hi paraṃ kṣetraṃ devikānāma nāmataḥ .. 1 ..
16.276.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि ऋषितीर्थस्य सन्निधौ ..
कामिकं हि परं क्षेत्रं देविकानाम नामतः .. 1 ..
16.276.m: The Lord said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go near the Ṛṣitīrtha; / for there is an excellent field granting desires, known by the name Devikā.
There is a forest of great accomplishments, frequented by seers and perfected beings, / filled with various trees and creepers, and adorned with mountains,

16.276.s:
caṃpakairbakulairdivyairaśokaiḥ stabakaiḥ paraiḥ ..
punnāgaiḥ kiṃkirātaiśca sugandhairnāgakesaraiḥ .. 3 ..
16.276.d:
चंपकैर्बकुलैर्दिव्यैरशोकैः स्तबकैः परैः ..
पुन्नागैः किंकिरातैश्च सुगन्धैर्नागकेसरैः .. 3 ..
16.276.m: beautified with campakas, divine bakulas, and splendid clusters of aśokas, / with punnāgas, kiṃkirātas, and fragrant nāgakesaras,
with mallikā and utpala flowers, pāṭalās and pārijātakas, / with mango, campaka, kapittha, bilva, and panasa trees,

16.276.s:
kharjūrairbadaraiścānyairmātuliṃgaiḥ sadāḍimaiḥ ..
jaṃbīraiścaiva divyaiśca nāraṃgairupa śobhitam.. 5 ..
16.276.d:
खर्जूरैर्बदरैश्चान्यैर्मातुलिंगैः सदाडिमैः ..
जंबीरैश्चैव दिव्यैश्च नारंगैरुप शोभितम्.. 5 ..
16.276.m: with date palms, jujubes, others such as citrons accompanied by pomegranates, / and adorned with heavenly jambīras and oranges;

16.276.s:
śikhibhiḥ kokilābhiśca gīyamānaṃ tu ṣaṭpadaiḥ ..
mṛgairṛkṣairvarāhaiśca siṃhairvyāghraistathā paraiḥ .. 6 ..
16.276.d:
शिखिभिः कोकिलाभिश्च गीयमानं तु षट्पदैः ..
मृगैरृक्षैर्वराहैश्च सिंहैर्व्याघ्रैस्तथा परैः .. 6 ..
16.276.m: resounded with songs of peacocks and cuckoos, and humming of bees; / with deer, bears, wild boars, lions, tigers, and others,
with beasts of prey of diverse shapes, with caves and chasms; / with hosts of gods and asuras, siddhas, yakṣas, gandharvas, and pannagas;

16.276.s:
apsaroraganāgaiśca bahubhistu samākulam ..
kecitstuvaṃti īśaṃ tu kecinnṛtyaṃti cāgrataḥ .. 8 ..
16.276.d:
अप्सरोरगनागैश्च बहुभिस्तु समाकुलम् ..
केचित्स्तुवंति ईशं तु केचिन्नृत्यंति चाग्रतः .. 8 ..
16.276.m: and crowded with many apsarases, uragas, and nāgas. / Some praise the Lord, while others dance before Him;

16.276.s:
puṣpairvṛṣṭiṃ tu muñcaṃti mukhavādyāni cāpare ..
hasaṃti cāpare hṛṣṭā garjaṃti ca tathāpare .. 9 ..
16.276.d:
पुष्पैर्वृष्टिं तु मुञ्चंति मुखवाद्यानि चापरे ..
हसंति चापरे हृष्टा गर्जंति च तथापरे .. 9 ..
16.276.m: some pour down showers of flowers, others play mouth-instruments; / others laugh in delight, and others roar;

16.276.s:
ūrddhvabāhavastathā cānye anye dhyāyaṃti tadgatāḥ ..
tasminsthānaṃ mahādevi devikāyāstaṭe śubhe .. 7.1.276.10 ..
16.276.d:
ऊर्द्ध्वबाहवस्तथा चान्ये अन्ये ध्यायंति तद्गताः ..
तस्मिन्स्थानं महादेवि देविकायास्तटे शुभे .. 7.1.276.10 ..
16.276.m: others raise their arms aloft, and others meditate with minds fixed on Him. / At that sacred place, O great goddess, on the auspicious bank of the Devikā,

16.276.s:
umāpatīśvaro nāma tatrāhaṃ saṃsthitaḥ sadā ..
yugeyuge sadā pūrṇe kalpe manvantare tathā .. 11 ..
16.276.d:
उमापतीश्वरो नाम तत्राहं संस्थितः सदा ..
युगेयुगे सदा पूर्णे कल्पे मन्वन्तरे तथा .. 11 ..
16.276.m: named Umāpatīśvara, I abide there eternally, / through every complete yuga, kalpa, and manvantara.

16.276.s:
na tyajāmi sadā devi devikāyāstaṭaṃ śubham ..
durllabhaṃ sarvaloke'sminpavitraṃ supriyaṃ hi me .. 12 ..
16.276.d:
न त्यजामि सदा देवि देविकायास्तटं शुभम् ..
दुर्ल्लभं सर्वलोकेऽस्मिन्पवित्रं सुप्रियं हि मे .. 12 ..
16.276.m: O goddess, I never abandon the auspicious bank of the Devikā; / it is hard to attain in all this world, sacred, and exceedingly dear to me.

16.276.s:
tvayā saha sthitaścāhaṃ tasmi nsthāne varānane ..
umayā yuktadehatvāttena khyātaṃ umāpatiḥ .. 13 ..
16.276.d:
त्वया सह स्थितश्चाहं तस्मि न्स्थाने वरानने ..
उमया युक्तदेहत्वात्तेन ख्यातं उमापतिः .. 13 ..
16.276.m: O fair-faced one, I dwell in that place along with you; / because my body is joined with Umā, it is renowned as Umāpati.

16.276.s:
puṣyamāse tvamāvasyāṃ dadyācchrāddhaṃ samāhitaḥ ..
na paśyāmi kṣayaṃ tasya tasmindattasya pārvati .. 14 ..
16.276.d:
पुष्यमासे त्वमावस्यां दद्याच्छ्राद्धं समाहितः ..
न पश्यामि क्षयं तस्य तस्मिन्दत्तस्य पार्वति .. 14 ..
16.276.m: One who with concentrated mind offers a śrāddha on the new moon day in the month of Puṣya, / O Pārvatī, I see no end to what is offered there.

16.276.s:
brahmahatyāsahasraṃ tu tasya darśanato vrajet ..
gobhūhiraṇyavāsāṃsi tatra dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ .. 15 ..
16.276.d:
ब्रह्महत्यासहस्रं तु तस्य दर्शनतो व्रजेत् ..
गोभूहिरण्यवासांसि तत्र दद्याद्विचक्षणः .. 15 ..
16.276.m: A thousand sins of killing a brahmin perish merely upon seeing it; / a wise man should give there cows, land, gold, and garments.

16.276.s:
sa ekaḥ paramaḥ putro yo gatvā tatra sundari ..
dadecchrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca tasyāṃto naiva vidyate .. 16 ..
16.276.d:
स एकः परमः पुत्रो यो गत्वा तत्र सुन्दरि ..
ददेच्छ्राद्धं पितॄणां च तस्यांतो नैव विद्यते .. 16 ..
16.276.m: He alone is the supreme son who, having gone there, O beautiful lady, / offers a śrāddha to the ancestors; there is no end [to its fruit].

16.276.s:
devaiḥ sarvaiḥ samāhūtā snānārthaṃ sā saridvarā ..
deviketi samākhyātā tena sā pāpanāśinī .. 17 ..
16.276.d:
देवैः सर्वैः समाहूता स्नानार्थं सा सरिद्वरा ..
देविकेति समाख्याता तेन सा पापनाशिनी .. 17 ..
16.276.m: That best of rivers was summoned by all the gods for bathing; / therefore she is known as Devikā, the destroyer of sins.

16.276.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye devikāyāmumāpatimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭsaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 276 ..
16.276.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये देविकायामुमापतिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्सप्तत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 276 ..
16.276.m: Thus ends the two hundred seventy-sixth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Umāpati on the Devikā,' in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.277.s:
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyedbhūdharaṃnāma nāmataḥ ..
uddhṛtya pṛthivīṃ yasmāddaṃṣṭrāgreṇa dadhāra saḥ .. 1 ..
16.277.d:
तत्रैव संस्थितं पश्येद्भूधरंनाम नामतः ..
उद्धृत्य पृथिवीं यस्माद्दंष्ट्राग्रेण दधार सः .. 1 ..
16.277.m: Right there one should behold the one known by name as Bhūdhara, / for He lifted up the earth and bore it upon the tip of His tusk.

16.277.s:
bhūdharastena cākhyāto devikātaṭasaṃsthitaḥ ..
vedapādo yūpadaṃṣṭraḥ kratudantaḥ srucīmukhaḥ .. 2 ..
16.277.d:
भूधरस्तेन चाख्यातो देविकातटसंस्थितः ..
वेदपादो यूपदंष्ट्रः क्रतुदन्तः स्रुचीमुखः .. 2 ..
16.277.m: Therefore, He who is stationed on the bank of the Devikā is known as Bhūdhara: / having the Vedas as His legs, the sacrificial post as His tusk, the sacrifices as His teeth, and the ladle as His mouth;

16.277.s:
agnijihvo darbharomā brahmaśīrṣo mahātapāḥ ..
ahorātrekṣaṇaparo vedāṃgaśrutibhūṣaṇaḥ .. 3 ..
16.277.d:
अग्निजिह्वो दर्भरोमा ब्रह्मशीर्षो महातपाः ..
अहोरात्रेक्षणपरो वेदांगश्रुतिभूषणः .. 3 ..
16.277.m: having the sacrificial fire as His tongue, darbha-grass as His hair, Brahmā as His head, possessing great tapas, / having day and night as His eyes, and adorned with the Vedāṅgas as His ears;

16.277.s:
ādyanāsaḥ sruvatuṃḍaḥ sāmaghoṣasvano mahān ..
prāgvaṃśakāyo dyutimā nnānādīkṣāvirājitaḥ .. 4 ..
16.277.d:
आद्यनासः स्रुवतुंडः सामघोषस्वनो महान् ..
प्राग्वंशकायो द्युतिमा न्नानादीक्षाविराजितः .. 4 ..
16.277.m: having the primeval ladle as His nose, the offering-spoon as His snout, the roar of the Sāmaveda as His great voice, / His body the Prāgvaṃśa hall, radiant, adorned with various consecrations;

16.277.s:
dakṣiṇāhṛdayo yogī mahāsatraśayo mahān ..
upākarmoṣṭharucakaḥ pravargyāvartabhūṣaṇaḥ .. 5 ..
16.277.d:
दक्षिणाहृदयो योगी महासत्रशयो महान् ..
उपाकर्मोष्ठरुचकः प्रवर्ग्यावर्तभूषणः .. 5 ..
16.277.m: having the sacrificial fee as His heart, a yogin, reposing in the great Soma sacrifice, the Great One, / having the upākarman ceremony as the beauty of His lip, adorned with the whirlpool of the pravargya rite;

16.277.s:
nānācchandogatipatho brahmoktakramavikramaḥ ..
bhūtvā yajñavarāho'sau tatra sthāne sthito'bhavat .. 6 ..
16.277.d:
नानाच्छन्दोगतिपथो ब्रह्मोक्तक्रमविक्रमः ..
भूत्वा यज्ञवराहोऽसौ तत्र स्थाने स्थितोऽभवत् .. 6 ..
16.277.m: having the diverse Vedic metres as His path of motion, and His strides defined by the order spoken by Brahmā; / having assumed the form of the Sacrificial Boar, He remained stationed in that place.

16.277.s:
puṣyamāse hyamāvāsyāmekādaśyāmathāpi vā ..
prāpte prāvṛṣi kāle ca jñātvā kanyāgataṃ ravim .. 7 ..
16.277.d:
पुष्यमासे ह्यमावास्यामेकादश्यामथापि वा ..
प्राप्ते प्रावृषि काले च ज्ञात्वा कन्यागतं रविम् .. 7 ..
16.277.m: On the new moon day or the eleventh lunar day in the month of Puṣya, / or when the rainy season arrives, knowing the sun to have entered Virgo,

16.277.s:
pāyasaṃ guḍasaṃyuktaṃ haviṣyaṃ ca guḍaplutam ..
namo vaḥ pitaro rasāya annādyamabhimaṃtrayet .. 8 ..
16.277.d:
पायसं गुडसंयुक्तं हविष्यं च गुडप्लुतम् ..
नमो वः पितरो रसाय अन्नाद्यमभिमंत्रयेत् .. 8 ..
16.277.m: one should consecrate the food and other items—milk-rice mixed with jaggery, and sacrificial food soaked in jaggery— / with the mantra: 'Homage to you, O ancestors, for the essence!'

16.277.s:
tejo'siśukramityājyaṃ dadhikrāvṇena vai dadhi ..
kṣīramājyāya mantreṇa vyañjanāni ca yāni tu .. 9 ..
16.277.d:
तेजोऽसिशुक्रमित्याज्यं दधिक्राव्णेन वै दधि ..
क्षीरमाज्याय मन्त्रेण व्यञ्जनानि च यानि तु .. 9 ..
16.277.m: He should consecrate the clarified butter with 'You are splendor, the seed,' the curds indeed with the Dadhikrāvan verse, / the milk with the mantra for ghee, and whatever cooked vegetables,

16.277.s:
bhakṣyabhojyāni sarvāṇi mahānindreṇa dāpayet ..
saṃvatsa roniyo maṃtraṃ japtvā tenodakaṃ dvijaḥ .. 7.1.277.10 ..
16.277.d:
भक्ष्यभोज्यानि सर्वाणि महानिन्द्रेण दापयेत् ..
संवत्स रोनियो मंत्रं जप्त्वा तेनोदकं द्विजः .. 7.1.277.10 ..
16.277.m: and offer all chewable and edible foods with the verse to great Indra; / and the twice-born should offer water reciting the mantra 'Saṃvatsara-...'

16.277.s:
evaṃ saṃbhojya vai viprānpiṇḍadānaṃ tu dāpayet ..
ityanena vidhānena yastatra śrāddhakṛdbhavet ..11..
16.277.d:
एवं संभोज्य वै विप्रान्पिण्डदानं तु दापयेत् ..
इत्यनेन विधानेन यस्तत्र श्राद्धकृद्भवेत् ..11..
16.277.m: Having thus fed the brahmins, he should offer the piṇḍa offerings. / Whoever performs a śrāddha there according to this rite,

16.277.s:
tasya tṛptāstu pitaro yāvadiṃdrāścaturddaśa ..
gayāśrāddhaṃ vināpīha gayāśrāddhaphalaṃ labhet..12..
16.277.d:
तस्य तृप्तास्तु पितरो यावदिंद्राश्चतुर्द्दश ..
गयाश्राद्धं विनापीह गयाश्राद्धफलं लभेत्..12..
16.277.m: his ancestors remain satisfied for the duration of fourteen Indras; / even without a śrāddha at Gayā, he obtains here the fruit of a Gayā-śrāddha.

16.277.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye devikāmāhātmye bhūdharayajñavarāhamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptasaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..277..
16.277.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये देविकामाहात्म्ये भूधरयज्ञवराहमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तसप्तत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..277..
16.277.m: Thus ends the two hundred seventy-seventh chapter, titled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Bhūdhara-Yajñavarāha in the Devikāmāhātmya,' in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.278.s:
..īśvara uvāca....
tato gacchenmahādevi śūlasthānamiti śrutam..
devikāyāstaṭe ramye bhāskaraṃ vāritaskaram .. 1 ..
16.278.d:
..ईश्वर उवाच....
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि शूलस्थानमिति श्रुतम्..
देविकायास्तटे रम्ये भास्करं वारितस्करम् .. 1 ..
16.278.m: The Lord said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the renowned place called Śūlasthāna, / to the Sun who repels thieves, on the charming bank of the Devikā,

16.278.s:
yatrātapattapo ghoraṃ vālmīkirmunipuṃgavaḥ ..
vālmīkināmā viprarṣiryatra siddho mahāmuniḥ .. 2 ..
16.278.d:
यत्रातपत्तपो घोरं वाल्मीकिर्मुनिपुंगवः ..
वाल्मीकिनामा विप्रर्षिर्यत्र सिद्धो महामुनिः .. 2 ..
16.278.m: where Vālmīki, the best of sages, practiced fierce austerity, / where the great sage, the brahmin-seer named Vālmīki, attained perfection,

16.278.s:
yatra saptarṣayo muṣṭāstenaiva muninā priye ..
tasyaiva paścime bhāge marīcipramukhā dvijāḥ .. 3 ..
16.278.d:
यत्र सप्तर्षयो मुष्टास्तेनैव मुनिना प्रिये ..
तस्यैव पश्चिमे भागे मरीचिप्रमुखा द्विजाः .. 3 ..
16.278.m: where the Seven Seers, the twice-born headed by Marīci, / were robbed by that very sage on its western side, O beloved.

16.278.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kathaṃ tu siddho vālmīkiḥ kathaṃ caurye'karonmanaḥ ..
kathaṃ saptarṣayo muṣṭā etanme vada śaṃkara .. 4 ..
16.278.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
कथं तु सिद्धो वाल्मीकिः कथं चौर्येऽकरोन्मनः ..
कथं सप्तर्षयो मुष्टा एतन्मे वद शंकर .. 4 ..
16.278.m: The goddess said: / How did Vālmīki attain perfection? And why did he set his mind on robbery? / How were the Seven Seers robbed? Tell me this, O Śaṃkara.

16.278.s:
.. īśvara uvāca.. ..
āsītpūrvaṃ dvijo devi nāmnā khyātaḥ śamīmukhaḥ ..
gārhasthye vartamānasya tasya putro vyajāyata ..
vaiśākha iti nāmnā'sau raudrakarmā vyajāyata .. 5 ..
16.278.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच.. ..
आसीत्पूर्वं द्विजो देवि नाम्ना ख्यातः शमीमुखः ..
गार्हस्थ्ये वर्तमानस्य तस्य पुत्रो व्यजायत ..
वैशाख इति नाम्नाऽसौ रौद्रकर्मा व्यजायत .. 5 ..
16.278.m: The Lord said: / Formerly, O goddess, there was a brahmin renowned by the name Śamīmukha. / While he was leading the householder life, a son was born to him; / born with the name Vaiśākha, he became one of cruel deeds.

16.278.s:
muktvaikāṃ guruśuśrūṣāṃ nānyatkiṃcidasau dvijaḥ ..
akarocchobhanaṃ karma divāprabhṛti nityaśaḥ .. 6 ..
16.278.d:
मुक्त्वैकां गुरुशुश्रूषां नान्यत्किंचिदसौ द्विजः ..
अकरोच्छोभनं कर्म दिवाप्रभृति नित्यशः .. 6 ..
16.278.m: Except for service to his guru alone, that twice-born performed no other / auspicious action whatsoever, from morning onwards and constantly.

16.278.s:
atha kālena mahatā pitarau tasya tau priye ..
vārddhakyabhāvamāpannau bhartavyau tasya vihvalau .. 7 ..
16.278.d:
अथ कालेन महता पितरौ तस्य तौ प्रिये ..
वार्द्धक्यभावमापन्नौ भर्तव्यौ तस्य विह्वलौ .. 7 ..
16.278.m: Then, after a long time, my beloved, his two parents / reached old age, trembling and in need of support from him.

16.278.s:
sa nityaṃ padavīṃ gatvā muṣṭvā lokānsvaśaktitaḥ ..
dravyamādāya pitarau bhāryāṃ cāpi pupoṣa ca .. 8 ..
16.278.d:
स नित्यं पदवीं गत्वा मुष्ट्वा लोकान्स्वशक्तितः ..
द्रव्यमादाय पितरौ भार्यां चापि पुपोष च .. 8 ..
16.278.m: Going out daily to the road and robbing people according to his might, / he took their wealth and supported his parents and his wife as well.

16.278.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya tena mārgeṇa gacchataḥ ..
saptarṣīṃśca tadāpaśyattīrthayātrāparāyaṇān .. 9 ..
16.278.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य तेन मार्गेण गच्छतः ..
सप्तर्षींश्च तदापश्यत्तीर्थयात्रापरायणान् .. 9 ..
16.278.m: Then, at a certain time, as he was going along that road, / he saw the Seven Seers devoted to a pilgrimage to holy fords.

16.278.s:
tāndṛṣṭvā yaṣṭimudyamya bhartsayanpa ruṣākṣaraiḥ ..
vākyairuvāca tānsarvāṃstiṣṭhadhvamiti bhūriśaḥ .. 7.1.278.10 ..
16.278.d:
तान्दृष्ट्वा यष्टिमुद्यम्य भर्त्सयन्प रुषाक्षरैः ..
वाक्यैरुवाच तान्सर्वांस्तिष्ठध्वमिति भूरिशः .. 7.1.278.10 ..
16.278.m: Seeing them, he raised his staff, threatening them with harsh words, / and said to them all, repeatedly shouting, "Halt!"

16.278.s:
atha te munayaḥ śāṃtāḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāṃcanāḥ ..
samāḥ śatrau ca mitre ca roṣarāgavivarjitāḥ .. 11 ..
16.278.d:
अथ ते मुनयः शांताः समलोष्टाश्मकांचनाः ..
समाः शत्रौ च मित्रे च रोषरागविवर्जिताः .. 11 ..
16.278.m: Then those peaceful sages, to whom a clod of earth, a stone, and gold were alike, / who were equal toward enemy and friend, free from anger and passion,

16.278.s:
asmākaṃ darśanaṃ cāsya saṃbhāṣyamṛṣibhiḥ saha ..
saṃjātaṃ niṣphalaṃ mā syādityuvācāṃgirā vacaḥ .. 12 .. ..
16.278.d:
अस्माकं दर्शनं चास्य संभाष्यमृषिभिः सह ..
संजातं निष्फलं मा स्यादित्युवाचांगिरा वचः .. 12 .. ..
16.278.m: [spoke amongst themselves]. "Our sight and conversation with the seers / must not become fruitless for him," thus spoke the words of Aṅgiras:

16.278.s:
.. aṃgirā uvāca .. ..
bhobhostaskara me vākyaṃ śṛṇuṣvāvahitaḥ kṣaṇāt ..
ātmanastu hitārthāya satyaṃ caiva vadāmyaham ..
tava kaḥ poṣyavargo'sti tacca sarvaṃ vadasva me .. 13 ..
16.278.d:
.. अंगिरा उवाच .. ..
भोभोस्तस्कर मे वाक्यं शृणुष्वावहितः क्षणात् ..
आत्मनस्तु हितार्थाय सत्यं चैव वदाम्यहम् ..
तव कः पोष्यवर्गोऽस्ति तच्च सर्वं वदस्व मे .. 13 ..
16.278.m: Aṅgiras said: / "Listen to my words with an attentive mind for a moment, O thief. / For your own benefit, I am telling you the truth: / Who makes up your family of dependents? Tell me all of that."

16.278.s:
.. taskara uvāca .. ..
syātāṃ me pitarau vṛddhau bhāryaikā'patyavarjjitā ..
ekā dāsī hyahaṃ ṣaṣṭho nānyadastyadhikaṃ mune .. 14 ..
16.278.d:
.. तस्कर उवाच .. ..
स्यातां मे पितरौ वृद्धौ भार्यैकाऽपत्यवर्ज्जिता ..
एका दासी ह्यहं षष्ठो नान्यदस्त्यधिकं मुने .. 14 ..
16.278.m: The thief said: / "There are my aged parents, one wife without offspring, / one female servant, and myself as the sixth. There is no one else, O sage."

16.278.s:
.. aṃgirā uvāca .. ..
gatvā pṛcchasva tānsarvānpuṣṭānpāpārjitairdhanaiḥ..
ahaṃ karomi pāpāni sarve yūyaṃ tu bhakṣakāḥ ..15..
16.278.d:
.. अंगिरा उवाच .. ..
गत्वा पृच्छस्व तान्सर्वान्पुष्टान्पापार्जितैर्धनैः..
अहं करोमि पापानि सर्वे यूयं तु भक्षकाः ..15..
16.278.m: Aṅgiras said: / "Go and ask all of them who are nourished with wealth acquired through sin: / 'I commit sins, but you are all the consumers;

16.278.s:
tatpāpaṃ bhavitā kasya kathayaṃtviti me laghu ..
tathaiva gatvā papraccha pitarau tāvathocatuḥ ..16..
16.278.d:
तत्पापं भविता कस्य कथयंत्विति मे लघु ..
तथैव गत्वा पप्रच्छ पितरौ तावथोचतुः ..16..
16.278.m: whose sin will that be? Let them tell me quickly.'" / Having gone there just so, he questioned his parents. Then they said:

16.278.s:
.. mātāpitarāvūcatuḥ.. ..
ekaḥ pāpāni kurute phalaṃ bhuṃkte mahā janaḥ ..
bhoktāro vipramucyaṃte kartā doṣeṇa lipyate ..17..
16.278.d:
.. मातापितरावूचतुः.. ..
एकः पापानि कुरुते फलं भुंक्ते महा जनः ..
भोक्तारो विप्रमुच्यंते कर्ता दोषेण लिप्यते ..17..
16.278.m: The mother and father said: / "One person commits sins, but a great crowd enjoys the fruit. / The consumers are released; the agent is tainted by the fault.

16.278.s:
yaḥ karotyaśubhaṃ karma kuṭuṃbārthaṃ tu maṃdadhīḥ..
ātmā na vallabhastasya nūnaṃ puṃsaḥ supāpinaḥ .. 18 ..
16.278.d:
यः करोत्यशुभं कर्म कुटुंबार्थं तु मंदधीः..
आत्मा न वल्लभस्तस्य नूनं पुंसः सुपापिनः .. 18 ..
16.278.m: The dull-witted person who performs an inauspicious deed for the sake of his family / certainly does not hold his own self dear, being a great sinner."

16.278.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tayoḥ sa vacanaṃ śrutvā punarbhītamanāstadā ..
tayostu saṃnatiṃ kṛtvā pitarau punarabravīt.. 19 ..
16.278.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तयोः स वचनं श्रुत्वा पुनर्भीतमनास्तदा ..
तयोस्तु संनतिं कृत्वा पितरौ पुनरब्रवीत्.. 19 ..
16.278.m: Īśvara said: / Having heard their words, his mind was frightened again at that time. / Having bowed to them, he spoke once more to his parents:

16.278.s:
yuvābhyāṃ hitamevāhaṃ yatkaromyaśubhaṃ kvacit ..
tasyāṃśaṃ bhujyate kiṃcidyuvābhyāṃ vā na vocyatām ..7.1.278.20..
16.278.d:
युवाभ्यां हितमेवाहं यत्करोम्यशुभं क्वचित् ..
तस्यांशं भुज्यते किंचिद्युवाभ्यां वा न वोच्यताम् ..7.1.278.20..
16.278.m: "Whatever inauspicious deed I commit anywhere is only for the welfare of you both. / Is some portion of it enjoyed by you two, or not? Let it be told."

16.278.s:
.. pitarāvūcatuḥ .. ..
pūrve vayasi putra tvamāvābhyāṃ pālya eva hi ..
uttare tu vayaṃ pālyāḥ samyakputra tvayā punaḥ .. 21 ..
16.278.d:
.. पितरावूचतुः .. ..
पूर्वे वयसि पुत्र त्वमावाभ्यां पाल्य एव हि ..
उत्तरे तु वयं पाल्याः सम्यक्पुत्र त्वया पुनः .. 21 ..
16.278.m: The parents said: / "In earlier age, O son, you were indeed to be maintained by us; / but in the later age, we are again properly to be maintained by you, O son.

16.278.s:
itaretaradharmo'yaṃ nirdiṣṭaḥ padmayoninā ..
āvābhyāṃ yatkṛtaṃ karma yuṣmadarthaṃ śubhāśubham ..
bhokṣyāmo vayameveha tatsarvaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. .22 ..
16.278.d:
इतरेतरधर्मोऽयं निर्दिष्टः पद्मयोनिना ..
आवाभ्यां यत्कृतं कर्म युष्मदर्थं शुभाशुभम् ..
भोक्ष्यामो वयमेवेह तत्सर्वं नात्र संशयः .. .22 ..
16.278.m: This reciprocal duty has been ordained by the Lotus-born [Brahmā]. / Whatever auspicious or inauspicious deed was done by us for your sake, / all of that we alone shall experience here; there is no doubt of this.

16.278.s:
atha tvamapi yadvatsa prakaroṣi śubhāśubham ..
bhokṣyase sakalaṃ tadvatsvayaṃ nānyaḥ paratra ca ..23..
16.278.d:
अथ त्वमपि यद्वत्स प्रकरोषि शुभाशुभम् ..
भोक्ष्यसे सकलं तद्वत्स्वयं नान्यः परत्र च ..23..
16.278.m: So too, child, whatever auspicious or inauspicious deed you perform, / you yourself shall experience all of that in like manner in the next world, not anyone else.

16.278.s:
avaśyaṃ svayamaśnāti kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham.
tasmānnareṇa kartavyaṃ śubhaṃ karma vipaścitā .. 24 ..
16.278.d:
अवश्यं स्वयमश्नाति कृतं कर्म शुभाशुभम्.
तस्मान्नरेण कर्तव्यं शुभं कर्म विपश्चिता .. 24 ..
16.278.m: One inevitably experiences the auspicious or inauspicious deed done by oneself. / Therefore, an auspicious deed ought to be performed by a wise man.

16.278.s:
cauryaṃ vātha kṛṣiṃ vātha kusīdaṃ vātha putraka ..
vāṇijyamathavā preṣyaṃ kṛtvā'smākaṃ ca bhojanam ..
aharniśaṃ tvayā deyaṃ na doṣo'smāsu putraka .. 25 ..
16.278.d:
चौर्यं वाथ कृषिं वाथ कुसीदं वाथ पुत्रक ..
वाणिज्यमथवा प्रेष्यं कृत्वाऽस्माकं च भोजनम् ..
अहर्निशं त्वया देयं न दोषोऽस्मासु पुत्रक .. 25 ..
16.278.m: Whether by theft, by farming, by usury, O son, / or by trade, or by servant-work—having done it, food / must be given to us day and night by you. There is no fault in us, O child."

16.278.s:
tābhyāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tato bhāryāmabhāṣata .
tadeva vākyaṃ sā'vocadyatproktaṃ gurubhiḥ purā ..
tato vairāgyamāpanno vaiśākho munisattamaḥ .. 26 ..
16.278.d:
ताभ्यां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ततो भार्यामभाषत .
तदेव वाक्यं साऽवोचद्यत्प्रोक्तं गुरुभिः पुरा ..
ततो वैराग्यमापन्नो वैशाखो मुनिसत्तमः .. 26 ..
16.278.m: Having heard that statement from the two of them, he then spoke to his wife. / She spoke the very same words that had been said before by his parents. / Then Vaiśākha, the best of sages, fell into renunciation.

16.278.s:
garhayannevamātmānaṃ bhūyobhūyaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ ..
dhiṅmāṃ duṣkṛtakarmāṇaṃ pāpakarmarataṃ sadā .. 27 ..
16.278.d:
गर्हयन्नेवमात्मानं भूयोभूयः सुदुःखितः ..
धिङ्मां दुष्कृतकर्माणं पापकर्मरतं सदा .. 27 ..
16.278.m: Thus reproaching himself again and again, exceedingly distressed: / "Fie upon me, a doer of wicked deeds, constantly delighting in sinful action,

16.278.s:
vivekena parityaktaṃ satsaṃgena vivarjitam ..
yaḥ karoti naraḥ pāpaṃ na sevayati paṃḍitān ..
na cātmā vallabhastasya etanme vartate hṛdi .. 28 ..
16.278.d:
विवेकेन परित्यक्तं सत्संगेन विवर्जितम् ..
यः करोति नरः पापं न सेवयति पंडितान् ..
न चात्मा वल्लभस्तस्य एतन्मे वर्तते हृदि .. 28 ..
16.278.m: abandoned by discernment, bereft of good company! / The man who commits sin and does not serve the wise / does not love his own self; this remains firmly in my heart."

16.278.s:
evaṃ vikalpahṛdayo gatvā sa ṛṣisannidhau ..
uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā gamyatāmiti sādaram .. .. 29 ..
16.278.d:
एवं विकल्पहृदयो गत्वा स ऋषिसन्निधौ ..
उवाच श्लक्ष्णया वाचा गम्यतामिति सादरम् .. .. 29 ..
16.278.m: With his heart thus troubled, going into the presence of the seers, / he spoke with gentle words, saying with respect, "Please go on.

16.278.s:
vṛsī pragṛhyatāmeṣā tathaiva ca kamaṇḍaluḥ ..
valkalāni ca cīrāṇi mṛgacarmāṇyaśeṣataḥ .. 7.1.278.30 ..
16.278.d:
वृसी प्रगृह्यतामेषा तथैव च कमण्डलुः ..
वल्कलानि च चीराणि मृगचर्माण्यशेषतः .. 7.1.278.30 ..
16.278.m: Let this seat of darbha-grass be taken, and likewise the water-pot, / and the bark garments, rags, and deer skins in their entirety.

16.278.s:
kṣamyatāmaparādho me dīnasya kṛpaṇasya ca ..
satsaṃgena viyuktasya mūrkhasya munisattamāḥ .. 31 ..
16.278.d:
क्षम्यतामपराधो मे दीनस्य कृपणस्य च ..
सत्संगेन वियुक्तस्य मूर्खस्य मुनिसत्तमाः .. 31 ..
16.278.m: Let my offense be forgiven, [wretched] as I am, miserable and poor, / deprived of the company of the good, foolish, O best of sages!

16.278.s:
adyaprabhṛti nivṛttaḥ karmaṇo'syāhameva ca ..
raudrasya sunṛśaṃsasya sādhubhirgarhitasya ca ..
tasmātkathayatāsmākaṃ nivṛttiṃ cāsya karmaṇaḥ..32..
16.278.d:
अद्यप्रभृति निवृत्तः कर्मणोऽस्याहमेव च ..
रौद्रस्य सुनृशंसस्य साधुभिर्गर्हितस्य च ..
तस्मात्कथयतास्माकं निवृत्तिं चास्य कर्मणः..32..
16.278.m: From this day forth, I have turned away from this deed / which is terrible, very cruel, and censured by the virtuous. / Therefore, tell me how to turn away from this deed,

16.278.s:
yena yuṣmatprasādena pāpānmokṣamahaṃ vraje..
upavāso'tha mantro vā niyamo vātha saṃyamaḥ..33..
16.278.d:
येन युष्मत्प्रसादेन पापान्मोक्षमहं व्रजे..
उपवासोऽथ मन्त्रो वा नियमो वाथ संयमः..33..
16.278.m: so that by your grace I may attain release from sin— / whether by fasting, a mantra, an observance, or self-restraint."

16.278.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ.. ..
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā vatsa tattvamekamanāḥ śṛṇu..
saṃgṛhya kīrtayiṣyāmastvayā''khyeyaṃ na kasyacit..34..
16.278.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः.. ..
साधु पृष्टं त्वया वत्स तत्त्वमेकमनाः शृणु..
संगृह्य कीर्तयिष्यामस्त्वया'ऽख्येयं न कस्यचित्..34..
16.278.m: The seers said: / "Well asked by you, child! Listen to the reality with single-minded attention. / We shall explain it concisely; it must not be told by you to anyone.

16.278.s:
tena japtena pāpatmanmokṣaṃ prāpsyasi niścitam..
jhāṭaghoṭastvayā kīrttyo mantro'yaṃ caturakṣaraḥ..35..
16.278.d:
तेन जप्तेन पापत्मन्मोक्षं प्राप्स्यसि निश्चितम्..
झाटघोटस्त्वया कीर्त्त्यो मन्त्रोऽयं चतुरक्षरः..35..
16.278.m: Through muttering it, O sinful soul, you will certainly obtain liberation. / This four-syllable mantra must be recited by you: 'jhāṭa-ghoṭa'.

16.278.s:
sarvapāpaharo nṛṇāṃ svargamokṣaphalapradaḥ..
sa tadaivaṃ hi taiḥ prokto vaiśākho munipuṃgavaiḥ ..
tasthau jāpyaparo nityaṃ gatāste munipuṃgavāḥ .. 36 ..
16.278.d:
सर्वपापहरो नृणां स्वर्गमोक्षफलप्रदः..
स तदैवं हि तैः प्रोक्तो वैशाखो मुनिपुंगवैः ..
तस्थौ जाप्यपरो नित्यं गतास्ते मुनिपुंगवाः .. 36 ..
16.278.m: It removes all sins for humans and bestows the fruit of heaven and liberation." / Having been told thus by those bull-like sages, / Vaiśākha remained constantly intent on recitation, and those bull-like sages departed.

16.278.s:
tasyaivaṃ japato devi devikāyāstaṭe śubhe ..
aniśaṃ guru bhaktasya samādhiḥ samapadyata .. 37 ..
16.278.d:
तस्यैवं जपतो देवि देविकायास्तटे शुभे ..
अनिशं गुरु भक्तस्य समाधिः समपद्यत .. 37 ..
16.278.m: As he was thus reciting continuously on the auspicious bank of the Devikā, O goddess, / absorption arose for him who was devoted to the guru.

16.278.s: kṣutpipāsā tadā naṣṭā śuddhimāyātkalevaram .. 38 ..
16.278.d: क्षुत्पिपासा तदा नष्टा शुद्धिमायात्कलेवरम् .. 38 ..
16.278.m: Then hunger and thirst vanished, and his body attained purity.

16.278.s:
maṃtre tīrthe dvije deve daivajñe bheṣaje gurau ..
yādṛśī bhāva nā yasya siddhirbhavati tādṛśī .. 39 ..
16.278.d:
मंत्रे तीर्थे द्विजे देवे दैवज्ञे भेषजे गुरौ ..
यादृशी भाव ना यस्य सिद्धिर्भवति तादृशी .. 39 ..
16.278.m: In a mantra, a sacred ford, a brahmin, a deity, an astrologer, a medicine, and a guru, / of whatever nature a person's faith is, such is their perfection.

16.278.s:
nirmalo'yaṃ svabhāvena paramātmā yathā hitaḥ ..
upādhisaṃgamāsādya vikāraṃ sphaṭiko yathā.. 7.1.278.40 ..
16.278.d:
निर्मलोऽयं स्वभावेन परमात्मा यथा हितः ..
उपाधिसंगमासाद्य विकारं स्फटिको यथा.. 7.1.278.40 ..
16.278.m: Just as the Supreme Self is pure by nature and beneficent, / yet undergoes transformation through contact with limiting adjuncts, like a crystal,

16.278.s:
yathā ca bhramarī vaṃdhyā labdhvā jīvamaṇuṃ kvacit ..
svasthāne sthāpya taṃ dhyāyedbhramarī dhyānasaṃyutā .. 41 ..
16.278.d:
यथा च भ्रमरी वंध्या लब्ध्वा जीवमणुं क्वचित् ..
स्वस्थाने स्थाप्य तं ध्यायेद्भ्रमरी ध्यानसंयुता .. 41 ..
16.278.m: and just as a barren female wasp, having found a tiny living worm somewhere, / placing it in her own abode, meditates upon it with concentrated thought,

16.278.s:
sa tu taddhyānasaṃvṛddho jīvo bhavati tādṛśaḥ ..
anyayonyudbhavo vāpi tathā nidarśanaṃ satām..42..
16.278.d:
स तु तद्ध्यानसंवृद्धो जीवो भवति तादृशः ..
अन्ययोन्युद्भवो वापि तथा निदर्शनं सताम्..42..
16.278.m: and that living being, grown through meditation upon it, becomes just like that, / even if born in another womb—such is the illustration of the wise.

16.278.s:
ādiṣṭo guruṇā yaśca vikalpaṃ yadi gacchati..
nāsau siddhimavāpnoti maṃdabhāgyo yathā nidhim.. !.. 43 ..
16.278.d:
आदिष्टो गुरुणा यश्च विकल्पं यदि गच्छति..
नासौ सिद्धिमवाप्नोति मंदभाग्यो यथा निधिम्.. !.. 43 ..
16.278.m: And if someone instructed by a guru falls into doubt, / he does not obtain perfection, just as an unfortunate man fails to find a treasure.

16.278.s:
evaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi samatītāni bhūriśaḥ..
tasya jāpyaparasyaiva amṛtatvaṃ gatasya ca .. 44 ..
16.278.d:
एवं वर्षसहस्राणि समतीतानि भूरिशः..
तस्य जाप्यपरस्यैव अमृतत्वं गतस्य च .. 44 ..
16.278.m: In this way, many thousands of years passed away / for him who was intent on muttering and who had attained immortality.

16.278.s:
tataḥ kālakrameṇaiva valmīkena sa veṣṭitaḥ ..
yenāsau sarvato vyāpto na ca taṃ sa bubodha vai .. 45 ..
16.278.d:
ततः कालक्रमेणैव वल्मीकेन स वेष्टितः ..
येनासौ सर्वतो व्याप्तो न च तं स बुबोध वै .. 45 ..
16.278.m: Then, in the course of time, he was surrounded by an anthill, / by which he was covered on all sides, and he did not notice it at all.

16.278.s:
kasyacittvathakālasya munayaste samāgatāḥ ..
taṃ pradeśaṃ tu saṃprekṣya sahāyyamitaretaram..
ūcuḥ parasparaṃ sarve dattvā caiva karaiḥ karam ..46..
16.278.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथकालस्य मुनयस्ते समागताः ..
तं प्रदेशं तु संप्रेक्ष्य सहाय्यमितरेतरम्..
ऊचुः परस्परं सर्वे दत्त्वा चैव करैः करम् ..46..
16.278.m: Then after some time, those sages arrived. / Beholding that region, joining together in mutual support, / and placing hand in hand, they all said to one another: 46

16.278.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
atrāsau taskaraḥ prāpto vaiśākho dāruṇākṛtiḥ ..
yena sarve vayaṃ muṣṭā asmi nsthāne samāgatāḥ .. 47 ..
16.278.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
अत्रासौ तस्करः प्राप्तो वैशाखो दारुणाकृतिः ..
येन सर्वे वयं मुष्टा अस्मि न्स्थाने समागताः .. 47 ..
16.278.m: The seers said: / "Here that robber arrived, Vaiśākha of cruel form, / by whom we were all plundered when we assembled at this place." 47

16.278.s:
evaṃ saṃjalpamānāste śuśruvuḥ śabdamuttamam ..
valmīkamadhyato vyaktaṃ tataste kautukānvitāḥ .. 48 ..
16.278.d:
एवं संजल्पमानास्ते शुश्रुवुः शब्दमुत्तमम् ..
वल्मीकमध्यतो व्यक्तं ततस्ते कौतुकान्विताः .. 48 ..
16.278.m: As they were conversing in this manner, they heard a wonderful sound / clearly coming from within an anthill; thereupon, filled with curiosity, 48

16.278.s: akhanaṃstatra valmīkaṃ kuśībhiḥ parvatopamam .. 49 ..
16.278.d: अखनंस्तत्र वल्मीकं कुशीभिः पर्वतोपमम् .. 49 ..
16.278.m: they dug open that mountain-like anthill there with spades. 49

16.278.s:
atha te dadṛśustatra viśākhaṃ munisattamāḥ ..
japaṃtamasakṛnmatraṃ tameva caturakṣaram .. 7.1.278.50 ..
16.278.d:
अथ ते ददृशुस्तत्र विशाखं मुनिसत्तमाः ..
जपंतमसकृन्मत्रं तमेव चतुरक्षरम् .. 7.1.278.50 ..
16.278.m: Then, O best of sages, they saw Viśākha there, / repeatedly chanting that very same four-syllabled mantra. 50

16.278.s:
taṃ samādhigataṃ jñātvā bheṣajairyogasaṃmataiḥ ..
mamarduḥ sarvato viprāstatra suptatanau bhṛśam .. 51 ..
16.278.d:
तं समाधिगतं ज्ञात्वा भेषजैर्योगसंमतैः ..
ममर्दुः सर्वतो विप्रास्तत्र सुप्ततनौ भृशम् .. 51 ..
16.278.m: Recognizing that he had attained absorption (samādhi), the brahmins vigorously rubbed / his dormant body all over with medicines approved by yoga. 51

16.278.s:
tato'bravīdṛṣrīnsarvānsvamarthaṃ gṛhyatāṃ dvijāḥ ..
yuṣmadīyaṃ gṛhītaṃ yatpā penākṛtabuddhinā .. 52 ..
16.278.d:
ततोऽब्रवीदृष्रीन्सर्वान्स्वमर्थं गृह्यतां द्विजाः ..
युष्मदीयं गृहीतं यत्पा पेनाकृतबुद्धिना .. 52 ..
16.278.m: Then he said to all the seers: "O twice-born ones, take back your property / that was seized by me, a sinner of unrefined intellect! 52

16.278.s:
gamyatāṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ sarve muktā mayā dvijāḥ ..
vācyau me pitarau gatvā tathā bhāryā dvijottamāḥ .. 53 ..
16.278.d:
गम्यतां तीर्थयात्रायां सर्वे मुक्ता मया द्विजाः ..
वाच्यौ मे पितरौ गत्वा तथा भार्या द्विजोत्तमाः .. 53 ..
16.278.m: Go on your pilgrimage to the sacred fords; all of you, O twice-born ones, are released by me. / Having gone, O best of brahmins, tell my parents and my wife: 53

16.278.s:
sarva saṃgaparityakto viśākhaḥ samapadyata ..
darśanaṃ kāṃkṣate naiva bhavadbhistu yathā purā .. 54 ..
16.278.d:
सर्व संगपरित्यक्तो विशाखः समपद्यत ..
दर्शनं कांक्षते नैव भवद्भिस्तु यथा पुरा .. 54 ..
16.278.m: Viśākha has become one who has renounced all attachment; / he no longer desires to see you as before." 54

16.278.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
bahuvarṣāṇyatītāni tavātra vasato mune ..
sarve te nidhanaṃ prāptā ye cānye te kuṭuṃbinaḥ .. 55 ..
16.278.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
बहुवर्षाण्यतीतानि तवात्र वसतो मुने ..
सर्वे ते निधनं प्राप्ता ये चान्ये ते कुटुंबिनः .. 55 ..
16.278.m: The seers said: / "Many years have passed while you have dwelled here, O sage. / All those family members of yours, and others as well, have met their death. 55

16.278.s:
vayaṃ cirātsamāyātāḥ sthāne'sminmunisattamāḥ ..
sa tvaṃ siddhimanuprāpto maṃtrādasmādasaṃśayam .. 56 ..
16.278.d:
वयं चिरात्समायाताः स्थानेऽस्मिन्मुनिसत्तमाः ..
स त्वं सिद्धिमनुप्राप्तो मंत्रादस्मादसंशयम् .. 56 ..
16.278.m: We, best of sages, have returned to this place after a long time. / You have surely attained perfection (siddhi) from this mantra, without a doubt. 56

16.278.s:
yasmāttvaṃ maṃtramekāgro dhyāyanvalmīkamāśritaḥ ..
tasmādvālmīkināmā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi mahītale .. 57 ..
16.278.d:
यस्मात्त्वं मंत्रमेकाग्रो ध्यायन्वल्मीकमाश्रितः ..
तस्माद्वाल्मीकिनामा त्वं भविष्यसि महीतले .. 57 ..
16.278.m: Because you, single-minded in meditating on the mantra, took shelter within an anthill (valmīka), / therefore you will be known on earth by the name Vālmīki. 57

16.278.s:
svacchaṃdā bhāratī devī jihvāgre te bhaviṣyati ..
kṛtvā rāmāyaṇaṃ kāvyaṃ tato mokṣaṃ gamiṣyasi.. 58 ..
16.278.d:
स्वच्छंदा भारती देवी जिह्वाग्रे ते भविष्यति ..
कृत्वा रामायणं काव्यं ततो मोक्षं गमिष्यसि.. 58 ..
16.278.m: The goddess Bhāratī will dwell at the tip of your tongue at will. / Having composed the poem Rāmāyaṇa, you will then attain liberation." 58

16.278.s:
viśākha uvāca ..
gṛhyatāṃ dvijaśārdūlāḥ prasannā gurudakṣiṇām..
yenāhamanṛṇo bhūtvā karomi sumahattapaḥ .. 59 ..
16.278.d:
विशाख उवाच ..
गृह्यतां द्विजशार्दूलाः प्रसन्ना गुरुदक्षिणाम्..
येनाहमनृणो भूत्वा करोमि सुमहत्तपः .. 59 ..
16.278.m: Viśākha said: / "O tigers among the twice-born, being pleased, accept a teacher's fee, / so that, freed from debt, I may perform great austerity." 59

16.278.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
eṣā no dakṣiṇā vipra yastvaṃ siddhimupāgataḥ ..
sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā kṛtakṛtyā vayaṃ mune .. 7.1.278.60 ..
16.278.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
एषा नो दक्षिणा विप्र यस्त्वं सिद्धिमुपागतः ..
सर्वकामसमृद्धात्मा कृतकृत्या वयं मुने .. 7.1.278.60 ..
16.278.m: The seers said: / "This is our fee, O brahmin: that you have attained perfection. / With your soul fulfilled in all desires, O sage, we have achieved our purpose. 60

16.278.s: varaṃ varaya bhūyastvaṃ yaste manasi vartate .. 61 ..
16.278.d: वरं वरय भूयस्त्वं यस्ते मनसि वर्तते .. 61 ..
16.278.m: Choose a boon further, whatever is in your mind." 61

16.278.s:
.. vālmīkiruvāca .. ..
bhavaṃto yadi tuṣṭā me yadi deyo varo mama ..
kathyatāṃ tarhi me śīghraṃ ko devo hyatra saṃsthitaḥ ..
devikāyāstaṭe ramye sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ .. 62 ..
16.278.d:
.. वाल्मीकिरुवाच .. ..
भवंतो यदि तुष्टा मे यदि देयो वरो मम ..
कथ्यतां तर्हि मे शीघ्रं को देवो ह्यत्र संस्थितः ..
देविकायास्तटे रम्ये सर्वकामफलप्रदः .. 62 ..
16.278.m: Vālmīki said: / "If you are pleased with me, if a boon is to be given to me, / then tell me quickly: which god resides here / on the charming bank of the Devikā, granting the fruit of all desires?" 62

16.278.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā vipra yo devaścātra saṃsthitaḥ ..
paśya niṃbamimaṃ vipra bahuśākhāpravistaram .. 63 ..
16.278.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
शृणुष्वैकमना विप्र यो देवश्चात्र संस्थितः ..
पश्य निंबमिमं विप्र बहुशाखाप्रविस्तरम् .. 63 ..
16.278.m: The seers said: / "Listen with single-minded attention, O brahmin, to which god resides here: / behold this neem tree, O brahmin, with its widespread branches! 63

16.278.s:
asya mūle sthitaḥ sūryyaḥ kalpādau brahmaṇoṃ'śajaḥ ..
tamārādhaya yattesāvasya sthānasya devatā .. 64 ..
16.278.d:
अस्य मूले स्थितः सूर्य्यः कल्पादौ ब्रह्मणोंऽशजः ..
तमाराधय यत्तेसावस्य स्थानस्य देवता .. 64 ..
16.278.m: At its root Sūrya resides, born from a portion of Brahmā at the beginning of the kalpa. / Worship him diligently, for he is the deity of this place. 64

16.278.s:
sūryakṣetraṃ samākhyātamidaṃ gavyūtimātrakam ..
atra sthāne sthitā yepi teṣāṃ svargo dhruvaṃ bhavet .. 65 ..
16.278.d:
सूर्यक्षेत्रं समाख्यातमिदं गव्यूतिमात्रकम् ..
अत्र स्थाने स्थिता येपि तेषां स्वर्गो ध्रुवं भवेत् .. 65 ..
16.278.m: This is declared to be a sacred field of Sūrya measuring only a gavyūti. / Even those who simply dwell in this place will surely attain heaven. 65

16.278.s:
adyaprabhṛti viprendra mūlasthānamiti śrutam ..
sthānaṃ sūryasya viprendra kāryā cātra tvayā sthitiḥ .. .. 66 ..
16.278.d:
अद्यप्रभृति विप्रेन्द्र मूलस्थानमिति श्रुतम् ..
स्थानं सूर्यस्य विप्रेन्द्र कार्या चात्र त्वया स्थितिः .. .. 66 ..
16.278.m: From this day forth, O best of brahmins, this is celebrated as Mūlasthāna, / the abode of Sūrya, O best of brahmins; and you must make your dwelling here. 66

16.278.s:
adyaprabhṛti vipreṃdra tīrthametanmahītale ..
gamiṣyati parāṃ khyātiṃ devikātaṭamāśritam .. 67 ..
16.278.d:
अद्यप्रभृति विप्रेंद्र तीर्थमेतन्महीतले ..
गमिष्यति परां ख्यातिं देविकातटमाश्रितम् .. 67 ..
16.278.m: From this day forth, O best of brahmins, this sacred ford on earth / situated on the bank of the Devikā will attain supreme renown. 67

16.278.s:
vayaṃ muṣṭā yato vipra mūlasthāne purā sthitāḥ ..
mūlasthāneti vai nāma loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati .. 68 ..
16.278.d:
वयं मुष्टा यतो विप्र मूलस्थाने पुरा स्थिताः ..
मूलस्थानेति वै नाम लोके ख्यातिं गमिष्यति .. 68 ..
16.278.m: Since we were plundered in the past while staying at the root of the tree (mūlasthāne), O brahmin, / it will become renowned in the world by the very name Mūlasthāna. 68

16.278.s:
atra ye mānavā bhaktyā snānaṃ sūryasya saṃgame ..
uttare tu kariṣyaṃti te yāsyaṃti triviṣṭapam .. 69 ..
16.278.d:
अत्र ये मानवा भक्त्या स्नानं सूर्यस्य संगमे ..
उत्तरे तु करिष्यंति ते यास्यंति त्रिविष्टपम् .. 69 ..
16.278.m: Those men who take a ritual ablution with devotion here at the northern confluence / of Sūrya will go to heaven. 69

16.278.s:
tarpaṇaṃ tilamiśreṇa jalena dvijasattamāḥ ..
gayāśrāddhasamā tuṣṭiḥ pitṝṇāṃ ca bhaviṣyati .. 7.1.278.70 ..
16.278.d:
तर्पणं तिलमिश्रेण जलेन द्विजसत्तमाः ..
गयाश्राद्धसमा तुष्टिः पितॄणां च भविष्यति .. 7.1.278.70 ..
16.278.m: When they perform libation with water mixed with sesame seeds, O best of twice-born ones, / the satisfaction of their ancestors will equal that of a śrāddha at Gayā. 70

16.278.s:
atra ye mānavā bhaktyā śrāddhaṃ dāsyaṃti sattamāḥ ..
śākamūlaphalairvāpi samyakchraddhāsamanvitāḥ .. 71 ..
16.278.d:
अत्र ये मानवा भक्त्या श्राद्धं दास्यंति सत्तमाः ..
शाकमूलफलैर्वापि सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्विताः .. 71 ..
16.278.m: Those excellent men who offer a śrāddha here with devotion, / even with vegetables, roots, or fruits, endowed with full faith, 71

16.278.s: teṣāṃ yāsyaṃti pitaro mokṣaṃ naivātra saṃśayaḥ .. 72 .
16.278.d: तेषां यास्यंति पितरो मोक्षं नैवात्र संशयः .. 72 .
16.278.m: their ancestors will attain liberation; of this there is no doubt. 72

16.278.s:
api kīṭapataṃgā ye pakṣiṇaḥ paśavo mṛgāḥ ..
tṛṣārtā jalasaṃsparśādyāsyaṃti paramāṃ gatim .. 73 ..
16.278.d:
अपि कीटपतंगा ये पक्षिणः पशवो मृगाः ..
तृषार्ता जलसंस्पर्शाद्यास्यंति परमां गतिम् .. 73 ..
16.278.m: Even insects, moths, birds, beasts, and deer / afflicted by thirst will attain the highest state through contact with the water. 73

16.278.s:
vayameva sadātrasthāḥ śrāvaṇe māsi sattama ..
paurṇamāsyāṃ bhaviṣyāmastava snehādasaṃśayam .. 74 ..
16.278.d:
वयमेव सदात्रस्थाः श्रावणे मासि सत्तम ..
पौर्णमास्यां भविष्यामस्तव स्नेहादसंशयम् .. 74 ..
16.278.m: We ourselves will always be present here in the month of Śrāvaṇa, O best of men, / on the full moon day, out of affection for you, without a doubt. 74

16.278.s:
tasminnahani yastoyaiḥ pitṝnsaṃtarpayiṣyati ..
tasyāṣṭādaśakuṣṭhāni kṣayaṃ yāsyaṃti tatkṣaṇāt .. 75 ..
16.278.d:
तस्मिन्नहनि यस्तोयैः पितॄन्संतर्पयिष्यति ..
तस्याष्टादशकुष्ठानि क्षयं यास्यंति तत्क्षणात् .. 75 ..
16.278.m: For whoever satisfies the ancestors with water on that day, / their eighteen kinds of leprosy will instantly be eradicated: 75

16.278.s:
kapālodumbarākhyeṃdramaṇḍalākhyavicarcikāḥ ..
ṛṣyacarmaikakiṭibhasidhmālasavipādikāḥ .. 76 ..
16.278.d:
कपालोदुम्बराख्येंद्रमण्डलाख्यविचर्चिकाः ..
ऋष्यचर्मैककिटिभसिध्मालसविपादिकाः .. 76 ..
16.278.m: the ones named kapāla, udumbara, and indramaṇḍala, and vicarcikā; / ṛṣyacarma, ekakuṣṭha, kiṭibha, sidhma, alasa, and vipādikā; 76

16.278.s:
dadrusitā rucisphoṭaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ sakākaṇam ..
pāmā carmadalaṃ ceti kuṣṭhānyaṣṭādaśaiva tu .. 77 ..
16.278.d:
दद्रुसिता रुचिस्फोटं पुण्डरीकं सकाकणम् ..
पामा चर्मदलं चेति कुष्ठान्यष्टादशैव तु .. 77 ..
16.278.m: dadru, sitā, aruci, sphoṭa, puṇḍarīka, along with kākaṇa, / pāmā, and carmadala—these are the eighteen kinds of leprosy. 77

16.278.s:
gamiṣyaṃti na saṃdeha ityuktvāṃtardadhuśca te ..
ṛṣiḥ siṣeve ca raviṃ cakre rāmāyaṇaṃ tataḥ .. 78 ..
16.278.d:
गमिष्यंति न संदेह इत्युक्त्वांतर्दधुश्च ते ..
ऋषिः सिषेवे च रविं चक्रे रामायणं ततः .. 78 ..
16.278.m: They will vanish, there is no doubt." Having spoken thus, they disappeared. / And the sage worshipped the sun and then composed the Rāmāyaṇa. 78

16.278.s:
tasmātpaśyecca taṃ devaṃ sarvayajñaphalapradam ..
śṛṇuyācca kathāṃ caināṃ sarvapātakanāśinīm .. 79 ..
16.278.d:
तस्मात्पश्येच्च तं देवं सर्वयज्ञफलप्रदम् ..
शृणुयाच्च कथां चैनां सर्वपातकनाशिनीम् .. 79 ..
16.278.m: Therefore, one should behold that god who grants the fruit of all sacrifices, / and one should listen to this story, which destroys all sins. 79

16.278.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye devikāmāhātmyamūlasthānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭasaptatyuttara dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..278..
16.278.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये देविकामाहात्म्यमूलस्थानमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टसप्तत्युत्तर द्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..278..
16.278.m: Thus ends the two hundred and seventy-eighth chapter, entitled "Description of the Greatness of the Devikā and the Greatness of Mūlasthāna," in the first [sub-section], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 278

16.279.s:
.. īśvara uvāca ..
tato gacchenmahādevi cyavanārkamanuttamam ..
hiraṇyāpūrvabhāgasthaṃ cyavanena pratiṣṭhitam..1..
16.279.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि च्यवनार्कमनुत्तमम् ..
हिरण्यापूर्वभागस्थं च्यवनेन प्रतिष्ठितम्..1..
16.279.m: Īśvara said: / "Next, O great goddess, one should go to the unsurpassable Cyavanārka, / situated on the eastern side of the Hiraṇyā, established by Cyavana, 1

16.279.s:
sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ pūjitaṃ vidhivannaraiḥ ..
saptamyāṃ ca vidhānena yaḥ stoṣyati raviṃ naraḥ .. 2 ..
16.279.d:
सर्वकामप्रदं नृणां पूजितं विधिवन्नरैः ..
सप्तम्यां च विधानेन यः स्तोष्यति रविं नरः .. 2 ..
16.279.m: which grants all desires to mortals when duly worshipped by men. / And whatever man praises the sun according to rule on the seventh lunar day, 2

16.279.s:
aṣṭottaraśatairnāmnāṃ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
śṛṇu tāni mahādevi śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ .. 3 ..
16.279.d:
अष्टोत्तरशतैर्नाम्नां सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
शृणु तानि महादेवि शुचिर्भूत्वा समाहितः .. 3 ..
16.279.m: with the one hundred and eight names, endowed with full faith— / listen to them, O great goddess, having become pure and concentrated. 3

16.279.s:
kṣaṇaṃ tvaṃ kuru deveśi sarvaṃ vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ ..
dhaumyena tu yathāpūrvaṃ pārthāya sumahātmane .. 4 ..
16.279.d:
क्षणं त्वं कुरु देवेशि सर्वं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः ..
धौम्येन तु यथापूर्वं पार्थाय सुमहात्मने .. 4 ..
16.279.m: Grant a moment, O ruler of the gods; I will tell you everything completely, / just as of old Dhaumya told to the great-souled son of Pṛthā (Arjuna). 4

16.279.s:
nāmāṣṭaśatamākhyātaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva mahāmate ..
sūryo'ryamā bhagastvaṣṭā pūṣā'rkaḥ savitā raviḥ .. 5 ..
16.279.d:
नामाष्टशतमाख्यातं तच्छृणुष्व महामते ..
सूर्योऽर्यमा भगस्त्वष्टा पूषाऽर्कः सविता रविः .. 5 ..
16.279.m: The one hundred and eight names were proclaimed; listen to that, O intelligent one: / Sūrya, Aryaman, Bhaga, Tvaṣṭṛ, Pūṣan, Arka, Savitṛ, Ravi, 5

16.279.s:
gabhastimānajaḥ kālo mṛtyurddhātā prabhākaraḥ ..
pṛthivyāpaśca tejaśca khaṃ vāyuśca parāyaṇaḥ .. 6 ..
16.279.d:
गभस्तिमानजः कालो मृत्युर्द्धाता प्रभाकरः ..
पृथिव्यापश्च तेजश्च खं वायुश्च परायणः .. 6 ..
16.279.m: Gabhastimant, Aja, Kāla, Mṛtyu, Dhātṛ, Prabhākara, / Earth, Water, Fire, Sky, and Wind, the Supreme Refuge, 6

16.279.s:
somo bṛhaspatiḥ śukro budhoṃ'gāraka eva ca ..
indro vivasvāndīptāṃśuḥ śuciḥ sauriḥ śanaiścaraḥ .. .. 7 ..
16.279.d:
सोमो बृहस्पतिः शुक्रो बुधोंऽगारक एव च ..
इन्द्रो विवस्वान्दीप्तांशुः शुचिः सौरिः शनैश्चरः .. .. 7 ..
16.279.m: Soma, Bṛhaspati, Śukra, Budha, and Aṅgāraka, / Indra, Vivasvant, Dīptāṃśu, Śuci, Śauri, Śanaiścara, 7

16.279.s:
brahmā rudraśca viṣṇuśca skando vaiśravaṇo yamaḥ ..
vaidyuto jāṭharaścāgniriṃdhanastejasāṃ patiḥ .. 8 ..
16.279.d:
ब्रह्मा रुद्रश्च विष्णुश्च स्कन्दो वैश्रवणो यमः ..
वैद्युतो जाठरश्चाग्निरिंधनस्तेजसां पतिः .. 8 ..
16.279.m: [He is] Brahmā, Rudra, and Viṣṇu, Skanda, Vaiśravaṇa, Yama, / lightning, digestive fire, fuel, and the lord of splendours. (8)

16.279.s:
dharmadhvajo vedakarttā vedāṃgo vedavāhanaḥ ..
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaśca kaliḥ sarvāmarāśrayaḥ .. 9 ..
16.279.d:
धर्मध्वजो वेदकर्त्ता वेदांगो वेदवाहनः ..
कृतं त्रेता द्वापरश्च कलिः सर्वामराश्रयः .. 9 ..
16.279.m: [He has] the banner of dharma, the author of the Vedas, the limb of the Vedas, the vehicle of the Vedas, / the Kṛta, Tretā, Dvāpara, and Kali [ages], the refuge of all the immortals. (9)

16.279.s:
kalākāṣṭhāmuhūrttāśca pakṣā māsā aharniśāḥ ..
saṃvatsarakaro'śvasthaḥ kālacakro vibhāvasuḥ .. 7.1.279.10 ..
16.279.d:
कलाकाष्ठामुहूर्त्ताश्च पक्षा मासा अहर्निशाः ..
संवत्सरकरोऽश्वस्थः कालचक्रो विभावसुः .. 7.1.279.10 ..
16.279.m: [He is] the kalās, kāṣṭhās, muhūrtas, fortnights, months, days and nights, / the maker of the year, seated on a horse, the wheel of time, Vibhāvasu. (10)

16.279.s:
puruṣaḥ śāśvato yogī vyaktāvyaktaḥ sanātanaḥ ..
lokādhyakṣaḥ prajādhyakṣo viśvakarmā tamonudaḥ ..11..
16.279.d:
पुरुषः शाश्वतो योगी व्यक्ताव्यक्तः सनातनः ..
लोकाध्यक्षः प्रजाध्यक्षो विश्वकर्मा तमोनुदः ..11..
16.279.m: [He is] the Spirit, eternal, yogin, manifest and unmanifest, perpetual, / the overseer of the worlds, the overseer of creatures, Viśvakarman, the dispeller of darkness. (11)

16.279.s:
varuṇaḥ sāgaroṃśuśca jīvanto jīvano'rihā ..
bhūtāśrayo bhūtapatiḥ sarvabhūtaniṣevitaḥ .. 12 ..
16.279.d:
वरुणः सागरोंशुश्च जीवन्तो जीवनोऽरिहा ..
भूताश्रयो भूतपतिः सर्वभूतनिषेवितः .. 12 ..
16.279.m: [He is] Varuṇa, the ocean, ray of light, living, giving life, slayer of enemies, / the refuge of beings, the lord of beings, worshipped by all beings. (12)

16.279.s:
sraṣṭā saṃvarttako vahniḥ sarvasyādikaro'malaḥ ..
anaṃtaḥ kapilo bhānuḥ kāmadaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ .. 13 ..
16.279.d:
स्रष्टा संवर्त्तको वह्निः सर्वस्यादिकरोऽमलः ..
अनंतः कपिलो भानुः कामदः सर्वतोमुखः .. 13 ..
16.279.m: [He is] the creator, the destroyer, fire, the originator of everything, spotless, / endless, tawny, the sun, bestower of wishes, facing all directions. (13)

16.279.s:
jayo viṣādo varadaḥ sarvadhātuniṣevitaḥ ..
samaḥ suvarṇo bhūtādiḥ śīghragaḥ prāṇadhārakaḥ .. 14 ..
16.279.d:
जयो विषादो वरदः सर्वधातुनिषेवितः ..
समः सुवर्णो भूतादिः शीघ्रगः प्राणधारकः .. 14 ..
16.279.m: [He is] victory, dejection, giver of boons, worshipped by all elements, / impartial, golden, the origin of beings, swift-moving, the upholder of life-breaths. (14)

16.279.s:
dhanvaṃtarirdhūmaketurādidevo'diteḥ sutaḥ..
dvādaśātmā'raviṃdākṣaḥ pitā mātā pitāmahaḥ ..15..
svargadvāraṃ prajādvāraṃ mokṣadvāraṃ triviṣṭapam ..
dehakarttā praśāṃtātmā viśvātmā viśvatomukhaḥ ..
carācarātmā sūkṣmātmā maitreṇa vapuṣā'nvitaḥ .. 15 ..
16.279.d:
धन्वंतरिर्धूमकेतुरादिदेवोऽदितेः सुतः..
द्वादशात्माऽरविंदाक्षः पिता माता पितामहः ..15..
स्वर्गद्वारं प्रजाद्वारं मोक्षद्वारं त्रिविष्टपम् ..
देहकर्त्ता प्रशांतात्मा विश्वात्मा विश्वतोमुखः ..
चराचरात्मा सूक्ष्मात्मा मैत्रेण वपुषाऽन्वितः .. 15 ..
16.279.m:
[He is] Dhanvantari, the comet, the primal god, the son of Aditi, / twelve-souled, lotus-eyed, father, mother, grandfather. (15)
[He is] the door to heaven, the door to progeny, the door to liberation, the celestial realm, / maker of the body, tranquil-souled, the soul of all, facing all directions, / the soul of moving and unmoving, subtle-souled, endowed with a benevolent form. (16)

16.279.s:
etadvai kīrtanīyasya sūryasyāmitatejasaḥ ..
nāmnāmaṣṭottaraśataṃ proktaṃ śakreṇa dhīmatā .. 17 ..
16.279.d:
एतद्वै कीर्तनीयस्य सूर्यस्यामिततेजसः ..
नाम्नामष्टोत्तरशतं प्रोक्तं शक्रेण धीमता .. 17 ..
16.279.m: Indeed, this hymn of one hundred and eight names of the sun of boundless splendour, / who is worthy of praise, was spoken by wise Śakra. (17)

16.279.s:
śakrācca nāradaḥ prāpto dhaumyastu tadanantaram ..
dhaumyādyudhiṣṭhiraḥ prāpya sarvānkāmānavāptavān .. 18 ..
16.279.d:
शक्राच्च नारदः प्राप्तो धौम्यस्तु तदनन्तरम् ..
धौम्याद्युधिष्ठिरः प्राप्य सर्वान्कामानवाप्तवान् .. 18 ..
16.279.m: From Śakra, Nārada obtained it, and then Dhaumya next; / having obtained it from Dhaumya, Yudhiṣṭhira attained all his desires. (18)

16.279.s:
etāni kīrtanīyasya sūryasyāmitatejasaḥ ..
nāmāni yaḥ paṭhennityaṃ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 19 ..
16.279.d:
एतानि कीर्तनीयस्य सूर्यस्यामिततेजसः ..
नामानि यः पठेन्नित्यं सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् .. 19 ..
16.279.m: Whoever recites daily these names of the sun of boundless splendour, / who is worthy of praise, shall attain all desires. (19)

16.279.s:
surapitṛmanujayakṣasevitamasuraniśācarasiddhavaṃditam ..
varakanakahutāśanaprabhaṃ tvamapi nama hitāya bhāskaram .. 7.1.279.20 ..
16.279.d:
सुरपितृमनुजयक्षसेवितमसुरनिशाचरसिद्धवंदितम् ..
वरकनकहुताशनप्रभं त्वमपि नम हिताय भास्करम् .. 7.1.279.20 ..
16.279.m: Served by gods, ancestors, men, and yakṣas, praised by asuras, night-wanderers, and siddhas, / possessing the splendour of choice gold and fire: you too bow down to the Sun for your own welfare. (20)

16.279.s:
sūryodaye yastu samāhitaḥ paṭhetsa putralābhaṃ dhanaratnasaṃcayān ..
labheta jātismaratāṃ sadā naraḥ smṛtiṃ ca medhāṃ ca sa viṃdate pumān .... 21..
16.279.d:
सूर्योदये यस्तु समाहितः पठेत्स पुत्रलाभं धनरत्नसंचयान् ..
लभेत जातिस्मरतां सदा नरः स्मृतिं च मेधां च स विंदते पुमान् .... 21..
16.279.m: The focused man who recites [this] at sunrise would obtain sons and heaps of wealth and gems; / that man always obtains memory of past lives, and he gains memory and wisdom. (21)

16.279.s:
imaṃ stavaṃ devavarasya yo naraḥ prakīrttayecchuddhamanāḥ samāhitaḥ ..
sa mucyate śokadavāgnisārāllabheta kāmānmanasā yathepsitān ..22..
16.279.d:
इमं स्तवं देववरस्य यो नरः प्रकीर्त्तयेच्छुद्धमनाः समाहितः ..
स मुच्यते शोकदवाग्निसाराल्लभेत कामान्मनसा यथेप्सितान् ..22..
16.279.m: That person who, with a purified mind and concentrated focus, proclaims this praise of the foremost god, / is freed from the forest fire of sorrow and obtains the desires wished for in his heart. (22)

16.279.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye cyavanādityamāhātmyasūryāṣṭottaraśatanāma māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonāśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ.. 279..
16.279.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये च्यवनादित्यमाहात्म्यसूर्याष्टोत्तरशतनाम माहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनाशीत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः.. 279..
16.279.m: Thus ends the two hundred and seventy-ninth chapter, titled 'Description of the greatness of the Sun's one hundred and eight names in the greatness of Cyavanāditya', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. (279)

16.280.s:
īśvara uvāca..
tato gacchenmahādevi cyavaneśvaramuttamam..
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.280.d:
ईश्वर उवाच..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि च्यवनेश्वरमुत्तमम्..
तत्रैव संस्थितं लिंगं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.280.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the supreme Cyavaneśvara; / the liṅga situated right there destroys all sins. (1)

16.280.s:
yatra śaryātinā dattā sukanyā sā maharṣaye ..
yatra saṃstaṃbhitaṃ sainyamānāhārttamathākarot .. 2 ... (ānāha – jaṭhara ādhmānam)
16.280.d:
यत्र शर्यातिना दत्ता सुकन्या सा महर्षये ..
यत्र संस्तंभितं सैन्यमानाहार्त्तमथाकरोत् .. 2 ... (आनाह – जठर आध्मानम्)
16.280.m: Where Sukanyā was given to the great seer by Śaryāti; / where [Cyavana] paralyzed the army and then afflicted it with constipation. (2)

16.280.s:
eṣa śaryātiyajñasya deśo devi prakāśate ..
prabhāsakṣetramadhye tu sākṣātpātakanāśanaḥ .. 3 ..
16.280.d:
एष शर्यातियज्ञस्य देशो देवि प्रकाशते ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रमध्ये तु साक्षात्पातकनाशनः .. 3 ..
16.280.m: O goddess, this region of Śaryāti's sacrifice shines forth / in the midst of Prabhāsa sacred field, directly destroying sins. (3)

16.280.s:
sākṣāttatrābhajatsomamaśvibhyāṃ saha kauśikaḥ ..
cukopa bhārgavaścaiva mahendrāya mahātapāḥ .. 4 ..
16.280.d:
साक्षात्तत्राभजत्सोममश्विभ्यां सह कौशिकः ..
चुकोप भार्गवश्चैव महेन्द्राय महातपाः .. 4 ..
16.280.m: There Kauśika directly shared Soma along with the two Aśvins, / and the Bhārgava of great austerity became angry with Mahendra. (4)

16.280.s:
saṃstaṃbhayāmāsa ca taṃ vāsavaṃ cyavanaḥ prabhuḥ ..
sukanyāṃ cāpi bhāryāṃ sa rājaputrīmavāptavān .. 5 .. ..
16.280.d:
संस्तंभयामास च तं वासवं च्यवनः प्रभुः ..
सुकन्यां चापि भार्यां स राजपुत्रीमवाप्तवान् .. 5 .. ..
16.280.m: Lord Cyavana immobilized that Vāsava, / and he obtained Sukanyā, the king's daughter, as his wife. (5)

16.280.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kathaṃ viṣṭaṃbhitastena bhagavānpākaśāsanaḥ ..
kimarthaṃ bhārgavaścāpi kopaṃ cakre mahātapāḥ .. 6 ..
16.280.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
कथं विष्टंभितस्तेन भगवान्पाकशासनः ..
किमर्थं भार्गवश्चापि कोपं चक्रे महातपाः .. 6 ..
16.280.m: The goddess said: / How was the venerable Pākaśāsana immobilized by him? / For what reason did the Bhārgava of great austerity become angry? (6)

16.280.s:
nāsatyau ca kathaṃ brahmankṛ tavānsomapāyinau ..
tatsarvaṃ ca yathāvṛttamākhyātu bhagavānmama .. 7 ..
16.280.d:
नासत्यौ च कथं ब्रह्मन्कृ तवान्सोमपायिनौ ..
तत्सर्वं च यथावृत्तमाख्यातु भगवान्मम .. 7 ..
16.280.m: And how did he make the two Nāsatyas drinkers of Soma, O lord? / May the Lord explain all of that to me as it occurred. (7)

16.280.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
bhṛgormaharṣeḥ putro'bhūccyavano nāma nāmataḥ ..
sa prabhāsaṃ samāsādya tapastepe mahāmuniḥ .. 8 ..
16.280.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
भृगोर्महर्षेः पुत्रोऽभूच्च्यवनो नाम नामतः ..
स प्रभासं समासाद्य तपस्तेपे महामुनिः .. 8 ..
16.280.m: Īśvara said: / The great seer Bhṛgu had a son named Cyavana by name; / he reached Prabhāsa, and that great sage performed austerity. (8)

16.280.s:
sthāṇubhūto mahātejā vīrasthāne ca bhāmini ..
atiṣṭhatsuciraṃ kālamekadeśe varānane .. 9 ..
16.280.d:
स्थाणुभूतो महातेजा वीरस्थाने च भामिनि ..
अतिष्ठत्सुचिरं कालमेकदेशे वरानने .. 9 ..
16.280.m: Becoming like a pillar, of great splendour, in the posture of a hero, O passionate lady, / he stood for a very long time in one spot, O fair-faced one. (9)

16.280.s:
sa valmīko'bhavattatra latābhirabhisaṃvṛtaḥ ..
kālena mahatā devi samākīrṇaḥ pipīlakaiḥ .. 7.1.280.10 ..
16.280.d:
स वल्मीकोऽभवत्तत्र लताभिरभिसंवृतः ..
कालेन महता देवि समाकीर्णः पिपीलकैः .. 7.1.280.10 ..
16.280.m: There he became an anthill covered all around with creepers; / after a long time, O goddess, he was overrun by ants. (10)

16.280.s:
sa tathā saṃvṛto dhīmānmṛtpiṃḍa iva sarvataḥ ..
tapyate sma tapo ghoraṃ valmīkena samāvṛtaḥ .. 11 ..
16.280.d:
स तथा संवृतो धीमान्मृत्पिंड इव सर्वतः ..
तप्यते स्म तपो घोरं वल्मीकेन समावृतः .. 11 ..
16.280.m: Covered thus like a lump of clay on all sides, the wise one, / enclosed by the anthill, practiced severe austerity. (11)

16.280.s:
athāsya yātakālasya śaryātirnāma pārthivaḥ ..
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena śrīsomeśadidṛkṣayā ..
ājagāma mahākṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ pāpanāśanam .. 12 ..
16.280.d:
अथास्य यातकालस्य शर्यातिर्नाम पार्थिवः ..
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन श्रीसोमेशदिदृक्षया ..
आजगाम महाक्षेत्रं प्रभासं पापनाशनम् .. 12 ..
16.280.m: Now as this time passed, a king named Śaryāti, / in the course of a pilgrimage to sacred fords, wishing to see glorious Someśa, / came to the great sacred field of Prabhāsa, which destroys sins. (12)

16.280.s:
tasya strīṇāṃ sahasrāṇi catvāryāsanparigrahāḥ ..
ekaiva tu sutā śubhrā sukanyānāma nāmataḥ .. .. 13 ..
16.280.d:
तस्य स्त्रीणां सहस्राणि चत्वार्यासन्परिग्रहाः ..
एकैव तु सुता शुभ्रा सुकन्यानाम नामतः .. .. 13 ..
16.280.m: His wives taken in marriage were four thousand [in number]; / but he had only one radiant daughter, Sukanyā by name. (13)

16.280.s:
sā sakhībhiḥ parivṛtā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā ..
caṃkramyamāṇā valmīkaṃ bhārgavasya samāsadat .. 14 ..
16.280.d:
सा सखीभिः परिवृता सर्वाभरणभूषिता ..
चंक्रम्यमाणा वल्मीकं भार्गवस्य समासदत् .. 14 ..
16.280.m: Surrounded by her female companions, adorned with all ornaments, / wandering about, she approached the anthill of the Bhārgava. (14)

16.280.s:
sā caiva sudatī tatra paśyamānā manoramān ..
vanaspatīnvicinvaṃtī vijahāra sakhīvṛtā .. 15 ..
16.280.d:
सा चैव सुदती तत्र पश्यमाना मनोरमान् ..
वनस्पतीन्विचिन्वंती विजहार सखीवृता .. 15 ..
16.280.m: And she of beautiful teeth, gazing at delightful / forest trees and gathering [flowers] there, sported surrounded by friends. (15)

16.280.s:
rūpeṇa vayasā caiva surāpānamadena ca ..
babhaṃja vanavṛkṣāṇāṃ śākhāḥ parama puṣpitāḥ .. 16 ..
16.280.d:
रूपेण वयसा चैव सुरापानमदेन च ..
बभंज वनवृक्षाणां शाखाः परम पुष्पिताः .. 16 ..
16.280.m: Through her beauty, youth, and the intoxication of drinking liquor, / she broke the richly blossomed branches of the forest trees. (16)

16.280.s:
tāṃ sakhīrahitāmekāmekavastrāmalaṃkṛtām ..
dadarśa bhārgavo dhīmāṃścaraṃtīmiva vidyutam .. 17 ..
16.280.d:
तां सखीरहितामेकामेकवस्त्रामलंकृताम् ..
ददर्श भार्गवो धीमांश्चरंतीमिव विद्युतम् .. 17 ..
16.280.m: The wise Bhārgava saw her, separated from her friends, alone, / dressed in a single garment and adorned, moving like lightning. (17)

16.280.s:
tāṃ paśyamāno vijane sa reme paramadyutiḥ ..
kṣāmakaṇṭhaśca brahmarṣistapobalasamanvitaḥ .. 18 ..
16.280.d:
तां पश्यमानो विजने स रेमे परमद्युतिः ..
क्षामकण्ठश्च ब्रह्मर्षिस्तपोबलसमन्वितः .. 18 ..
16.280.m: Beholding her in the solitary place, he of supreme splendour was delighted; / and the brahmin seer, whose throat was emaciated, was endowed with the power of austerity. (18)

16.280.s:
tāmabhāṣata kalyāṇīṃ sā cāsya na śṛṇoti vai ..
tataḥ sukanyā valmīke dṛṣṭvā bhārgavacakṣuṣī .. 19 ..
16.280.d:
तामभाषत कल्याणीं सा चास्य न शृणोति वै ..
ततः सुकन्या वल्मीके दृष्ट्वा भार्गवचक्षुषी .. 19 ..
16.280.m: He spoke to that auspicious lady, but she did not hear him; / then Sukanyā, having seen the two eyes of the Bhārgava in the anthill, (19)

16.280.s:
kautūhalātkaṇṭakena buddhimohabalātkṛtā ..
kinnu khalvidamityuktvā nirbibhedāsya locane .. 7.1.280.20 ..
16.280.d:
कौतूहलात्कण्टकेन बुद्धिमोहबलात्कृता ..
किन्नु खल्विदमित्युक्त्वा निर्बिभेदास्य लोचने .. 7.1.280.20 ..
16.280.m: out of curiosity, overpowered by the force of deluded thinking, / saying 'What indeed is this?', pierced his two eyes with a thorn. (20)

16.280.s:
akudhyatsa tayā viddho netre paramamanyumān ..
tataḥ śaryātisainyasya śakṛnmūtre samāvṛṇot .. 21 ..
16.280.d:
अकुध्यत्स तया विद्धो नेत्रे परममन्युमान् ..
ततः शर्यातिसैन्यस्य शकृन्मूत्रे समावृणोत् .. 21 ..
16.280.m: Pierced by her in both eyes, he became angry, filled with supreme wrath; / then he obstructed the feces and urine of Śaryāti's army. (21)

16.280.s:
tato ruddhe śakṛnmūtre sainyamānāhaduḥkhitam ..
tathāgatamabhibhekṣya paryatapyata pārthivaḥ .. 22 ..
16.280.d:
ततो रुद्धे शकृन्मूत्रे सैन्यमानाहदुःखितम् ..
तथागतमभिभेक्ष्य पर्यतप्यत पार्थिवः .. 22 ..
16.280.m: Then, with feces and urine obstructed, the army was afflicted with constipation; / having observed it reduced to such a condition, the king was deeply distressed. (22)

16.280.s:
taponityasya vṛddhasya roṣaṇasya viśeṣataḥ ..
kenāpakṛtamadyeha bhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ ..
jñātaṃ vā yadi vā'jñātaṃ tadidaṃ brūta mā ciram.. 23 ..
16.280.d:
तपोनित्यस्य वृद्धस्य रोषणस्य विशेषतः ..
केनापकृतमद्येह भार्गवस्य महात्मनः ..
ज्ञातं वा यदि वाऽज्ञातं तदिदं ब्रूत मा चिरम्.. 23 ..
16.280.m: 'Who here today has wronged the great-souled Bhārgava, / who is constant in austerity, aged, and particularly prone to anger? / Whether known or unknown, speak this without delay!' (23)

16.280.s:
tatrocuḥ sainikāḥ sarve na vidmo'pakṛtaṃ vayam ..
sarvopāyairyathākāmaṃ bhavānsamadhigacchatu .. 24 ..
16.280.d:
तत्रोचुः सैनिकाः सर्वे न विद्मोऽपकृतं वयम् ..
सर्वोपायैर्यथाकामं भवान्समधिगच्छतु .. 24 ..
16.280.m: There all the soldiers said: 'We do not know of any offence; / may your majesty discover it by every means according to your desire.' (24)

16.280.s:
tataḥ sa pṛthivīpālaḥ sāmnā cogreṇa ca svayam ..
paryapṛcchatsuhṛdvargaṃ pratyajānanna caiva te .. 25 ..
16.280.d:
ततः स पृथिवीपालः साम्ना चोग्रेण च स्वयम् ..
पर्यपृच्छत्सुहृद्वर्गं प्रत्यजानन्न चैव ते .. 25 ..
16.280.m: Then that protector of the earth questioned his group of friends himself, both gently and sternly; / but they too did not know.

16.280.s:
ānāhārttaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā tatsainyaṃ saṃmukhoditam..
pitaraṃ duḥkhitaṃ cāpi sukanyaivamathābravīt .. 26 ..
16.280.d:
आनाहार्त्तं ततो दृष्ट्वा तत्सैन्यं संमुखोदितम्..
पितरं दुःखितं चापि सुकन्यैवमथाब्रवीत् .. 26 ..
16.280.m: Then, seeing that army distressed with constipation and standing before him, / and also her father sorrowful, Sukanyā said:

16.280.s:
mayā tāteha valmīke dṛṣṭaṃ sarvamabhijvalat ..
uddyotavadavijñānāttanmayā viddhamantikāt .. 27 ..
16.280.d:
मया तातेह वल्मीके दृष्टं सर्वमभिज्वलत् ..
उद्द्योतवदविज्ञानात्तन्मया विद्धमन्तिकात् .. 27 ..
16.280.m: "Father, here in an anthill I saw something blazing brightly all around / like a light. Out of ignorance, I pierced it up close."

16.280.s:
etacchrutvā tu śaryāti rvalmīkaṃ kṣipramabhyagāt..
tatrāpaśyattapovṛddhaṃ vayovṛddhaṃ ca bhārgavam .. 28 ..
16.280.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु शर्याति र्वल्मीकं क्षिप्रमभ्यगात्..
तत्रापश्यत्तपोवृद्धं वयोवृद्धं च भार्गवम् .. 28 ..
16.280.m: Hearing this, Śaryāti went quickly to the anthill; / there he saw the descendant of Bhṛgu, aged in austerity and advanced in years.

16.280.s:
athāvadatsvasainyārthaṃ prāṃjaliḥ sa mahīpatiḥ ..
ajñānādbālayā yatte kṛtaṃ tatkṣaṃtumarhasi .. 29 ..
16.280.d:
अथावदत्स्वसैन्यार्थं प्रांजलिः स महीपतिः ..
अज्ञानाद्बालया यत्ते कृतं तत्क्षंतुमर्हसि .. 29 ..
16.280.m: Then that king, with joined palms, spoke for the sake of his army: / "You ought to forgive what was done out of ignorance by the young girl."

16.280.s:
tato'bravīnmahīpālaṃ cyavano bhārgavastadā ..
rūpaudāryasamāyuktāṃ lobhamohasamāvṛtām .. 7.1.280.30 ..
16.280.d:
ततोऽब्रवीन्महीपालं च्यवनो भार्गवस्तदा ..
रूपौदार्यसमायुक्तां लोभमोहसमावृताम् .. 7.1.280.30 ..
16.280.m: Then the descendant of Bhṛgu, Cyavana, said to the protector of the earth: / "[Your daughter,] endowed with beauty and generosity, [though now] overcome with greed and delusion—

16.280.s:
tāmeva pratigṛhyāhaṃ rājanduhitaraṃ tava ..
kṣamiṣyāmi mahīpāla satyametadbravīmi te .. 31 ..
16.280.d:
तामेव प्रतिगृह्याहं राजन्दुहितरं तव ..
क्षमिष्यामि महीपाल सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते .. 31 ..
16.280.m: only after accepting that daughter of yours, O king, / will I forgive [you], O protector of the earth. This I say to you in truth."

16.280.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ṛṣervacanamājñāya śaryātiravicārayan..
dadau duhitaraṃ tasmai cyavanāya mahātmane .. 32 ..
16.280.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ऋषेर्वचनमाज्ञाय शर्यातिरविचारयन्..
ददौ दुहितरं तस्मै च्यवनाय महात्मने .. 32 ..
16.280.m: Īśvara said: / Learning the seer's word, Śaryāti, without hesitating, / gave his daughter to that great-souled Cyavana.

16.280.s:
pratigṛhya ca tāṃ kanyāṃ bhagavānprasasāda ha ..
prāpte prasāde rājā tu sasainyaḥ puramāvrajat .. 33 ..
16.280.d:
प्रतिगृह्य च तां कन्यां भगवान्प्रससाद ह ..
प्राप्ते प्रसादे राजा तु ससैन्यः पुरमाव्रजत् .. 33 ..
16.280.m: And having accepted that maiden, the blessed one was pleased. / When favor was obtained, the king went to his city together with his army.

16.280.s:
sukanyāpi patiṃ labdhvā tapasvinamaninditam ..
nityaṃ paryacaratprītyā tapasā niyamena ca .. 34 ..
16.280.d:
सुकन्यापि पतिं लब्ध्वा तपस्विनमनिन्दितम् ..
नित्यं पर्यचरत्प्रीत्या तपसा नियमेन च .. 34 ..
16.280.m: Sukanyā too, having gained an unblemished ascetic as her husband, / constantly served him with love, austerity, and observance.

16.280.s:
agnīnāmatithīnāṃ ca śuśrūṣuranasūyayā ..
samārādhayata kṣipraṃ cyavanaṃ sā śubhānanā .. 35 ..
16.280.d:
अग्नीनामतिथीनां च शुश्रूषुरनसूयया ..
समाराधयत क्षिप्रं च्यवनं सा शुभानना .. 35 ..
16.280.m: Attentive to the fires and guests, without jealousy, / that fair-faced woman quickly gratified Cyavana.

16.280.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye cyavaneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 280 ..
16.280.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभास क्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये च्यवनेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाशीत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 280 ..
16.280.m: Thus ends the two hundred and eightieth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Cyavaneśvara', in the first [sub-section], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.281.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya tridaśāvaśvinau priye ..
kṛtābhiṣekāṃ vivṛtāṃ sukanyāṃ tāmapaśyatām .. 1 ..
16.281.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य त्रिदशावश्विनौ प्रिये ..
कृताभिषेकां विवृतां सुकन्यां तामपश्यताम् .. 1 ..
16.281.m: Īśvara said: / Then, at some time, O dear one, the two gods, the Aśvins, / saw that Sukanyā, who had completed her bath and was unveiled.

16.281.s:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā darśanīyāṃgīṃ devarājasutāmiva ..
ūcatuḥ samabhidrutya nāsatyāvaśvināvatha .. 2 ..
16.281.d:
तां दृष्ट्वा दर्शनीयांगीं देवराजसुतामिव ..
ऊचतुः समभिद्रुत्य नासत्यावश्विनावथ .. 2 ..
16.281.m: Seeing her with lovely limbs, like the daughter of the king of gods, / the two Nāsatyas, the Aśvins, ran up and said:

16.281.s:
kasya tvamasi vāmoru kiṃ vane'smiṃścikīrṣasi..
icchāvastvāṃ ca vijñātuṃ tattvamākhyāhi śobhane .. 3 ..
16.281.d:
कस्य त्वमसि वामोरु किं वनेऽस्मिंश्चिकीर्षसि..
इच्छावस्त्वां च विज्ञातुं तत्त्वमाख्याहि शोभने .. 3 ..
16.281.m: "Whose [daughter or wife] are you, O fair-thighed one? What do you wish to do in this forest? / We wish to know you. Tell us the truth, O fair one."

16.281.s:
tataḥ sukanyā saṃvītā tāvuvāca surottamau ..
śaryātitanayāṃ vittaṃ bhāryāṃ ca cyavanasya mām .. 4 ..
16.281.d:
ततः सुकन्या संवीता तावुवाच सुरोत्तमौ ..
शर्यातितनयां वित्तं भार्यां च च्यवनस्य माम् .. 4 ..
16.281.m: Then Sukanyā, covering herself, said to the two best of gods: / "Know me as the daughter of Śaryāti and the wife of Cyavana."

16.281.s:
tato'śvinau prahasyaināmabrūtāṃ punareva tu ..
kathaṃ tvaṃ ca viditvā tu pitrā dattā''gatā vane .. 5 ..
16.281.d:
ततोऽश्विनौ प्रहस्यैनामब्रूतां पुनरेव तु ..
