कथं त्वं च विदित्वा तु पित्रा दत्ता'ऽगता वने .. 5 ..
16.281.m: Then the Aśvins laughed and spoke to her again: / "How is it that, with understanding, given by your father, you have come to the forest?

16.281.s:
bhrājase gaganoddeśe vidyutsaudāmanī yathā ..
na deveṣvapi tulyāṃ hi tava paśyāva bhāmini .. 6 ..
16.281.d:
भ्राजसे गगनोद्देशे विद्युत्सौदामनी यथा ..
न देवेष्वपि तुल्यां हि तव पश्याव भामिनि .. 6 ..
16.281.m: You shine like lightning in the sky! / Indeed, even among goddesses we see none equal to you, O lovely lady!

16.281.s:
sarvābharaṇasaṃpannā paramāṃbaradhāriṇī ..
māmaivamanavadyāṃgi tyajainamavivekinam .. 7 ..
16.281.d:
सर्वाभरणसंपन्ना परमांबरधारिणी ..
मामैवमनवद्यांगि त्यजैनमविवेकिनम् .. 7 ..
16.281.m: Endowed with all ornaments, wearing the finest garments! / Do not [remain] thus, O flawless-limbed one; abandon this foolish man!

16.281.s:
kasmādevaṃvidhā bhūtvā jarājarjaritaṃ bhuvi ..
tvamupāsye hi kalyāṇi kāmabhāvabahiṣkṛtam .. 8 ..
16.281.d:
कस्मादेवंविधा भूत्वा जराजर्जरितं भुवि ..
त्वमुपास्ये हि कल्याणि कामभावबहिष्कृतम् .. 8 ..
16.281.m: Why, being of such a kind, do you serve on earth / one worn out by old age and devoid of the capacity for desire, O auspicious one,

16.281.s:
asamarthaṃ paritrāṇe poṣaṇe vā śucismite ..
sā tvaṃ cyavanamutsṛjya varayasvaikamāvayoḥ .. 9 ..
16.281.d:
असमर्थं परित्राणे पोषणे वा शुचिस्मिते ..
सा त्वं च्यवनमुत्सृज्य वरयस्वैकमावयोः .. 9 ..
16.281.m: incapable of protecting or supporting [you], O sweet-smiling lady? / So you, abandoning Cyavana, choose one of us two

16.281.s:
patyarthaṃ devagarbhābhe mā vṛthā yauvanaṃ kṛthāḥ ..
evamuktā sukanyā sā surau tāvidamabravīt ..7.1.281.10 ..
16.281.d:
पत्यर्थं देवगर्भाभे मा वृथा यौवनं कृथाः ..
एवमुक्ता सुकन्या सा सुरौ ताविदमब्रवीत् ..7.1.281.10 ..
16.281.m: for a husband, O woman resembling the offspring of gods! Do not waste your youth!" / Spoken to thus, that Sukanyā said to the two gods:

16.281.s:
ratā'haṃ cyavane patyau na caivaṃ pariśaṃkatam ..
tāvabrūtāṃ punaścaitāmāvāṃ devabhiṣagvarau .. 11 ..
16.281.d:
रताऽहं च्यवने पत्यौ न चैवं परिशंकतम् ..
तावब्रूतां पुनश्चैतामावां देवभिषग्वरौ .. 11 ..
16.281.m: "I am devoted to my husband Cyavana; do not doubt thus." / And the two said to her again: "We are the two best physicians of the gods.

16.281.s:
yuvānaṃ rūpasaṃpannaṃ kariṣyāvaḥ patiṃ tava ..
tatastasyāvayoścaiva patimekatamaṃ vṛṇu .. 12 ..
16.281.d:
युवानं रूपसंपन्नं करिष्यावः पतिं तव ..
ततस्तस्यावयोश्चैव पतिमेकतमं वृणु .. 12 ..
16.281.m: We shall make your husband youthful and endowed with beauty; / then choose one of him and the two of us as your husband.

16.281.s:
etena samayenāvāṃ śamaṃ naya sumadhyame ..
sā tayorvacanāddevi upasaṃgamya bhārgavam ..
uvāca vākyaṃ yattābhyāmuktaṃ bhṛgusutaṃ prati .. 13 ..
16.281.d:
एतेन समयेनावां शमं नय सुमध्यमे ..
सा तयोर्वचनाद्देवि उपसंगम्य भार्गवम् ..
उवाच वाक्यं यत्ताभ्यामुक्तं भृगुसुतं प्रति .. 13 ..
16.281.m: By this agreement, bring us satisfaction, O woman of slender waist!" / At their word, O goddess, she approached the descendant of Bhṛgu / and spoke the word which had been said by the two to the son of Bhṛgu.

16.281.s:
tadvākyaṃ cyavano bhāryāmuvācādriyatāmiti ..
ityuktā cyavanenātha sukanyā tāvuvāca vai .. 14 ..
16.281.d:
तद्वाक्यं च्यवनो भार्यामुवाचाद्रियतामिति ..
इत्युक्ता च्यवनेनाथ सुकन्या तावुवाच वै .. 14 ..
16.281.m: To that statement, Cyavana said to his wife: "Let it be accepted!" / Spoken to thus by Cyavana, Sukanyā then indeed said to the two:

16.281.s:
evaṃ devau bhavadbhyāṃ yatproktaṃ tatkiyatāṃ laghu ..
ityuktau bhiṣajau tatra tayā caiva sukanyayā ..
ūcatū rājaputrīṃ tāṃ patistava viśatvapaḥ .. 15 ..
16.281.d:
एवं देवौ भवद्भ्यां यत्प्रोक्तं तत्कियतां लघु ..
इत्युक्तौ भिषजौ तत्र तया चैव सुकन्यया ..
ऊचतू राजपुत्रीं तां पतिस्तव विशत्वपः .. 15 ..
16.281.m: "O gods, let what was promised by you be done quickly." / Addressed thus by that Sukanyā, the two physicians / said to that princess: "Let your husband enter the water."

16.281.s:
tato'paścyavanaḥ śīghraṃ rūpārthī praviveśa ha ..
aśvināvapi taddevi tataḥ prāviśatāṃ jalam .. 16 ..
16.281.d:
ततोऽपश्च्यवनः शीघ्रं रूपार्थी प्रविवेश ह ..
अश्विनावपि तद्देवि ततः प्राविशतां जलम् .. 16 ..
16.281.m: Then Cyavana, desiring beauty, quickly entered the water. / The Aśvins too, O goddess, then entered the water.

16.281.s:
tato muhūrttāduttīrṇāḥ sarve te sarasastataḥ ..
divyarūpadharāḥ sarve yuvāno mṛṣṭakuṇḍalāḥ .. 17 ..
16.281.d:
ततो मुहूर्त्तादुत्तीर्णाः सर्वे ते सरसस्ततः ..
दिव्यरूपधराः सर्वे युवानो मृष्टकुण्डलाः .. 17 ..
16.281.m: Then after a moment they all emerged from that lake, / all having celestial forms, youthful, with polished earrings,

16.281.s:
divyaveṣadharāścaiva manasaḥ prītivarddhanāḥ ..
te'bruvansahitāḥ sarve vṛṇīṣvānyatamaṃ śubhe .. 18 ..
16.281.d:
दिव्यवेषधराश्चैव मनसः प्रीतिवर्द्धनाः ..
तेऽब्रुवन्सहिताः सर्वे वृणीष्वान्यतमं शुभे .. 18 ..
16.281.m: wearing celestial dress, and enhancing delight of the mind. / They all together said: "Choose any one, O fair one!

16.281.s:
asmākamīpsitaṃ bhadre yatastvaṃ varavarṇinī ..
yatra vāpyabhi kāmāsi taṃ vṛṇīṣva suśobhane .. 19 ..
16.281.d:
अस्माकमीप्सितं भद्रे यतस्त्वं वरवर्णिनी ..
यत्र वाप्यभि कामासि तं वृणीष्व सुशोभने .. 19 ..
16.281.m: You are desired by us, O fair lady of excellent complexion! / Or wherever your love lies, choose him, O very beautiful woman!"

16.281.s:
sā samīkṣya tu tānsarvāṃstulyarūpadharānsthitān ..
niścitya manasā buddhyā devi vavre patiṃ svakam .. 7.1.281.20 ..
16.281.d:
सा समीक्ष्य तु तान्सर्वांस्तुल्यरूपधरान्स्थितान् ..
निश्चित्य मनसा बुद्ध्या देवि वव्रे पतिं स्वकम् .. 7.1.281.20 ..
16.281.m: Looking upon them all standing endowed with identical forms, / having determined with her mind and intellect, O goddess, she chose her own husband.

16.281.s:
labdhvā tu cyavano bhāryāṃ vayorūpamavasthitaḥ ..
hṛṣṭo'bravīnmahātejāstau nāsatyāvidaṃ vacaḥ .. 21 ..
16.281.d:
लब्ध्वा तु च्यवनो भार्यां वयोरूपमवस्थितः ..
हृष्टोऽब्रवीन्महातेजास्तौ नासत्याविदं वचः .. 21 ..
16.281.m: Having obtained his wife, and established in youth and beauty, / Cyavana of great splendor, rejoiced, spoke these words to the two Nāsatyas:

16.281.s:
yadahaṃ rūpasaṃpanno vayasā ca samanvitaḥ ..
kṛto bhavadbhyāṃ vṛddhaḥ sanbhāryāṃ ca prāptavānnijām ..
tadbrūtaṃ vai vidhāsyāmi bhavatoryadabhīpsitam .. 22 ..
16.281.d:
यदहं रूपसंपन्नो वयसा च समन्वितः ..
कृतो भवद्भ्यां वृद्धः सन्भार्यां च प्राप्तवान्निजाम् ..
तद्ब्रूतं वै विधास्यामि भवतोर्यदभीप्सितम् .. 22 ..
16.281.m: "Since, though old, I have been made endowed with beauty and endowed with youth by you, / and have obtained my own wife, / therefore speak! I will accomplish whatever is desired by you two."

16.281.s:
.. aśvināvūcatuḥ .. ..
āvāṃ tu devabhiṣajau na ca śakraḥ karoti nau ..
somapānārhatāṃ tasmātkuru nau somapāyinau .. 23 ..
16.281.d:
.. अश्विनावूचतुः .. ..
आवां तु देवभिषजौ न च शक्रः करोति नौ ..
सोमपानार्हतां तस्मात्कुरु नौ सोमपायिनौ .. 23 ..
16.281.m: The two Aśvins said: / "We are the two physicians of the gods, and Śakra does not grant us / eligibility to drink soma; therefore, make us two drinkers of soma."

16.281.s:
.. cyavana uvāca .. ..
ahaṃ vāṃ yajñabhāgārhau kariṣye somapāyinau .. 24 ..
16.281.d:
.. च्यवन उवाच .. ..
अहं वां यज्ञभागार्हौ करिष्ये सोमपायिनौ .. 24 ..
16.281.m: Cyavana said: / "I shall make you two drinkers of soma, worthy of a share in the sacrifice."

16.281.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatastau hṛṣṭamanasau nāsatyau divi jagmatuḥ ..
cyavano'pi sukanyā ca surāviva vijahratuḥ .. 25 ..
16.281.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततस्तौ हृष्टमनसौ नासत्यौ दिवि जग्मतुः ..
च्यवनोऽपि सुकन्या च सुराविव विजह्रतुः .. 25 ..
16.281.m: Īśvara said: / Then, with delighted minds, the two Nāsatyas went to heaven; / Cyavana and Sukanyā also sported like two gods.

16.281.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye cyavaneśvara māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikāśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 281 ..
16.281.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये च्यवनेश्वर माहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकाशीत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 281 ..
16.281.m: Thus ends the two hundred and eighty-first chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Cyavaneśvara', in the first [sub-section], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.282.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tataḥ śrutvā ca śaryātirvalabhīsthāna saṃsthitaḥ ..
vayasthaṃ cyavanaṃ śrutvā ānandodgatamānasaḥ .. 1 ..
16.282.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततः श्रुत्वा च शर्यातिर्वलभीस्थान संस्थितः ..
वयस्थं च्यवनं श्रुत्वा आनन्दोद्गतमानसः .. 1 ..
16.282.m: Īśvara said: / Then Śaryāti, residing at the place of Valabhī, having heard— / having heard that Cyavana was restored to youth, his mind filled with joy—

16.282.s:
prahṛṣṭaḥ senayā sārddhaṃ sa prāyādbhārgavāśramam ..
cyavanaṃ ca sukanyāṃ ca hṛṣṭāṃ deva sutāmiva .. 2 ..
16.282.d:
प्रहृष्टः सेनया सार्द्धं स प्रायाद्भार्गवाश्रमम् ..
च्यवनं च सुकन्यां च हृष्टां देव सुतामिव .. 2 ..
16.282.m: overjoyed, set out with his army for the hermitage of the descendant of Bhṛgu, / [to see] Cyavana and Sukanyā, who was delighted like a daughter of the gods.

16.282.s:
gato mahīpaḥ śaryātiḥ kṛtsnānaṃdamahodadhiḥ ..
ṛṣiṇā satkṛtastena sabhāryaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ..
tatropaviṣṭaḥ kalyāṇīḥ kathāścakre mahāmanāḥ .. 3 ..
16.282.d:
गतो महीपः शर्यातिः कृत्स्नानंदमहोदधिः ..
ऋषिणा सत्कृतस्तेन सभार्यः पृथिवीपतिः ..
तत्रोपविष्टः कल्याणीः कथाश्चक्रे महामनाः .. 3 ..
16.282.m: The king Śaryāti went, an ocean of complete bliss; / honoured by that seer, the lord of the earth along with his wife / sat there and engaged in auspicious conversations, being noble-minded.

16.282.s:
athainaṃ bhārgavo devi hyuvāca parisāṃtvayan ..
yājayiṣyāmi rājaṃstvāṃ saṃbhārānupakalpaya .. 4 ..
16.282.d:
अथैनं भार्गवो देवि ह्युवाच परिसांत्वयन् ..
याजयिष्यामि राजंस्त्वां संभारानुपकल्पय .. 4 ..
16.282.m: Then, O goddess, the Bhārgava addressed him consolingly: / 'O king, I will officiate at a sacrifice for you; prepare the sacrificial provisions.'

16.282.s:
tataḥ paramasaṃhṛṣṭaḥ śaryātiḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ..
cyavanasya mahādevi tadvākyaṃ pratyapūjayat .. 5 ..
16.282.d:
ततः परमसंहृष्टः शर्यातिः पृथिवीपतिः ..
च्यवनस्य महादेवि तद्वाक्यं प्रत्यपूजयत् .. 5 ..
16.282.m: Then the lord of the earth, Śaryāti, was exceedingly delighted, / O great goddess, and revered those words of Cyavana.

16.282.s:
praśaste'hani yājñīye sarvakāmasamṛddhimat ..
kārayāmāsa śaryātiryajñāyatanamuttamam .. 6 ..
16.282.d:
प्रशस्तेऽहनि याज्ञीये सर्वकामसमृद्धिमत् ..
कारयामास शर्यातिर्यज्ञायतनमुत्तमम् .. 6 ..
16.282.m: On an auspicious day suitable for sacrifice, fulfilling all desires, / Śaryāti caused an excellent sacrificial pavilion to be erected.

16.282.s:
tatraiva cyavano devi yājayāmāsa bhārgavam ..
adbhutāni ca tatrāsanyāni tāni maheśvari .. 7 ..
16.282.d:
तत्रैव च्यवनो देवि याजयामास भार्गवम् ..
अद्भुतानि च तत्रासन्यानि तानि महेश्वरि .. 7 ..
16.282.m: Right there, O goddess, Cyavana, the Bhārgava, officiated as priest; / and there occurred wonders, O great goddess, which were [remarkable].

16.282.s:
agṛhṇāccyavanaḥ somamaśvinordevayostadā ..
tamindro vārayāmāsa mā gṛhāṇa tayorgraham .. 8...
.. indra uvāca .. ..
ubhāvetau na somārhau nāsatyāviti me matiḥ ..
bhiṣajau devatānāṃ hi karmaṇā tena garhitau .. 9 ..
16.282.d:
अगृह्णाच्च्यवनः सोममश्विनोर्देवयोस्तदा ..
तमिन्द्रो वारयामास मा गृहाण तयोर्ग्रहम् .. 8...
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
उभावेतौ न सोमार्हौ नासत्याविति मे मतिः ..
भिषजौ देवतानां हि कर्मणा तेन गर्हितौ .. 9 ..
16.282.m: Cyavana then took the soma draught for the two gods, the Aśvins; / Indra prevented him: 'Do not take a cup for those two!' / Indra said: / 'These two are not worthy of soma, the two Nāsatyas—such is my view. / For they are the physicians of the gods, despised on account of that occupation.'

16.282.s:
.. cyavana uvāca .. ..
mā'vamaṃsthā mahātmānau rūpadraviṇavarcasau ..
yau cakratuśca māmadya vṛṃdārakamivājaram .. 7.1.282.10 ..
16.282.d:
.. च्यवन उवाच .. ..
माऽवमंस्था महात्मानौ रूपद्रविणवर्चसौ ..
यौ चक्रतुश्च मामद्य वृंदारकमिवाजरम् .. 7.1.282.10 ..
16.282.m: Cyavana said: / 'Do not disrespect these two great-souled ones, endowed with beauty, wealth, and radiance, / who today have made me ageless like a god!

16.282.s:
samatvenānyadevānāṃ kathaṃ vai nekṣate bhavān..
aśvināvapi devendra devau viddhi paraṃtapa .. 11 ..
16.282.d:
समत्वेनान्यदेवानां कथं वै नेक्षते भवान्..
अश्विनावपि देवेन्द्र देवौ विद्धि परंतप .. 11 ..
16.282.m: Why indeed do you not look upon them as equal to the other gods? / Know the Aśvins also to be gods, O lord of gods, O scorcher of foes!'

16.282.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
cikitsakau karmakarau kāmarūpasamanvitau ..
loke caraṃtau martyānāṃ kathaṃ somamihārhataḥ .. 12 ..
16.282.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
चिकित्सकौ कर्मकरौ कामरूपसमन्वितौ ..
लोके चरंतौ मर्त्यानां कथं सोममिहार्हतः .. 12 ..
16.282.m: Indra said: / 'As healers, menial workers, shapeshifters, / wandering about in the world of mortals, how do they deserve soma here?'

16.282.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
etadeva yadā vākyamāmreḍayati vāsavaḥ ..
anādṛtya tataḥ śakraṃ grahaṃ jagrāha bhārgavaḥ .. 13 ..
16.282.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एतदेव यदा वाक्यमाम्रेडयति वासवः ..
अनादृत्य ततः शक्रं ग्रहं जग्राह भार्गवः .. 13 ..
16.282.m: Īśvara said: / When Vāsava repeated that very same statement, / the Bhārgava disregarded Śakra and took up the cup.

16.282.s:
grahīṣyaṃtaṃ tataḥ somamaśvinoḥ sattamaṃ tadā ..
samīkṣya balabhiddeva idaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 14 ..
16.282.d:
ग्रहीष्यंतं ततः सोममश्विनोः सत्तमं तदा ..
समीक्ष्य बलभिद्देव इदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 14 ..
16.282.m: Seeing that the best of beings was about to take soma for the two Aśvins, / the god Balabhid then uttered this speech:

16.282.s:
ābhyāmarthāya somaṃ tvaṃ grahīṣyasi yadi svayam ..
vajraṃ te prahariṣyāmi ghorarūpamanuttamam .. 15 ..
16.282.d:
आभ्यामर्थाय सोमं त्वं ग्रहीष्यसि यदि स्वयम् ..
वज्रं ते प्रहरिष्यामि घोररूपमनुत्तमम् .. 15 ..
16.282.m: 'If you yourself take soma for the sake of these two, / I will strike you with my fierce, peerless thunderbolt!'

16.282.s:
evamuktaḥ svayamindramabhivīkṣya sa bhārgavaḥ ..
jagrāha vidhivatsomamaśvibhyāmuttamaṃ graham .. 16 ..
16.282.d:
एवमुक्तः स्वयमिन्द्रमभिवीक्ष्य स भार्गवः ..
जग्राह विधिवत्सोममश्विभ्यामुत्तमं ग्रहम् .. 16 ..
16.282.m: Thus addressed, looking straight at Indra, the Bhārgava / took up according to rule the excellent cup of soma for the two Aśvins.

16.282.s:
tato'smai prāharatkopādvajramiṃdraḥ śacīpatiḥ ..
tasya praharato bāhuṃ staṃbhayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ .. 17 ..
16.282.d:
ततोऽस्मै प्राहरत्कोपाद्वज्रमिंद्रः शचीपतिः ..
तस्य प्रहरतो बाहुं स्तंभयामास भार्गवः .. 17 ..
16.282.m: Then Indra, the husband of Śacī, hurled his thunderbolt at him in anger; / as he was striking, the Bhārgava paralysed his arm.

16.282.s:
staṃbhayitvātha cyavano juhuve mantrato'nalam ..
kṛtyārthī sumahātejā devaṃ hiṃsitumudyataḥ .. 18 ..
16.282.d:
स्तंभयित्वाथ च्यवनो जुहुवे मन्त्रतोऽनलम् ..
कृत्यार्थी सुमहातेजा देवं हिंसितुमुद्यतः .. 18 ..
16.282.m: Having paralysed [it], Cyavana then made an offering into the fire with mantras; / seeking an act of destruction, having exceedingly great splendour, he prepared to strike down the god.

16.282.s:
tatra kṛtyodbhavo yajñe munestasya tapobalāt ..
madonāma mahāvīryo mahākāyo mahāsuraḥ .. 19 ..
16.282.d:
तत्र कृत्योद्भवो यज्ञे मुनेस्तस्य तपोबलात् ..
मदोनाम महावीर्यो महाकायो महासुरः .. 19 ..
16.282.m: There arose in that sacrifice, from that sage's power of austerity, a destructive spirit / named Mada, of great prowess, of gigantic body, a great asura,

16.282.s:
śarīraṃ yasya nirdeṣṭumaśakyaṃ ca surāsuraiḥ ..
tasya pramāṇaṃ vapuṣā na tulyamiha vidyate .. 7.1.282.20 ..
16.282.d:
शरीरं यस्य निर्देष्टुमशक्यं च सुरासुरैः ..
तस्य प्रमाणं वपुषा न तुल्यमिह विद्यते .. 7.1.282.20 ..
16.282.m: whose body gods and asuras were unable even to measure; / there existed no equal to the size of his physical form here.

16.282.s:
tasyāsyaṃ cābhavedghoraṃ daṃṣṭrā durdarśanaṃ mahat ..
hanurekaḥ sthitastasya bhūmāveko divaṃ gataḥ .. 21 ..
16.282.d:
तस्यास्यं चाभवेद्घोरं दंष्ट्रा दुर्दर्शनं महत् ..
हनुरेकः स्थितस्तस्य भूमावेको दिवं गतः .. 21 ..
16.282.m: His mouth was dreadful, fearsome to behold with large fangs; / one of his jaws rested on the earth, and one reached to heaven.

16.282.s:
catasraścāpi tā daṃṣṭrā yojanānāṃ śataṃśatam ..
itare tvasya daśanā babhūburdaśayojanāḥ ..22 ..
16.282.d:
चतस्रश्चापि ता दंष्ट्रा योजनानां शतंशतम् ..
इतरे त्वस्य दशना बभूबुर्दशयोजनाः ..22 ..
16.282.m: His four fangs each measured a hundred yojanas, / while his other teeth were ten yojanas [long],

16.282.s:
prākārasadṛśākārā mūlāgrasamadarśanāḥ ..
nāmnā parvatasaṃkāśāścāyutāyutayojanāḥ .. 23 ..
16.282.d:
प्राकारसदृशाकारा मूलाग्रसमदर्शनाः ..
नाम्ना पर्वतसंकाशाश्चायुतायुतयोजनाः .. 23 ..
16.282.m: resembling city ramparts in shape, uniform from root to tip, / resembling mountains by description, ten thousand yojanas [in extent].

16.282.s:
netre raviśaśiprakhye bhruvāvaṃtakasannibhe ..
lelihajjihvayā vaktraṃ vidyuccalitalolayā ..
vyāttānano ghoradṛṣṭirgrasanniva jagadbalāt .. 24 ..
16.282.d:
नेत्रे रविशशिप्रख्ये भ्रुवावंतकसन्निभे ..
लेलिहज्जिह्वया वक्त्रं विद्युच्चलितलोलया ..
व्यात्ताननो घोरदृष्टिर्ग्रसन्निव जगद्बलात् .. 24 ..
16.282.m: His eyes were like the sun and moon; his brows resembled the God of Death; / he licked his mouth with a flickering tongue moving like lightning; / with gaping jaws and a dreadful gaze, he was as if forcibly devouring the world.

16.282.s:
sa bhakṣayiṣyansaṃkruddhaḥ śatakratumupādravat ..
mahatā ghoranādena lokāñchabdena chādayan .. 25 ..
16.282.d:
स भक्षयिष्यन्संक्रुद्धः शतक्रतुमुपाद्रवत् ..
महता घोरनादेन लोकाञ्छब्देन छादयन् .. 25 ..
16.282.m: Intent on devouring [him], enraged, he rushed at Śatakratu, / covering the worlds with a sound, with a great, dreadful roar.

16.282.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye cyavaneśvaramāhātmye cyavanena nāsatyayajñabhāgapratirodhakavajra mocanodyataśakranāśāya kṛtyodbhavamadanāmakamahā'surotpādanavṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma dvyaśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 282 .. ..
16.282.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये च्यवनेश्वरमाहात्म्ये च्यवनेन नासत्ययज्ञभागप्रतिरोधकवज्र मोचनोद्यतशक्रनाशाय कृत्योद्भवमदनामकमहाऽसुरोत्पादनवृत्तान्तवर्णनंनाम द्व्यशीत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 282 .. ..
16.282.m: Thus ends the two hundred and eighty-second chapter, titled 'The Description of the Account of the Creation of the Great Asura Named Mada through a Destructive Rite to Slay Śakra Who Was Preparing to Hurl His Thunderbolt Obstructing the Sacrificial Portion of the Nāsatyas by Cyavana,' in the Cyavaneśvara-māhātmya, in the First Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya, in the Seventh Prabhāsa-khaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.283.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā ghoravadanaṃ madaṃ devaḥ śatakratuḥ ..
āyāṃtaṃ bhakṣayiṣyantaṃ vyāttānanamivāntakam .. 1 ..
16.283.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तं दृष्ट्वा घोरवदनं मदं देवः शतक्रतुः ..
आयांतं भक्षयिष्यन्तं व्यात्ताननमिवान्तकम् .. 1 ..
16.283.m: Īśvara said: / Seeing that Mada with a terrible mouth approaching, about to devour him, / with his jaws open like the God of Death,

16.283.s:
bhayātstaṃbhitarūpeṇa lelihānaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ..
praṇato'bravīnmahādevi cyavanaṃ bhayapīḍitaḥ .. 2 ..
16.283.d:
भयात्स्तंभितरूपेण लेलिहानं मुहुर्मुहुः ..
प्रणतोऽब्रवीन्महादेवि च्यवनं भयपीडितः .. 2 ..
16.283.m: frightened by his paralysed state, while [the monster] licked his lips again and again, / afflicted by fear, [Indra] bowed down and addressed Cyavana, O great goddess:

16.283.s:
somārhāvaśvināvetāvadyaprabhṛti bhārgava ..
bhaviṣyataḥ sarvametadvacaḥ satyaṃ bravīmi te .. 3 ..
16.283.d:
सोमार्हावश्विनावेतावद्यप्रभृति भार्गव ..
भविष्यतः सर्वमेतद्वचः सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते .. 3 ..
16.283.m: 'From this day forward, these two Aśvins shall be worthy of soma, O Bhārgava; / it will all be so—I speak the truth to you!

16.283.s:
mā te mithyā samārambho bhavatvatha tapodhana ..
jānāmi cāhaṃ viprarṣe na mithyā tvaṃ kariṣyasi .. 4 ..
16.283.d:
मा ते मिथ्या समारम्भो भवत्वथ तपोधन ..
जानामि चाहं विप्रर्षे न मिथ्या त्वं करिष्यसि .. 4 ..
16.283.m: Let your undertaking not prove in vain, O rich in austerity; / and I know, O brahmin seer, that you will not act in vain.

16.283.s:
somārhāvaśvināvetau yathaivādya tvayā kṛtau ..
bhūya eva tu te vīryaṃ prakāśediti bhārgava .. 5 ..
16.283.d:
सोमार्हावश्विनावेतौ यथैवाद्य त्वया कृतौ ..
भूय एव तु ते वीर्यं प्रकाशेदिति भार्गव .. 5 ..
16.283.m: These two Aśvins are worthy of soma, just as they have been made by you today; / but [it was done] so that your prowess might shine forth even more, O Bhārgava,

16.283.s:
sukanyāyāḥ pituścāsya loke kīrtirbhavediti ..
ato mayaitadvihitaṃ tadvīryasya prakāśanam ..
tasmātprasādaṃ kuru me bhavatvetadyathecchasi .. 6 ..
16.283.d:
सुकन्यायाः पितुश्चास्य लोके कीर्तिर्भवेदिति ..
अतो मयैतद्विहितं तद्वीर्यस्य प्रकाशनम् ..
तस्मात्प्रसादं कुरु मे भवत्वेतद्यथेच्छसि .. 6 ..
16.283.m: and so that the father of Sukanyā might gain fame in the world; / therefore this revelation of your prowess was brought about by me. / Therefore show favour to me; let this happen just as you desire.'

16.283.s:
evamuktasya śakreṇa cyavanasya mahātmanaḥ ..
manyurvyupāramacchīghraṃ mānaścaiva sureśituḥ .. 7 ..
16.283.d:
एवमुक्तस्य शक्रेण च्यवनस्य महात्मनः ..
मन्युर्व्युपारमच्छीघ्रं मानश्चैव सुरेशितुः .. 7 ..
16.283.m: When the great-souled Cyavana was thus addressed by Śakra, / his anger subsided quickly, and so too did the pride of the ruler of the gods.

16.283.s:
madaṃ ca vyabhajaddevi pāne strīṣu ca vīryavān ..
akṣeṣu mṛgayāyāṃ ca pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ punaḥpunaḥ ..
tathā madaṃ vinikṣipya śakraṃ saṃtarpya ceṃdunā .. 8 ..
16.283.d:
मदं च व्यभजद्देवि पाने स्त्रीषु च वीर्यवान् ..
अक्षेषु मृगयायां च पूर्वं सृष्टं पुनःपुनः ..
तथा मदं विनिक्षिप्य शक्रं संतर्प्य चेंदुना .. 8 ..
16.283.m: And the powerful one divided Mada, O goddess, which he had created before, / again and again into liquor, women, dice, and hunting; / having thus distributed Mada and having satisfied Śakra with soma,

16.283.s:
aśvibhyāṃ sahitānsarvānyājayitvā ca taṃ nṛpam ..
vikhyāpya vīryaṃ sarveṣu lokeṣu varavarṇini .. 9 ..
16.283.d:
अश्विभ्यां सहितान्सर्वान्याजयित्वा च तं नृपम् ..
विख्याप्य वीर्यं सर्वेषु लोकेषु वरवर्णिनि .. 9 ..
16.283.m: and having officiated at the sacrifice for that king along with all [the gods] including the two Aśvins, / making his prowess renowned across all worlds, O fair-complexioned one,

16.283.s:
sukanyayā mahāraṇye kṣetre'sminvijahāra saḥ ..
tasyaitaddevi saṃyuktaṃ cyavaneśvaranāmabhṛt .. 7.1.283.10 ..
16.283.d:
सुकन्यया महारण्ये क्षेत्रेऽस्मिन्विजहार सः ..
तस्यैतद्देवि संयुक्तं च्यवनेश्वरनामभृत् .. 7.1.283.10 ..
16.283.m: he roamed about with Sukanyā in the great forest in this sacred field. / Connected with him, O goddess, is this [shrine] bearing the name Cyavaneśvara,

16.283.s:
liṃgaṃ mahāpāpaharaṃ cyava nena pratiṣṭhitam ..
pūjayettaṃ vidhānena so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ..11..
16.283.d:
लिंगं महापापहरं च्यव नेन प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
पूजयेत्तं विधानेन सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ..11..
16.283.m: a liṅga removing great sins, installed by Cyavana. / Whoever worships it according to rule obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice.

16.283.s:
tasmāccandramasastīrthamṛṣayaḥ paryupāsate ..
vaikhānasākhyā ṛṣayo vālakhilyāstathaiva ca .. 12 ..
16.283.d:
तस्माच्चन्द्रमसस्तीर्थमृषयः पर्युपासते ..
वैखानसाख्या ऋषयो वालखिल्यास्तथैव च .. 12 ..
16.283.m: Therefore seers wait upon Candramas' sacred ford, / namely the seers called Vaikhānasa and likewise the Vālakhilyas.

16.283.s:
atrāśvine māsi naraḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
śrāddhaṃ kuryādvidhānena brāhmaṇānbhojayetpṛthak ..
koṭitīrthaphalaṃ tasya bhavennai'vātra saṃśayaḥ .. 13 ..
16.283.d:
अत्राश्विने मासि नरः पौर्णमास्यां विशेषतः ..
श्राद्धं कुर्याद्विधानेन ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेत्पृथक् ..
कोटितीर्थफलं तस्य भवेन्नैऽवात्र संशयः .. 13 ..
16.283.m: If a man performs a śrāddha here according to rule, especially on the full-moon day in the month of Āśvina, / and feeds brahmins individually, / his fruit will be equal to ten million sacred fords; there is no doubt about this.

16.283.s:
ya imāṃ śṛṇuyāddevi kathāṃ pātakanāśinīm ..
samastajanmasaṃbhūtātpāpānmukto bhavennaraḥ .. 14 ..
16.283.d:
य इमां शृणुयाद्देवि कथां पातकनाशिनीम् ..
समस्तजन्मसंभूतात्पापान्मुक्तो भवेन्नरः .. 14 ..
16.283.m: Whoever listens to this sin-destroying story, O goddess, / shall become freed from the sins born of all his lifetimes.

16.283.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye cyavaneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tryaśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..283 .. ..
16.283.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये च्यवनेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्र्यशीत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..283 .. ..
16.283.m: Thus ends the two hundred and eighty-third chapter, named 'The Description of the Glory of Cyavaneśvara', in the first [part], the Glory of Prabhāsa Field, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsa Section, in the compilation of eighty-one thousand [verses] in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

16.284.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi sukanyāsara utamam ..
yatrāśvinau nimagnau tau cyavanena sahāṃbike ..
samānarūpo hyabhavaccyavano yatra so'śvinā .. 1 ..
16.284.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि सुकन्यासर उतमम् ..
यत्राश्विनौ निमग्नौ तौ च्यवनेन सहांबिके ..
समानरूपो ह्यभवच्च्यवनो यत्र सोऽश्विना .. 1 ..
16.284.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O great goddess, one should go to the excellent Sukanyāsaras, / where those two Aśvins plunged together with Cyavana, O Ambikā, / and where Cyavana came to have a form identical to that of the Aśvins. // 1

16.284.s:
yatra prāptavatī kāmaṃ sukanyā varavarṇinī ..
saraḥsnānaprabhāvena tena kanyāsaraḥ smṛtam ..
tatra snātā śubhā nārī tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 2 ..
16.284.d:
यत्र प्राप्तवती कामं सुकन्या वरवर्णिनी ..
सरःस्नानप्रभावेन तेन कन्यासरः स्मृतम् ..
तत्र स्नाता शुभा नारी तृतीयायां विशेषतः .. 2 ..
16.284.m: Where Sukanyā, of fair complexion, obtained her desire / through the power of bathing in the pool; therefore it is known as Kanyāsaras. / A virtuous woman who bathes there, especially on the third [lunar day], // 2

16.284.s:
saptajanmasahasrāṇi gṛhabhaṃgaṃ na cāpnuyāt ..
daridro vikalo dīno nāṃdhastasyā bhavetpatiḥ .. 3 ..
16.284.d:
सप्तजन्मसहस्राणि गृहभंगं न चाप्नुयात् ..
दरिद्रो विकलो दीनो नांधस्तस्या भवेत्पतिः .. 3 ..
16.284.m: shall not suffer the ruin of her household for seven thousand births; / nor shall her husband ever be poor, deformed, wretched, or blind. // 3

16.284.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye cyavaneśvaramāhātmye sukanyāsaromāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturaśītyuttara dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 284 ..
16.284.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये च्यवनेश्वरमाहात्म्ये सुकन्यासरोमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुरशीत्युत्तर द्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 284 ..
16.284.m: Thus ends the two hundred and eighty-fourth chapter, named 'The Description of the Glory of Sukanyāsaras in the Glory of Cyavaneśvara', in the first [part], the Glory of Prabhāsa Field, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsa Section, in the compilation of eighty-one thousand [verses] in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

16.285.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi punarnyaṃkumatīṃ nadīm ..
tatra kṛtvā gayāśrāddhaṃ goṣpade tīrtha uttame .. 1 ..
16.285.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि पुनर्न्यंकुमतीं नदीम् ..
तत्र कृत्वा गयाश्राद्धं गोष्पदे तीर्थ उत्तमे .. 1 ..
16.285.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O great goddess, one should go again to the Nyaṅkumatī river. / Having performed the Gayā-śrāddha there at the excellent tīrtha Goṣpada, // 1

16.285.s:
tataḥ paśyedvarāhaṃ tu tasmāddharigṛhaṃ vrajet ..
tatra mātṛstu saṃpūjya snātvā sāgarasaṃgame .. 2 ..
16.285.d:
ततः पश्येद्वराहं तु तस्माद्धरिगृहं व्रजेत् ..
तत्र मातृस्तु संपूज्य स्नात्वा सागरसंगमे .. 2 ..
16.285.m: one should then behold Varāha, and from there proceed to the abode of Hari. / Having worshipped the Mothers there, and having bathed at the confluence with the ocean, // 2

16.285.s:
nyaṃkumatyarṇavopete tataḥ pūrvamanu vrajet ..
agasterāśramaṃ divyaṃ kṣudhāharamitismṛtam .. 3 ..
16.285.d:
न्यंकुमत्यर्णवोपेते ततः पूर्वमनु व्रजेत् ..
अगस्तेराश्रमं दिव्यं क्षुधाहरमितिस्मृतम् .. 3 ..
16.285.m: where the Nyaṅkumatī meets the sea, one should then proceed eastward / to the divine hermitage of Agastya, known as Kṣudhāhara. // 3

16.285.s:
yatrelvalaṃ ca vātāpiṃ saṃhṛtya bhagavānmuniḥ ..
muktvā''padbhyo brāhmaṇāṃśca tebhyaḥ sthānaṃ tato dadau .. 4 ..
16.285.d:
यत्रेल्वलं च वातापिं संहृत्य भगवान्मुनिः ..
मुक्त्वा'ऽपद्भ्यो ब्राह्मणांश्च तेभ्यः स्थानं ततो ददौ .. 4 ..
16.285.m: Where the venerable sage, having destroyed Ilvala and Vātāpi, / freed the brahmins from calamities and then granted that place to them. // 4

16.285.s:
agastyāśramametaddhi agastipriyamuttamam ..
nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe ramye sarvapātakanāśane .. 5 ..
16.285.d:
अगस्त्याश्रममेतद्धि अगस्तिप्रियमुत्तमम् ..
न्यंकुमत्यास्तटे रम्ये सर्वपातकनाशने .. 5 ..
16.285.m: This is indeed the hermitage of Agastya, dear to Agastya and most excellent, / on the delightful bank of the Nyaṅkumatī, which destroys all sins. // 5

16.285.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
agastineha vātāpiḥ kimarthamupaśāmitaḥ ..
atra vai kiṃprabhāvaśca sa daityo brāhmaṇāṃtakaḥ ..
kimarthaṃ codgato manyuragastestu mahātmanaḥ ..6..
16.285.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
अगस्तिनेह वातापिः किमर्थमुपशामितः ..
अत्र वै किंप्रभावश्च स दैत्यो ब्राह्मणांतकः ..
किमर्थं चोद्गतो मन्युरगस्तेस्तु महात्मनः ..6..
16.285.m:
The Goddess said:
For what reason was Vātāpi destroyed here by Agastya? / What was the power of that Daitya who was the slayer of brahmins? / And why did the wrath of the great-souled Agastya arise? // 6

16.285.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ilvalo nāma daityendra āsīdvai varavarṇini ..
maṇimatyāṃ purā puryāṃ vātāpistasya cānujaḥ .. 7 ..
16.285.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इल्वलो नाम दैत्येन्द्र आसीद्वै वरवर्णिनि ..
मणिमत्यां पुरा पुर्यां वातापिस्तस्य चानुजः .. 7 ..
16.285.m:
Īśvara said:
There was a lord of the Daityas named Ilvala, O fair-complexioned one, / in the city of Maṇimatī in ancient times, and Vātāpi was his younger brother. // 7

16.285.s:
sa brāhmaṇaṃ tapoyuktamuvāca ditinaṃdanaḥ ..
putra me bhagavannekamiṃdratulyaṃ prayacchatu ..8..
16.285.d:
स ब्राह्मणं तपोयुक्तमुवाच दितिनंदनः ..
पुत्र मे भगवन्नेकमिंद्रतुल्यं प्रयच्छतु ..8..
16.285.m: That son of Diti said to a brahmin endowed with austerity: / 'O venerable one, grant me a son equal to Indra.' // 8

16.285.s:
tasminsa brāhmaṇo naicchatputraṃ dātuṃ tathāvidham ..
cukrodha ditijastasya brāhmaṇasya tato bhṛśam .. 9 ..
16.285.d:
तस्मिन्स ब्राह्मणो नैच्छत्पुत्रं दातुं तथाविधम् ..
चुक्रोध दितिजस्तस्य ब्राह्मणस्य ततो भृशम् .. 9 ..
16.285.m: When that brahmin did not wish to grant such a son to him, / the son of Diti then became exceedingly angry with that brahmin. // 9

16.285.s:
prabhāsakṣetramāsādya sa daityaḥ pāpabuddhimān ..
meṣarūpī ca vātāpiḥ kāmarūpo'bhavatkṣaṇāt .. 7.1.285.10 ..
16.285.d:
प्रभासक्षेत्रमासाद्य स दैत्यः पापबुद्धिमान् ..
मेषरूपी च वातापिः कामरूपोऽभवत्क्षणात् .. 7.1.285.10 ..
16.285.m: Having arrived at Prabhāsa Field, that wicked-minded Daitya / had Vātāpi, who could change form at will, instantly assume the shape of a ram. // 10

16.285.s:
saṃskṛtya bhojayettatra viprānsa ca jighāṃsati ..
samā hvayati taṃ vācā gataṃ caiva tataḥ kṣayam .. 11 ..
16.285.d:
संस्कृत्य भोजयेत्तत्र विप्रान्स च जिघांसति ..
समा ह्वयति तं वाचा गतं चैव ततः क्षयम् .. 11 ..
16.285.m: He would cook him and feed him there to the brahmins, desiring to kill them; / and with his voice he would summon him who had gone to destruction. // 11

16.285.s:
sa punardehamāsthāya jīvansma pratyadṛśyata ..
tato vātāpirapi taṃ chāgaṃ kṛtvā susaṃskṛtam ..
brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayitvā tu punareva samāhvayat .. 12 ..
16.285.d:
स पुनर्देहमास्थाय जीवन्स्म प्रत्यदृश्यत ..
ततो वातापिरपि तं छागं कृत्वा सुसंस्कृतम् ..
ब्राह्मणं भोजयित्वा तु पुनरेव समाह्वयत् .. 12 ..
16.285.m: Assuming his body once more, he would appear alive. / Then, having turned Vātāpi into a well-prepared goat, / and having fed him to a brahmin, he would call him again. // 12

16.285.s:
sa tasya pārśvaṃ nirbhidya brāhmaṇasya mahātmanaḥ ..
vātāpiḥ prahasaṃstatra niścakrāma dvijodarāt .. 13 ..
16.285.d:
स तस्य पार्श्वं निर्भिद्य ब्राह्मणस्य महात्मनः ..
वातापिः प्रहसंस्तत्र निश्चक्राम द्विजोदरात् .. 13 ..
16.285.m: Tearing through the flank of that noble brahmin, / Vātāpi would emerge laughing from the belly of the twice-born. // 13

16.285.s:
evaṃ sa brāhmaṇāndevi bhojayitvā punaḥpunaḥ ..
vinirbhidyodaraṃ teṣāmevaṃ haṃti dvijānbahūn ..14..
16.285.d:
एवं स ब्राह्मणान्देवि भोजयित्वा पुनःपुनः ..
विनिर्भिद्योदरं तेषामेवं हंति द्विजान्बहून् ..14..
16.285.m: Having thus fed the brahmins again and again, O goddess, / and bursting their bellies, he would in this manner kill many twice-born. // 14

16.285.s:
tato vai brāhmaṇāḥ sarve bhayabhītāḥ pradudruvuḥ ..
agasterāśramaṃ jagmuḥ kathayāmāsuragrataḥ .. 15 ..
16.285.d:
ततो वै ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे भयभीताः प्रदुद्रुवुः ..
अगस्तेराश्रमं जग्मुः कथयामासुरग्रतः .. 15 ..
16.285.m: Then indeed all the brahmins, terrified with fear, ran away; / they went to the hermitage of Agastya and spoke before him: // 15

16.285.s:
bhagavañchṛṇu no vākyamasmākaṃ tu bhayāvaham ..
nimaṃtritāḥ sma sarve vā ilvalena vayaṃ prabho .. 16 ..
16.285.d:
भगवञ्छृणु नो वाक्यमस्माकं तु भयावहम् ..
निमंत्रिताः स्म सर्वे वा इल्वलेन वयं प्रभो .. 16 ..
16.285.m: 'Venerable one, listen to our words, which bring fear upon us! / We have all been invited by Ilvala, O lord. // 16

16.285.s:
asmākaṃ mṛtyurūpaṃ tadbhojanaṃ nāsti saṃśayaḥ ..
tadasmānrakṣa bhagavanviṣaṇṇāgatacetasaḥ .. 17 ..
16.285.d:
अस्माकं मृत्युरूपं तद्भोजनं नास्ति संशयः ..
तदस्मान्रक्ष भगवन्विषण्णागतचेतसः .. 17 ..
16.285.m: That meal is death itself for us, without doubt. / Therefore, protect us, O venerable one, dejected and dismayed as we are!' // 17

16.285.s:
tataḥ prabhāsamāsādya yatra tau daityapuṃgavau ..
brahmaghrau pāpaniratau dadarśa sa mahāmuniḥ .. 18 ..
16.285.d:
ततः प्रभासमासाद्य यत्र तौ दैत्यपुंगवौ ..
ब्रह्मघ्रौ पापनिरतौ ददर्श स महामुनिः .. 18 ..
16.285.m: Then, having reached Prabhāsa where those two prominent Daityas were, / the great sage saw the two murderers of brahmins engaged in sin. // 18

16.285.s:
vātāpiṃ saṃskṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā meṣarūpaṃ mahāsuram ..
uvāca dehi me bhojyaṃ bubhukṣā mama vartate .. 19 ..
16.285.d:
वातापिं संस्कृतं दृष्ट्वा मेषरूपं महासुरम् ..
उवाच देहि मे भोज्यं बुभुक्षा मम वर्तते .. 19 ..
16.285.m: Seeing that the great Asura Vātāpi had been prepared in the form of a ram, / he said: 'Give me food, for hunger is upon me.' // 19

16.285.s:
ityuktau svāgataṃ tatra cakrāte munaye tadā ..
bhagavanbhojanaṃ tubhyaṃ dāsye'haṃ bahuvistaram ..
kiyanmānastavāhārastāvanmānaṃ pacāmyaham .. 7.1.285.20 ..
16.285.d:
इत्युक्तौ स्वागतं तत्र चक्राते मुनये तदा ..
भगवन्भोजनं तुभ्यं दास्येऽहं बहुविस्तरम् ..
कियन्मानस्तवाहारस्तावन्मानं पचाम्यहम् .. 7.1.285.20 ..
16.285.m: Thus addressed, the two of them then bade welcome to the sage: / 'O venerable one, I will give you a meal of great abundance. / How large is your meal? I will cook as much.' // 20

16.285.s:
.. agastya uvāca .. ..
annaṃ pacasva daityendra kiṃcittṛptirbhaviṣyati ..
evamastviti daityendraḥ pakvamāha mahāmune ..21..
16.285.d:
.. अगस्त्य उवाच .. ..
अन्नं पचस्व दैत्येन्द्र किंचित्तृप्तिर्भविष्यति ..
एवमस्त्विति दैत्येन्द्रः पक्वमाह महामुने ..21..
16.285.m:
Agastya said:
'Cook the food, O lord of Daityas; there will be some satisfaction [for me].' / Saying 'So be it,' the lord of Daityas announced that it was cooked, O great sage: // 21

16.285.s:
āsyatāmāsanamidaṃ bhujyatāṃ svecchayā mune ..
ityukto'ghoramaṃtraṃ sa japankalpāṃtakārakam ..
dhuryāsanamathāsādya niṣasāda mahāmuniḥ .. 22 ..
16.285.d:
आस्यतामासनमिदं भुज्यतां स्वेच्छया मुने ..
इत्युक्तोऽघोरमंत्रं स जपन्कल्पांतकारकम् ..
धुर्यासनमथासाद्य निषसाद महामुनिः .. 22 ..
16.285.m: 'Please sit upon this seat, O sage, and eat at your pleasure.' / Thus addressed, repeating the Aghora mantra that brings about the end of an aeon, / the great sage approached the principal seat and sat down. // 22

16.285.s:
taṃ paryaveṣaddaityeṃdra ilvalaḥ prahasanniva ..
śatahastapramāṇena rāśimannasya so'karot .. 23 ..
16.285.d:
तं पर्यवेषद्दैत्येंद्र इल्वलः प्रहसन्निव ..
शतहस्तप्रमाणेन राशिमन्नस्य सोऽकरोत् .. 23 ..
16.285.m: The lord of Daityas, Ilvala, served him as if laughing; / he made a heap of food a hundred cubits in size. // 23

16.285.s:
tato haṣṭamanā'gastyaḥ prāgrasatkavaladvayam ..
rūpaṃ kṛtvā mahattadvadyadvatsāgaraśoṣaṇe .. 24 ..
16.285.d:
ततो हष्टमनाऽगस्त्यः प्राग्रसत्कवलद्वयम् ..
रूपं कृत्वा महत्तद्वद्यद्वत्सागरशोषणे .. 24 ..
16.285.m: Then, delighted in mind, Agastya swallowed two mouthfuls, / having assumed a vast form just as he did when drying up the ocean. // 24

16.285.s:
samastameva tadbhojyaṃ vātāpiṃ bubhuje tataḥ ..
bhuktavatyasuro hvānamakarottasya ilvalaḥ .. 25 ..
16.285.d:
समस्तमेव तद्भोज्यं वातापिं बुभुजे ततः ..
भुक्तवत्यसुरो ह्वानमकरोत्तस्य इल्वलः .. 25 ..
16.285.m: He then consumed all that food, [which was] Vātāpi. / When he had finished eating, the Asura Ilvala called out to him. // 25

16.285.s:
tato'sau dattavānannamagastyasya mahātmanaḥ ..
bhasmīcakāra sarvaṃ sa tadannaṃ ca sadānavam ..26..
16.285.d:
ततोऽसौ दत्तवानन्नमगस्त्यस्य महात्मनः ..
भस्मीचकार सर्वं स तदन्नं च सदानवम् ..26..
16.285.m: Then that one gave food to the high-souled Agastya; / and he reduced to ashes all that food along with the Dānava. // 26

16.285.s:
ilvalaṃ krodhamuṣṭyā tu bhasmīcakre mahāmuniḥ ..
tato hāhāravaṃ kṛtvā sarve daityā nanaṃśire .. 27 ..
16.285.d:
इल्वलं क्रोधमुष्ट्या तु भस्मीचक्रे महामुनिः ..
ततो हाहारवं कृत्वा सर्वे दैत्या ननंशिरे .. 27 ..
16.285.m: The great sage reduced Ilvala to ashes with a fist of wrath. / Then, uttering cries of woe, all the Daityas perished. // 27

16.285.s:
tato'gastyo mahātejā āhūya dvijapuṃgavān ..
tatsthānaṃ ca dadau tebhyo daityrānāṃ dravyapūritam.. 28 ..
16.285.d:
ततोऽगस्त्यो महातेजा आहूय द्विजपुंगवान् ..
तत्स्थानं च ददौ तेभ्यो दैत्य्रानां द्रव्यपूरितम्.. 28 ..
16.285.m: Then the immensely splendid Agastya, having summoned the excellent twice-born, / gave them that place, which was filled with the wealth of the Daityas. // 28

16.285.s:
kṣudhā hṛtā tato devi tatrāgastyasya dānavaiḥ ..
tena kṣudhā haraṃnāma sthānamāsīdvijanmanām .. 29 ..
16.285.d:
क्षुधा हृता ततो देवि तत्रागस्त्यस्य दानवैः ..
तेन क्षुधा हरंनाम स्थानमासीद्विजन्मनाम् .. 29 ..
16.285.m: Thus, O goddess, Agastya's hunger was removed there by the Dānavas; / because of that, it became a place for the twice-born named Kṣudhāhara. // 29

16.285.s:
tasya paścimabhāge tu nātidūre vyavasthitam ..
gaṃgeśvaramiti khyātaṃ gaṃgayā yatpratiṣṭhitam .. 7.1.285.30 ..
16.285.d:
तस्य पश्चिमभागे तु नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् ..
गंगेश्वरमिति ख्यातं गंगया यत्प्रतिष्ठितम् .. 7.1.285.30 ..
16.285.m: On its western side, situated not very far away, / is that which is known as Gaṅgeśvara, installed by Gaṅgā. // 30

16.285.s:
vātāpibhakṣaṇepūrvamagastyena mahātmanā ..
daityasaṃbhakṣaṇotpannasarvapātakaśuddhaye ..
samāhūtā mahādevi gaṃgāpātakanāśinī .. 31 ..
16.285.d:
वातापिभक्षणेपूर्वमगस्त्येन महात्मना ..
दैत्यसंभक्षणोत्पन्नसर्वपातकशुद्धये ..
समाहूता महादेवि गंगापातकनाशिनी .. 31 ..
16.285.m: Formerly, upon consuming Vātāpi, the high-souled Agastya, / in order to purify all the sin arising from eating the Daitya, / summoned Gaṅgā, the destroyer of sins, O great goddess. // 31

16.285.s:
tato devi samā yātā gaṃgā pātakanāśinī ..
śuddhiṃ cakāra tasyarṣestatra sthāne sthitā'bhavat ..32..
16.285.d:
ततो देवि समा याता गंगा पातकनाशिनी ..
शुद्धिं चकार तस्यर्षेस्तत्र स्थाने स्थिताऽभवत् ..32..
16.285.m: Then, O goddess, Gaṅgā, the destroyer of sins, arrived; / she purified that seer and remained at that place. // 32

16.285.s:
agastyasyā''śrame ramye nṛṇāṃ pāpabhayāpahe ..
tatra gaṃgeśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā abhakṣyodbhavapātakāt..
mucyate nātra saṃdehaḥ snānadānajapādinā .. 33 ..
16.285.d:
अगस्त्यस्या'ऽश्रमे रम्ये नृणां पापभयापहे ..
तत्र गंगेश्वरं दृष्ट्वा अभक्ष्योद्भवपातकात्..
मुच्यते नात्र संदेहः स्नानदानजपादिना .. 33 ..
16.285.m: In Agastya's delightful hermitage, which removes the fear of sin for men, / by seeing Gaṅgeśvara there, through bathing, giving gifts, reciting mantras, and the like, / one is freed from the sin born of eating forbidden food; of this there is no doubt. // 33

16.285.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathameprabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nyaṃkumatīmāhātmye'gastyāśramagaṃgeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcāśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ.. 285 ..
16.285.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमेप्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये न्यंकुमतीमाहात्म्येऽगस्त्याश्रमगंगेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चाशीत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः.. 285 ..
16.285.m: Thus ends the two hundred and eighty-fifth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Agastyāśrama and Gaṅgeśvara in the Nyaṅkumatī-māhātmya', in the first [part], the Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.286.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi bālārkaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
agastyāśramato devi uttare nātidūrataḥ .. 1 ..
16.286.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि बालार्कं पापनाशनम् ..
अगस्त्याश्रमतो देवि उत्तरे नातिदूरतः .. 1 ..
16.286.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to Bālārka, the destroyer of sins, / which is not very far to the north from Agastya's hermitage, O goddess. // 1

16.286.s:
bāla eva tu yatrārkastapastepe purā priye ..
tena bālārka ityetannāma khyātaṃ dharātale .. 2 ..
16.286.d:
बाल एव तु यत्रार्कस्तपस्तेपे पुरा प्रिये ..
तेन बालार्क इत्येतन्नाम ख्यातं धरातले .. 2 ..
16.286.m: Since the Sun, while still a boy, performed austerities there of old, O beloved, / it became renowned by this name, 'Bālārka', on the surface of the earth. // 2

16.286.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā ravivāreṇa na kuṣṭhī jāyate naraḥ ..
bālānāṃ rogajā pīḍā na saṃbhūyātkadācana .. 3 ..
16.286.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा रविवारेण न कुष्ठी जायते नरः ..
बालानां रोगजा पीडा न संभूयात्कदाचन .. 3 ..
16.286.m: Having seen it on a Sunday, a man does not become a leper; / afflictions caused by disease shall never befall his children. // 3

16.286.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye bālārkamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍaśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 286 ..
16.286.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्र माहात्म्ये बालार्कमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षडशीत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 286 ..
16.286.m: Thus ends the two hundred and eighty-sixth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Bālārka', in the first [part], the Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.287.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi ajāpāleśvarīṃ śubhām ..
agastyasthānapūrveṇa nātidūre vyavasthitām .. 1 ..
16.287.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि अजापालेश्वरीं शुभाम् ..
अगस्त्यस्थानपूर्वेण नातिदूरे व्यवस्थिताम् .. 1 ..
16.287.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the auspicious Ajāpāleśvarī, / situated not very far to the east of Agastya's place. // 1

16.287.s:
raghuvaṃśasamudbhūto hyajāpālo nṛpottamaḥ ..
sa tatra devīmārādhya pāparogavaśaṃkarīm .. 2 ..
16.287.d:
रघुवंशसमुद्भूतो ह्यजापालो नृपोत्तमः ..
स तत्र देवीमाराध्य पापरोगवशंकरीम् .. 2 ..
16.287.m: There was a king, best among rulers, named Ajāpāla, born in Raghu's lineage. / He, having propitiated the goddess there who subdues sinful diseases, // 2

16.287.s:
ajārūpāṃśca rogānvai cārayāmāsa bhūmipaḥ ..
tatra tāṃ sthāpayāmāsa svanāmnā pāpanāśinīm ... .. 3 ..
16.287.d:
अजारूपांश्च रोगान्वै चारयामास भूमिपः ..
तत्र तां स्थापयामास स्वनाम्ना पापनाशिनीम् ... .. 3 ..
16.287.m: and having tended the diseases that had assumed the form of goats, that ruler of the earth / installed her there, the destroyer of sins, after his own name. // 3

16.287.s:
yastāṃ pūjayate bhaktyā tṛtīyāyāṃ vidhānataḥ ..
bala buddhiryaśo vidyāṃ saubhāgyaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ .. 4 ..
16.287.d:
यस्तां पूजयते भक्त्या तृतीयायां विधानतः ..
बल बुद्धिर्यशो विद्यां सौभाग्यं प्राप्नुयान्नरः .. 4 ..
16.287.m: Whoever worships her with devotion according to the prescribed rites on the third lunar day / will obtain strength, intellect, fame, learning, and good fortune. // 4

16.287.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'jāpāleśvarīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptāśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 287 .. ..
16.287.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येऽजापालेश्वरीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्ताशीत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 287 .. ..
16.287.m: Thus ends the two hundred and eighty-seventh chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Ajāpāleśvarī', in the first [part], the Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.288.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi bālādityamiti śrutam ..
agatsyasthānataḥ pūrve gavyūtidvitayena tu.. 1 ..
16.288.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि बालादित्यमिति श्रुतम् ..
अगत्स्यस्थानतः पूर्वे गव्यूतिद्वितयेन तु.. 1 ..
16.288.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to that which is renowned as Bālāditya, / two gavyūtis to the east of Agastya's place. // 1

16.288.s:
sthānaṃ sapāṭikānāma tasyadakṣiṇataḥ sthitam ..
gavyūtimātraṃ deveśi bālārka iti viśrutam .. 2 ..
16.288.d:
स्थानं सपाटिकानाम तस्यदक्षिणतः स्थितम् ..
गव्यूतिमात्रं देवेशि बालार्क इति विश्रुतम् .. 2 ..
16.288.m: South of that place named Sapāṭikā, / at a distance of a single gavyūti, O ruler of the gods, is that celebrated as Bālārka, // 2

16.288.s:
yatra cārādhitā vidyā viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā ..
saṃsthāpya liṃgatritayaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tathā ravim .. 3 ..
16.288.d:
यत्र चाराधिता विद्या विश्वामित्रेण धीमता ..
संस्थाप्य लिंगत्रितयं प्रतिष्ठाप्य तथा रविम् .. 3 ..
16.288.m: where the sacred lore was mastered by the wise Viśvāmitra / after establishing a triad of liṅgas and consecrating the Sun. // 3

16.288.s:
vidyāyāḥ sādhanaṃ cakre siddhiṃ sūryādavāptavān .
bālādityeti tenāsau tataḥ khyātimagātprabhuḥ .. 4 ..
16.288.d:
विद्यायाः साधनं चक्रे सिद्धिं सूर्यादवाप्तवान् .
बालादित्येति तेनासौ ततः ख्यातिमगात्प्रभुः .. 4 ..
16.288.m: He accomplished the mastery of the sacred lore and obtained perfection from the Sun; / hence that lord attained renown by the name Bālāditya. // 4

16.288.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi bhāskarapāpataskaram..
na dāridryamavāpnoti yāvajjīvati mānavaḥ .. 5 ..
16.288.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो देवि भास्करपापतस्करम्..
न दारिद्र्यमवाप्नोति यावज्जीवति मानवः .. 5 ..
16.288.m: Having beheld that Sun, who steals away sins, O goddess, / a mortal never encounters poverty as long as he lives. // 5

16.288.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bālārkamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 288 .. ..
16.288.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये बालार्कमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टाशीत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 288 .. ..
16.288.m: Thus ends the two hundred and eighty-eighth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Bālārka', in the first [part], the Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.289.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasyaiva dakṣiṇe devi tasmādgavyūtimātrataḥ ..
pātālagāminī gaṃgā saṃsthitā pāpanāśinī .. 1 ..
16.289.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्यैव दक्षिणे देवि तस्माद्गव्यूतिमात्रतः ..
पातालगामिनी गंगा संस्थिता पापनाशिनी .. 1 ..
16.289.m: Īśvara said: / To the south of that very place, O goddess, at a distance of just a gavyūti, / is the Ganges that flows to Pātāla, the destroyer of sins. // 1

16.289.s:
viśvāmitreṇa cāhūtā snānārthaṃ varavarṇini ..
tatra snātvā mahādevi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 2 ..
16.289.d:
विश्वामित्रेण चाहूता स्नानार्थं वरवर्णिनि ..
तत्र स्नात्वा महादेवि मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 2 ..
16.289.m: She was summoned by Viśvāmitra for the purpose of bathing, O fair-complexioned one; / having bathed there, O great goddess, one is freed from all sins. // 2

16.289.s:
tatra gaṃgeśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā viśvāmitreśvaraṃ tathā ..
bāleśvaraṃ ca saṃprekṣya sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 3 ..
16.289.d:
तत्र गंगेश्वरं दृष्ट्वा विश्वामित्रेश्वरं तथा ..
बालेश्वरं च संप्रेक्ष्य सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् .. 3 ..
16.289.m: Having seen Gaṅgeśvara there, and likewise Viśvāmitreśvara, / and having beheld Bāleśvara, one attains all desires. // 3

16.289.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bālārkamāhātmye pātāla gaṃgeśvaraviśvāmitreśvarabāleśvarābhidhaliṃgatrayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonanavatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 289 ..
16.289.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये बालार्कमाहात्म्ये पाताल गंगेश्वरविश्वामित्रेश्वरबालेश्वराभिधलिंगत्रयमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोननवत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 289 ..
16.289.m: Thus ends the two hundred and eighty-ninth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Triad of Liṅgas Named Pātālagaṅgeśvara, Viśvāmitreśvara, and Bāleśvara in the Bālārka-māhātmya', in the first [part], the Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.290.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi kuberasthānamuttamam ..
yatra siddhaḥ purā devi kubero dhanado'bhavat .. 1 ..
16.290.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि कुबेरस्थानमुत्तमम् ..
यत्र सिद्धः पुरा देवि कुबेरो धनदोऽभवत् .. 1 ..
16.290.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the supreme place of Kubera, / where of old Kubera attained perfection and became the giver of wealth, O goddess. // 1

16.290.s:
brāhmaṇaścaurarūpeṇa tatra sthāne'vasatpurā ..
sa ca me bhaktiyogena purā vai dhanadaḥ kṛtaḥ.. 2 ..
16.290.d:
ब्राह्मणश्चौररूपेण तत्र स्थानेऽवसत्पुरा ..
स च मे भक्तियोगेन पुरा वै धनदः कृतः.. 2 ..
16.290.m: A brahmin who lived as a thief resided in that place long ago, / and he was made the giver of wealth of old through the practice of devotion to me. // 2

16.290.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kathaṃ sa brāhmaṇo bhūtvā caurarūpo narādhamaḥ ..
tanme kathaya deveśa dhanadaḥ sa yathā'bhavat .. 3 ..
16.290.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
कथं स ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा चौररूपो नराधमः ..
तन्मे कथय देवेश धनदः स यथाऽभवत् .. 3 ..
16.290.m: The Goddess said: / How did that vilest of men, though born a brahmin, become a thief? / Tell me that, O Lord of the gods: how did he become the giver of wealth? // 3

16.290.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasminnarthe mahādevi yadvṛttaṃ cauttameṃ'tare ..
kathayiṣyāmi tatsarvaṃ śivamāhātmyasūcakam .. 4 ..
16.290.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्मिन्नर्थे महादेवि यद्वृत्तं चौत्तमेंऽतरे ..
कथयिष्यामि तत्सर्वं शिवमाहात्म्यसूचकम् .. 4 ..
16.290.m: Īśvara said: / In that matter, O great goddess, I shall relate all that occurred in the reign of Manu Uttama, / which illustrates the greatness of Śiva. // 4

16.290.s:
kaścidāsīddvijo devi devaśarmeti viśrutaḥ ..
prabhāsakṣetranilayo nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe'vasat .. 5 ..
16.290.d:
कश्चिदासीद्द्विजो देवि देवशर्मेति विश्रुतः ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रनिलयो न्यंकुमत्यास्तटेऽवसत् .. 5 ..
16.290.m: There was a certain twice-born, O goddess, known by the name Devaśarman, / residing in Prabhāsa-kṣetra; he lived on the bank of the Nyaṅkumatī. // 5

16.290.s:
putrakṣetrakalatrādivyāpāraikarataḥ sadā ..
vihāyātha sa gārhasthyaṃ dhanārthaṃ lobha mohitaḥ ..
pracacāra mahīmetāṃ sagrāmanagarāṃtarām .. 6 ..
16.290.d:
पुत्रक्षेत्रकलत्रादिव्यापारैकरतः सदा ..
विहायाथ स गार्हस्थ्यं धनार्थं लोभ मोहितः ..
प्रचचार महीमेतां सग्रामनगरांतराम् .. 6 ..
16.290.m: Constantly devoted solely to the care of his sons, fields, and wife, / he then abandoned householdership, deluded by greed for the sake of wealth, / and wandered over this earth, across its villages and cities. // 6

16.290.s:
bhāryā tasya vilolākṣī tasya gehādvinirgatā ..
svacchaṃdacāriṇī nityaṃ nityaṃ cānaṃgamohitā .. 7 ..
16.290.d:
भार्या तस्य विलोलाक्षी तस्य गेहाद्विनिर्गता ..
स्वच्छंदचारिणी नित्यं नित्यं चानंगमोहिता .. 7 ..
16.290.m: His wife with restless eyes departed from his house, / living always as she pleased and constantly infatuated by lust. // 7

16.290.s:
tasyāṃ kadācitputrastu śūdrājjāto vidhervaśāt ..
duṣṭātmā'tīva nirmukto nāmnā duḥsaha ityataḥ .. 8 ..
16.290.d:
तस्यां कदाचित्पुत्रस्तु शूद्राज्जातो विधेर्वशात् ..
दुष्टात्माऽतीव निर्मुक्तो नाम्ना दुःसह इत्यतः .. 8 ..
16.290.m: By the power of fate, a son was born to her from a śūdra, / an extremely wicked soul, utterly unrestrained, called by the name Duḥsaha. // 8

16.290.s:
so'tha kālena mahatā nāmakarmapravartitaḥ ..
vyasanopahataḥ pāpastyakto bandhujanaistathā .. 9 ..
16.290.d:
सोऽथ कालेन महता नामकर्मप्रवर्तितः ..
व्यसनोपहतः पापस्त्यक्तो बन्धुजनैस्तथा .. 9 ..
16.290.m: Then, as much time passed, he engaged in deeds suited to his name: / stricken with vices, sinful, and likewise abandoned by his kin. // 9

16.290.s:
pūjopakaraṇaṃ dravyaṃ sa kasmiṃścicchivālaye ..
bahudoṣāmukhe dṛṣṭvā hartukāmo'viśattataḥ... .. 7.1.290.10..
16.290.d:
पूजोपकरणं द्रव्यं स कस्मिंश्चिच्छिवालये ..
बहुदोषामुखे दृष्ट्वा हर्तुकामोऽविशत्ततः... .. 7.1.290.10..
16.290.m: Seeing the articles and wealth used for worship in a certain temple of Śiva / late at night, he entered, wishing to steal them. // 10

16.290.s:
yāvaddīpo gataprāyo vartticchedo'bhavatkila ..
tāvattena daśā dattā dravyānveṣaṇakāraṇāt .. 11 ..
16.290.d:
यावद्दीपो गतप्रायो वर्त्तिच्छेदोऽभवत्किल ..
तावत्तेन दशा दत्ता द्रव्यान्वेषणकारणात् .. 11 ..
16.290.m: Just as the lamp was almost extinguished and its wick burnt out, / he placed a fresh wick into it for the purpose of searching for the wealth. // 11

16.290.s:
prabuddhaścotthitastatra devapūjākaro naraḥ ..
ko'yaṃ koyamiti proccairvyāharatparighāyudhaḥ ..12..
16.290.d:
प्रबुद्धश्चोत्थितस्तत्र देवपूजाकरो नरः ..
कोऽयं कोयमिति प्रोच्चैर्व्याहरत्परिघायुधः ..12..
16.290.m: A man attending to the worship of the deity awoke and arose there; / armed with an iron bar, he shouted loudly: 'Who is this? Who is this?' // 12

16.290.s:
sa ca prāṇabhayānnaṣṭaḥ śūdrajaścāpi mūḍhadhīḥ ..
vinindannātmano janma karma cāpi suduḥkhita..13..
16.290.d:
स च प्राणभयान्नष्टः शूद्रजश्चापि मूढधीः ..
विनिन्दन्नात्मनो जन्म कर्म चापि सुदुःखित..13..
16.290.m: Fearing for his life, the foolish-minded son of a śūdra fled, / deeply grieving, reviling his own birth and deeds. // 13

16.290.s:
purapālairhato'vanyāṃ mṛtaḥ kālādabhūcca saḥ..
gaṃdhāraviṣaye rājā khyāto nāmnā sudurmukhaḥ..14..
16.290.d:
पुरपालैर्हतोऽवन्यां मृतः कालादभूच्च सः..
गंधारविषये राजा ख्यातो नाम्ना सुदुर्मुखः..14..
16.290.m: He was struck down on the ground by the town guards and died in the course of time; / and he became a renowned king in the Gandhāra country named Sudurmukha. // 14

16.290.s:
gītavādyaratastatra veśyāsu nirato bhṛśam..
prajopadravakṛnmūrkhaḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ .. 15 ..
16.290.d:
गीतवाद्यरतस्तत्र वेश्यासु निरतो भृशम्..
प्रजोपद्रवकृन्मूर्खः सर्वधर्मबहिष्कृतः .. 15 ..
16.290.m: Devoted to singing and instrumental music there, intensely devoted to courtesans, / that foolish man harassed his subjects and was excluded from all religious duties. // 15

16.290.s:
kintvarcayansadaivāsau liṃgaṃ rājyakramāgatam ..
puṣpasragdhūpanaivedyagaṃdhādibhiramantravat ..16 ..
16.290.d:
किन्त्वर्चयन्सदैवासौ लिंगं राज्यक्रमागतम् ..
पुष्पस्रग्धूपनैवेद्यगंधादिभिरमन्त्रवत् ..16 ..
16.290.m: Yet he constantly worshipped the liṅga inherited through the royal succession, / without mantras, using garlands of flowers, incense, food offerings, perfumes, and the like. // 16

16.290.s:
mukhyeṣu ca sadā kāle devatāyataneṣu ca ..
dadyātsa bahulāndīpānvartibhiśca samujjvalān .. 17 ..
16.290.d:
मुख्येषु च सदा काले देवतायतनेषु च ..
दद्यात्स बहुलान्दीपान्वर्तिभिश्च समुज्ज्वलान् .. 17 ..
16.290.m: And on important occasions, in the temples of the deities, / he would always offer abundant lamps brightly blazing with wicks. // 17

16.290.s:
kadācinmṛgayāsakto babhrāma sa ca vīryavān..
prabhāsa kṣetramāgātya pūrvasaṃskārabhāvitaḥ .. 18 ..
16.290.d:
कदाचिन्मृगयासक्तो बभ्राम स च वीर्यवान्..
प्रभास क्षेत्रमागात्य पूर्वसंस्कारभावितः .. 18 ..
16.290.m: Once that valiant one, addicted to hunting, roamed about; / having arrived at Prabhāsa-kṣetra, impelled by past impressions, // 18

16.290.s:
parairabhihato yuddhe nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe śubhe ..
śivapūjāvidhānena vidhvastāśeṣapātakaḥ .. 19 ..
16.290.d:
परैरभिहतो युद्धे न्यंकुमत्यास्तटे शुभे ..
शिवपूजाविधानेन विध्वस्ताशेषपातकः .. 19 ..
16.290.m: Slain in battle by his enemies on the auspicious bank of the Nyaṅkumatī, / his sins were entirely destroyed by the proper performance of worship to Śiva.

16.290.s:
tato viśravasaścāsau putro'bhūdbhuvi viśrutaḥ ..
yaḥ sa eva mahātejāḥ sarvayajñādhipo balī .. 7.1.290.20 ..
16.290.d:
ततो विश्रवसश्चासौ पुत्रोऽभूद्भुवि विश्रुतः ..
यः स एव महातेजाः सर्वयज्ञाधिपो बली .. 7.1.290.20 ..
16.290.m: Then he became the son of Viśravas, renowned upon the earth, / the very one endowed with great splendor, mighty, and lord over all sacrifices,

16.290.s:
kubera iti dharmātmā śrutaśīlasamanvitaḥ ..
liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhayāmāsa nyaṃkumatyāśca pūrvataḥ .. 21 ..
16.290.d:
कुबेर इति धर्मात्मा श्रुतशीलसमन्वितः ..
लिंगं प्रतिष्ठयामास न्यंकुमत्याश्च पूर्वतः .. 21 ..
16.290.m: named Kubera, righteous, endowed with sacred learning and good character. / And he installed a liṅga to the east of the Nyaṅkumatī.

16.290.s:
kauberātpaścime bhāge somanātheti viśrutam ..
saṃpūjya ca yatheśānaṃ nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe śubhe ..
stotreṇānena cāstauṣīdbhaktyā taṃ sarvakāmadam .. 22 ..
16.290.d:
कौबेरात्पश्चिमे भागे सोमनाथेति विश्रुतम् ..
संपूज्य च यथेशानं न्यंकुमत्यास्तटे शुभे ..
स्तोत्रेणानेन चास्तौषीद्भक्त्या तं सर्वकामदम् .. 22 ..
16.290.m: Having duly worshipped the lord known as Somanātha to the west of the place of Kubera / on the auspicious bank of the Nyaṅkumatī, / he praised him who grants all desires with devotion through this hymn:

16.290.s:
mūrtiḥ kvāpi maheśvarasya mahatī yajñasya mūlodayā tumbī tuṃgaphalāvatī ca śataśo brahmāṇḍakoṭistathā ..
yanmānaṃ na pitāmaho na ca harirbrahmāṇḍamadhyasthito jānātyanyasureṣu kā ca gaṇanā sā saṃtataṃ vo'vatāt .. 23 ..
16.290.d:
मूर्तिः क्वापि महेश्वरस्य महती यज्ञस्य मूलोदया तुम्बी तुंगफलावती च शतशो ब्रह्माण्डकोटिस्तथा ..
यन्मानं न पितामहो न च हरिर्ब्रह्माण्डमध्यस्थितो जानात्यन्यसुरेषु का च गणना सा संततं वोऽवतात् .. 23 ..
16.290.m: "In some place is that great form of Maheśvara, the prime origin of sacrifice, / like a bottle-gourd creeper bearing high fruits of hundreds of millions of cosmic eggs, / whose measure neither the Grandfather nor Hari situated within the cosmos knows— / what reckoning can there be among other gods?—may that [form] protect you continually!

16.290.s:
namāmyahaṃ devamajaṃ purāṇamu pendramindrāvararājajuṣṭam ..
śaśāṃkasūryāgnisamānanetraṃ vṛṣendracihnaṃ pralayādihetum .. 24 ..
16.290.d:
नमाम्यहं देवमजं पुराणमु पेन्द्रमिन्द्रावरराजजुष्टम् ..
शशांकसूर्याग्निसमाननेत्रं वृषेन्द्रचिह्नं प्रलयादिहेतुम् .. 24 ..
16.290.m: I bow to the unborn, ancient God, attended by Indra's younger brother and the king of gods, / whose eyes are the moon, the sun, and fire, whose emblem is the bull, the cause of universal dissolution and creation,

16.290.s:
sarveśvaraikatribalaikabandhuṃ yogādhigamyaṃ jagato'dhivāsam ..
taṃ vismayādhāramanaṃtaśaktiṃ jñānodbhavaṃ dhairyaguṇādhikaṃ ca .. 25 ..
16.290.d:
सर्वेश्वरैकत्रिबलैकबन्धुं योगाधिगम्यं जगतोऽधिवासम् ..
तं विस्मयाधारमनंतशक्तिं ज्ञानोद्भवं धैर्यगुणाधिकं च .. 25 ..
16.290.m: the Lord of All, the single friend of the three worlds, attainable through yoga, the dwelling place of the universe, / the foundation of wonder, possessed of endless power, born of knowledge, exceedingly abundant in fortitude,

16.290.s:
pinākapāśāṃkuśaśūlahastaṃ kapardinaṃ meghasamānaghoṣam ..
sakālakaṇṭhaṃ sphaṭikāvabhāsaṃ namāmi śaṃbhuṃ bhuvanaikanātham .. 26 ..
16.290.d:
पिनाकपाशांकुशशूलहस्तं कपर्दिनं मेघसमानघोषम् ..
सकालकण्ठं स्फटिकावभासं नमामि शंभुं भुवनैकनाथम् .. 26 ..
16.290.m: holding the Pināka, noose, goad, and trident in his hands, with matted hair, rumbling like a cloud, / having a dark throat, radiating like crystal—I bow to Śambhu, the sole lord of the universe,

16.290.s:
kapālinaṃ mālinamādidevaṃ jaṭādharaṃ bhīmabhujaṃgahāram ..
prabhāsitāraṃ ca sahasramūrtiṃ sahasraśīrṣaṃ puruṣaṃ viśiṣṭam .. 27 ..
16.290.d:
कपालिनं मालिनमादिदेवं जटाधरं भीमभुजंगहारम् ..
प्रभासितारं च सहस्रमूर्तिं सहस्रशीर्षं पुरुषं विशिष्टम् .. 27 ..
16.290.m: bearing a skull, garlanded, the primal god, wearing braided hair, adorned with dread serpents as necklaces, / shining brightly, possessing a thousand forms, a thousand heads, the supreme Puruṣa,

16.290.s:
yadakṣaraṃ nirguṇamaprameyaṃ sajyotirekaṃ pravadaṃti saṃtaḥ ..
dūraṃgamaṃ vedyamaniṃdyavandyaṃ sarveṣu hṛtsthaṃ paramaṃ pavitram .. 28 ..
16.290.d:
यदक्षरं निर्गुणमप्रमेयं सज्योतिरेकं प्रवदंति संतः ..
दूरंगमं वेद्यमनिंद्यवन्द्यं सर्वेषु हृत्स्थं परमं पवित्रम् .. 28 ..
16.290.m: whom the virtuous declare to be imperishable, devoid of qualities, immeasurable, self-luminous and one, / far-reaching, to be known, blameless and worthy of adoration, abiding in the hearts of all, supremely pure.

16.290.s:
tejonibhaṃ bālamṛgāṃkamauliṃ namāmi rudraṃ sphuradugravaktram ..
kālendhanaṃ kāmadamastasaṃgaṃ dharmāsanasthaṃ prakṛtidvayastham .. 29 ..
16.290.d:
तेजोनिभं बालमृगांकमौलिं नमामि रुद्रं स्फुरदुग्रवक्त्रम् ..
कालेन्धनं कामदमस्तसंगं धर्मासनस्थं प्रकृतिद्वयस्थम् .. 29 ..
16.290.m: I bow to Rudra, radiant as splendor, with the crescent moon upon his crest, having a fiercely blazing countenance, / the consumer of time, bestower of desires, free from attachment, seated upon the throne of dharma, situated in both primary matters,

16.290.s:
atīndriyaṃ viśvabhujaṃ jitāriṃ guṇatrayātītamajaṃ nirīham ..
tamomayaṃ vedamayaṃ cidaṃśaṃ prajāpatīśaṃ puruhūtamindram ..
anāgataikadhvanirūpamādyaṃ dhyāyaṃti yaṃ yogavido yatīndrāḥ .. 7.1.290.30 ..
16.290.d:
अतीन्द्रियं विश्वभुजं जितारिं गुणत्रयातीतमजं निरीहम् ..
तमोमयं वेदमयं चिदंशं प्रजापतीशं पुरुहूतमिन्द्रम् ..
अनागतैकध्वनिरूपमाद्यं ध्यायंति यं योगविदो यतीन्द्राः .. 7.1.290.30 ..
16.290.m: transcending the senses, all-embracing, conqueror of enemies, beyond the three guṇas, unborn, free from striving, / consisting of darkness, consisting of the Vedas, a portion of pure consciousness, lord of the Prajāpatis, Indra invoked by many, / having the primal form of the unstruck sound, whom the lords of ascetics skilled in yoga meditate upon.

16.290.s: saṃsārapāśacchiduraṃ vimuktaḥ punaḥ punastvāṃ praṇamāmi devam .. 31 ..
16.290.d: संसारपाशच्छिदुरं विमुक्तः पुनः पुनस्त्वां प्रणमामि देवम् .. 31 ..
16.290.m: Severer of the bonds of worldly existence, being liberated, I bow again and again to You, O God!

16.290.s:
nirūpamāsyaṃ ca balaprabhāvaṃ na ca svabhāvaṃ paramasya puṃsaḥ ..
vijñāyate viṣṇupitāmahādyaistaṃ vāmadevaṃ praṇamāmyaciṃtyam .. 32 ..
16.290.d:
निरूपमास्यं च बलप्रभावं न च स्वभावं परमस्य पुंसः ..
विज्ञायते विष्णुपितामहाद्यैस्तं वामदेवं प्रणमाम्यचिंत्यम् .. 32 ..
16.290.m: Neither the matchless appearance nor the power of strength, nor the true nature of the supreme Puruṣa / is understood by Viṣṇu, the Grandfather, and the rest; I bow to that inconceivable Vāmadeva.

16.290.s:
śivaṃ samārādhya tamugramūrttiṃ papau samudraṃ bhagavānagastyaḥ ..
lebhe dilīpo'pyakhilāṃśca kāmāṃstaṃ viśvayoniṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye .. 33 ..
16.290.d:
शिवं समाराध्य तमुग्रमूर्त्तिं पपौ समुद्रं भगवानगस्त्यः ..
लेभे दिलीपोऽप्यखिलांश्च कामांस्तं विश्वयोनिं शरणं प्रपद्ये .. 33 ..
16.290.m: Having propitiated that Śiva of fierce form, the venerable Agastya drank the ocean; / Dilīpa too obtained all desires. I take refuge in him, the womb of the universe!

16.290.s:
devendravandyoddhara māmanāthaṃ śambho kṛpākāruṇikaḥ kila tvam ..
duḥkhā'rṇave magnamumeśa dīnaṃ samuddhara tvaṃ bhava śaṃkaro'si .. 34 ..
16.290.d:
देवेन्द्रवन्द्योद्धर मामनाथं शम्भो कृपाकारुणिकः किल त्वम् ..
दुःखाऽर्णवे मग्नमुमेश दीनं समुद्धर त्वं भव शंकरोऽसि .. 34 ..
16.290.m: O one worshipped by the lord of the gods, rescue me, a helpless one! O Śambhu, you are indeed compassionate and merciful! / Plunged in an ocean of sorrow, miserable, rescue me! Be my benefactor, for you are Śaṃkara!

16.290.s:
saṃpūjayanto divi devasaṃghā brahmendrarudrā viharaṃti kāmam ..
taṃ staumi naumīha japāmi śarvaṃ vande'bhivaṃdyaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannaḥ ..35..
16.290.d:
संपूजयन्तो दिवि देवसंघा ब्रह्मेन्द्ररुद्रा विहरंति कामम् ..
तं स्तौमि नौमीह जपामि शर्वं वन्देऽभिवंद्यं शरणं प्रपन्नः ..35..
16.290.m: Worshipping [you], hosts of gods in heaven, with Brahmā, Indra, and the Rudras, disport at will. / I praise him, I bow to him, here I repeat the name of Śarva; having taken refuge, I venerate the one worthy of veneration."

16.290.s:
stutvaivamīśaṃ virarāma yāvattāvatsa rudro'rkasahasratejāḥ ..
dadau ca tasmai varadoṃ'dhakārirvaratrayaṃ vaiśravaṇāya devaḥ..
sakhyaṃ ca dikpālapadaṃ caturthaṃ dhanādhipatyaṃ ca divaukasāṃ ca .. 36 ..
16.290.d:
स्तुत्वैवमीशं विरराम यावत्तावत्स रुद्रोऽर्कसहस्रतेजाः ..
ददौ च तस्मै वरदोंऽधकारिर्वरत्रयं वैश्रवणाय देवः..
सख्यं च दिक्पालपदं चतुर्थं धनाधिपत्यं च दिवौकसां च .. 36 ..
16.290.m: As soon as he had thus praised the Lord and ceased, Rudra, possessing the brilliance of a thousand suns, / the god who was the enemy of Andhaka, bestower of boons, gave three boons to Vaiśravaṇa: / friendship [with himself], the fourth quarter-guardian rank, and sovereignty over the wealth of the celestials.

16.290.s:
yasmādatra tvayā samyaṅnyaṃkumatyāstaṭe śubhe ..
ārādhito'haṃ vidhivatkṛtvā mūrttiṃ mahīmayīm .. 37 ..
16.290.d:
यस्मादत्र त्वया सम्यङ्न्यंकुमत्यास्तटे शुभे ..
आराधितोऽहं विधिवत्कृत्वा मूर्त्तिं महीमयीम् .. 37 ..
16.290.m: "Because I have been worshipped properly by you here on the auspicious bank of the Nyaṅkumatī, / having fashioned an earthen form according to rule,

16.290.s:
tasmāttavaiva nāmnā tatsthānaṃ khyātaṃ bhaviṣyati ..
kuberanagaretyevaṃ mama prītipradāyakam .. 38..
16.290.d:
तस्मात्तवैव नाम्ना तत्स्थानं ख्यातं भविष्यति ..
कुबेरनगरेत्येवं मम प्रीतिप्रदायकम् .. 38..
16.290.m: therefore that place will become famous by your very name / as 'Kubera-nagara', causing pleasure to me.

16.290.s:
tvayā pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgamasmātsthānācca paścime ..
umānāthasya vidhivatsomanātheti tatsmṛtam .. 39 ..
16.290.d:
त्वया प्रतिष्ठितं लिंगमस्मात्स्थानाच्च पश्चिमे ..
उमानाथस्य विधिवत्सोमनाथेति तत्स्मृतम् .. 39 ..
16.290.m: The liṅga of Umā's lord installed by you to the west of this place, / according to rule, is remembered as Somanātha.

16.290.s:
śrīpaṃcamyāṃ vidhānena yastacca pūjayiṣyati ..
saptapuruṣāvadhiryāvattasya lakṣmīrbhaviṣyati .. 7.1.290.40 ..
16.290.d:
श्रीपंचम्यां विधानेन यस्तच्च पूजयिष्यति ..
सप्तपुरुषावधिर्यावत्तस्य लक्ष्मीर्भविष्यति .. 7.1.290.40 ..
16.290.m: Whoever worships it properly on Śrīpañcamī / will have prosperity lasting up to seven generations."

16.290.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nyaṃkumatīmāhātmye kuberanagarotpattikuberasthāpitasomanāthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..290..
16.290.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये न्यंकुमतीमाहात्म्ये कुबेरनगरोत्पत्तिकुबेरस्थापितसोमनाथमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम नवत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..290..
16.290.m: Thus ends the two hundred and ninetieth chapter, entitled 'The Origin of Kuberanagara and the Description of the Māhātmya of Somanātha Installed by Kubera', in the Nyaṅkumatī-māhātmya, within the Prabhāsakṣetra-māhātmya, the first [sub-section] of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Purāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.291.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasmāduttarabhāge tu sthānātkauberasaṃjñakāt ..
bhadrakālī mahādevi vāṃchitārthapradāyinī .. 1 ..
16.291.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्मादुत्तरभागे तु स्थानात्कौबेरसंज्ञकात् ..
भद्रकाली महादेवि वांछितार्थप्रदायिनी .. 1 ..
16.291.m: Īśvara said: / To the north of that place called Kaubera, / [abides] Bhadrakālī, O Great Goddess, who grants desired goals.

16.291.s:
dakṣayajñasya vidhvaṃse vīrabhadrasamanvitā ..
bhadrakālī mahādevī dakṣayajñavināśinī .. 2 ..
16.291.d:
दक्षयज्ञस्य विध्वंसे वीरभद्रसमन्विता ..
भद्रकाली महादेवी दक्षयज्ञविनाशिनी .. 2 ..
16.291.m: At the destruction of Dakṣa's sacrifice, accompanied by Vīrabhadra, / she was the Great Goddess Bhadrakālī who destroyed Dakṣa's sacrifice.

16.291.s:
caitre māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ devīṃ tāṃ yastu pūjayet ..
navakoṭyastu cāmuṇḍā bhaviṣyaṃti supūjitāḥ ..
saubhāgyaṃ vijayaṃ caiva tasya lakṣmīrbhaviṣyati .. 3 ..
16.291.d:
चैत्रे मासि तृतीयायां देवीं तां यस्तु पूजयेत् ..
नवकोट्यस्तु चामुण्डा भविष्यंति सुपूजिताः ..
सौभाग्यं विजयं चैव तस्य लक्ष्मीर्भविष्यति .. 3 ..
16.291.m: Whoever worships that goddess on the third day of the bright fortnight in the month of Caitra, / the nine crores of Cāmuṇḍās will be well-worshipped by him; / good fortune, victory, and prosperity will be his.

16.291.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nyaṃkumatīmāhātmye bhadrakālīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikanavatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 291 ..
16.291.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये न्यंकुमतीमाहात्म्ये भद्रकालीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकनवत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 291 ..
16.291.m: Thus ends the two hundred and ninety-first chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Bhadrakālī', in the Nyaṅkumatī-māhātmya, within the Prabhāsakṣetra-māhātmya, the first [sub-section] of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Purāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.292.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasmāduttarabhāge tu sthānātkauravasaṃjñakāt ..
bhadrakālī mahādevi tapaḥ kṛtvā sudustaram .. 1 ..
16.292.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्मादुत्तरभागे तु स्थानात्कौरवसंज्ञकात् ..
भद्रकाली महादेवि तपः कृत्वा सुदुस्तरम् .. 1 ..
16.292.m: Īśvara said: / To the north of that place called Kaurava, / Bhadrakālī, O Great Goddess, having performed very difficult austerity,

16.292.s:
raviṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa bhaktyā paramayā yutā ..
ravivāreṇa saptamyāṃ rakta puṣpānulepanaiḥ .. 2 ..
16.292.d:
रविं संस्थापयामास भक्त्या परमया युता ..
रविवारेण सप्तम्यां रक्त पुष्पानुलेपनैः .. 2 ..
16.292.m: installed the Sun, endowed with supreme devotion. / On a Sunday falling on the seventh day, with red flowers and ointments,

16.292.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet ..
mucyate vātapittotthai rogairanyaiśca puṣkalaiḥ .. 3 ..
16.292.d:
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या कोटियज्ञफलं लभेत् ..
मुच्यते वातपित्तोत्थै रोगैरन्यैश्च पुष्कलैः .. 3 ..
16.292.m: whoever worships him with devotion obtains the fruit of ten million sacrifices, / and is freed from abundant diseases arising from wind and bile, and others.
A horse should be given as a gift right there by those desiring the full fruit of pilgrimage.

16.292.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nyaṃkumatīmāhātmye bhadrakālībālārkamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvinavatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 292 ..
16.292.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये न्यंकुमतीमाहात्म्ये भद्रकालीबालार्कमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विनवत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 292 ..
16.292.m: Thus ends the two hundred and ninety-second chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Bhadrakālī-Bālārka', in the Nyaṅkumatī-māhātmya, within the Prabhāsakṣetra-māhātmya, the first [sub-section] of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Purāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.293.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasmādvaiśravaṇa sthānānnairṛtyāṃ varavarṇini ..
svayaṃ sthitaḥ kuberastu sarvadāridryanāśanaḥ .. 1 ..
16.293.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्माद्वैश्रवण स्थानान्नैरृत्यां वरवर्णिनि ..
स्वयं स्थितः कुबेरस्तु सर्वदारिद्र्यनाशनः .. 1 ..
16.293.m: Īśvara said: / To the southwest of that place of Vaiśravaṇa, O fair-complexioned one, / Kubera himself resides, the destroyer of all poverty.

16.293.s:
makarādinidhānaistu aṣṭābhiḥ paribhūṣitaḥ ..
pañcamyāṃ pūjayedbhaktyā gandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ ..
nidhānaprāptiratulā nirvighnā tasya jāyate .. 2 ..
16.293.d:
मकरादिनिधानैस्तु अष्टाभिः परिभूषितः ..
पञ्चम्यां पूजयेद्भक्त्या गन्धपुष्पानुलेपनैः ..
निधानप्राप्तिरतुला निर्विघ्ना तस्य जायते .. 2 ..
16.293.m: Adorned with the eight treasures beginning with Makara, / one should worship [him] on the fifth day with devotion, with scents, flowers, and unguents. / Incomparable and unhindered acquisition of treasures is obtained by him. (2)

16.293.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāmakṣetramāhātmye nyaṃkumatīmāhātmye kuberasthānotpattau kuberamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trinavatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 293 ..
16.293.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभामक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये न्यंकुमतीमाहात्म्ये कुबेरस्थानोत्पत्तौ कुबेरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिनवत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 293 ..
16.293.m: Thus ends the two hundred and ninety-third chapter, named the Description of the Māhātmya of Kubera in the Origin of the Place of Kubera, in the Māhātmya of Nyaṅkumatī, in the first [part], the Māhātmya of the Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa. (293)

16.294.s:
.. īśvara uvāca ..
tato gacchenmahādevi kauberātpūrvasaṃsthitam ..
gavyūtipaṃcake devi puṣkaraṃnāma nāmataḥ ..
yatra siddho mahādevi kaivarto matsyaghātakaḥ .. 1 ..
16.294.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि कौबेरात्पूर्वसंस्थितम् ..
गव्यूतिपंचके देवि पुष्करंनाम नामतः ..
यत्र सिद्धो महादेवि कैवर्तो मत्स्यघातकः .. 1 ..
16.294.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, east from the [shrine] of Kubera, / at a distance of five gavyūtis, O goddess, to the place named Puṣkara, / where, O great goddess, a fisherman, a killer of fish, attained perfection. (1)

16.294.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
savistaraṃ mama brūhi kathaṃ sa siddhimāpa vai ..
kathayasva prasādena devadeva maheśvara .. 2 ..
16.294.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
सविस्तरं मम ब्रूहि कथं स सिद्धिमाप वै ..
कथयस्व प्रसादेन देवदेव महेश्वर .. 2 ..
16.294.m: The goddess said: / Tell me in full detail how he indeed attained perfection; / tell me, by your favor, O god of gods, Maheśvara! (2)

16.294.s:
.. .. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu tvaṃ yatpurāvṛttaṃ devi svārociṣeṃtare ..
āsītkaściddurācāraḥ kaivarto matsyaghātakaḥ .. 3 ..
16.294.d:
.. .. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु त्वं यत्पुरावृत्तं देवि स्वारोचिषेंतरे ..
आसीत्कश्चिद्दुराचारः कैवर्तो मत्स्यघातकः .. 3 ..
16.294.m: Īśvara said: / Listen to what happened long ago, O goddess, during the Svārociṣa Manvantara: / there was a certain wicked fisherman, a killer of fish. (3)

16.294.s:
sa kadāciccaranpāpaḥ puṣkare tu jagāma vai ..
dadarśa śāṃkaraṃ veśma latāpādapasaṃkulam .. 4 ..
16.294.d:
स कदाचिच्चरन्पापः पुष्करे तु जगाम वै ..
ददर्श शांकरं वेश्म लतापादपसंकुलम् .. 4 ..
16.294.m: Once, roaming about, that sinner indeed went to Puṣkara. / He saw an abode of Śaṅkara covered with vines and trees. (4)

16.294.s:
sa māghamāse śītārttaḥ klinnajālasamanvitaḥ ..
prāsādamārurohārttaḥ sūryatāpajighṛkṣayā .. 5 ..
16.294.d:
स माघमासे शीतार्त्तः क्लिन्नजालसमन्वितः ..
प्रासादमारुरोहार्त्तः सूर्यतापजिघृक्षया .. 5 ..
16.294.m: In the month of Māgha, afflicted by cold, carrying a wet net, / he climbed the temple, distressed, desiring to catch the warmth of the sun. (5)

16.294.s:
tataḥ sa klinnajālaṃ tacchoṣaṇāya raveḥ karaiḥ ..
prāsādadhvajadaṃḍāgre saṃprasāritavāṃstadā .. 6 ..
16.294.d:
ततः स क्लिन्नजालं तच्छोषणाय रवेः करैः ..
प्रासादध्वजदंडाग्रे संप्रसारितवांस्तदा .. 6 ..
16.294.m: Then, to dry that wet net by the rays of the sun, / he spread it out at that time upon the top of the temple's flagpole. (6)

16.294.s:
tataḥ prāsādato devi jāḍyātsaṃpatitaḥ kramāt ..
sa mṛtaḥ sahasā devi tasminkṣetre śivasya ca .. 7 ..
16.294.d:
ततः प्रासादतो देवि जाड्यात्संपतितः क्रमात् ..
स मृतः सहसा देवि तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे शिवस्य च .. 7 ..
16.294.m: Then, O goddess, from numbness he suddenly fell down from the temple. / He died all at once, O goddess, in that sacred field of Śiva. (7)

16.294.s:
jālaṃ tasya prabhūtena jīrṇakālena yattadā ..
dhvajā baddhā yato jālaiḥ prāsāde sā śubhe'bhavat .. 8 ..
16.294.d:
जालं तस्य प्रभूतेन जीर्णकालेन यत्तदा ..
ध्वजा बद्धा यतो जालैः प्रासादे सा शुभेऽभवत् .. 8 ..
16.294.m: Since over a long period of time his net became weathered, / because of the net attached as a banner, it became auspicious on the temple. (8)

16.294.s:
tato'sau dhvajamāhātmyājjāto'vanyāṃ narādhipaḥ ..
ṛtadhvajeti vikhyātaḥ saurāṣṭraviṣaye sudhīḥ ..
sa hi sphūrjaddhvajāgreṇa rathena paryaṭanmahīm .. 9 ..
16.294.d:
ततोऽसौ ध्वजमाहात्म्याज्जातोऽवन्यां नराधिपः ..
ऋतध्वजेति विख्यातः सौराष्ट्रविषये सुधीः ..
स हि स्फूर्जद्ध्वजाग्रेण रथेन पर्यटन्महीम् .. 9 ..
16.294.m: Then, by the majesty of the banner, he was born on earth as a ruler of men, / the wise one known as Ṛtadhvaja in the Saurāṣṭra region; / he indeed roamed the earth in a chariot with a gleaming banner-tip. (9)

16.294.s:
kāmabhogābhibhūtātmā rājyaṃ cakre pratāpavān ..
tato'sau bhavane śaṃbhordadau śobhāsamanvitām ..
dhvajāṃ śubhrāṃ vicitrāṃ ca nānyatkiṃcidapi prabhuḥ .. 7.1.294.10 ..
16.294.d:
कामभोगाभिभूतात्मा राज्यं चक्रे प्रतापवान् ..
ततोऽसौ भवने शंभोर्ददौ शोभासमन्विताम् ..
ध्वजां शुभ्रां विचित्रां च नान्यत्किंचिदपि प्रभुः .. 7.1.294.10 ..
16.294.m: His mind overwhelmed by sensual enjoyments, the valiant [king] ruled the kingdom. / Then he gave to Śambhu's temple a white, multicolored, / beautiful banner, and nothing else at all, that lord. (10)

16.294.s:
tato jātismaro rājā prabhāsakṣetramāgataḥ..
tatrāyatanaṃ dhvajājālasamanvitam..11..
16.294.d:
ततो जातिस्मरो राजा प्रभासक्षेत्रमागतः..
तत्रायतनं ध्वजाजालसमन्वितम्..11..
16.294.m: Then the king, remembering his past birth, came to the Prabhāsakṣetra. / [He saw] the temple there equipped with the netting of the banner. (11)

16.294.s:
ajogandhasya devasya pūrvamārādhitasya ca ..
prāsādaṃ kārayāmāsa śivopakaraṇāni ca..12..
16.294.d:
अजोगन्धस्य देवस्य पूर्वमाराधितस्य च ..
प्रासादं कारयामास शिवोपकरणानि च..12..
16.294.m: He caused to be made a temple and implements for Śiva / for the god Ajogandha, who had been worshipped previously. (12)

16.294.s:
nityaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā talliṃgaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi rājyaṃ cakre mahāmanāḥ .. 13 ..
16.294.d:
नित्यं पूजयते भक्त्या तल्लिंगं पापनाशनम् ..
दशवर्षसहस्राणि राज्यं चक्रे महामनाः .. 13 ..
16.294.m: He constantly worshipped that sin-destroying liṅga with devotion; / the noble-minded one ruled the kingdom for ten thousand years. (13)

16.294.s:
talliṃgasya prabhāvena tataḥ kālāddivaṃ gataḥ ..
tasmāttatra prayatnena gatvā liṃgaṃ prapūjayet .. 14 ..
16.294.d:
तल्लिंगस्य प्रभावेन ततः कालाद्दिवं गतः ..
तस्मात्तत्र प्रयत्नेन गत्वा लिंगं प्रपूजयेत् .. 14 ..
16.294.m: Through the power of that liṅga he went to heaven when the time came. / Therefore, having gone there with diligent effort, one should worship the liṅga. (14)

16.294.s:
snātvā paścimataḥ kuṇḍe puṣkare pāpataskare ..
yatra brahmā'yajatpūrvaṃ yajñairvipuladakṣiṇaiḥ .. 15 ..
16.294.d:
स्नात्वा पश्चिमतः कुण्डे पुष्करे पापतस्करे ..
यत्र ब्रह्माऽयजत्पूर्वं यज्ञैर्विपुलदक्षिणैः .. 15 ..
16.294.m: Having bathed to the west in the Puṣkara pool that steals away sins, / where Brahmā previously worshipped with sacrifices accompanied by generous gifts— (15)

16.294.s:
samāhūya ca tīrthāni puṣkarāttatra bhāmini ..
tasminkuṇḍe tu vinyasya ajogandha samīpataḥ ..
