pratiṣṭhāpya mahāliṃgamajogandheti nāmataḥ .. 16 ..
16.294.d:
समाहूय च तीर्थानि पुष्करात्तत्र भामिनि ..
तस्मिन्कुण्डे तु विन्यस्य अजोगन्ध समीपतः ..
प्रतिष्ठाप्य महालिंगमजोगन्धेति नामतः .. 16 ..
16.294.m: having summoned the sacred fords from Puṣkara, O lovely lady, / having deposited [them] in that pool near Ajogandha, / and having installed the great liṅga named Ajogandha; (16)

16.294.s:
tripuṣkare mahādevi kuṇḍe pātakanāśane ..
sauvarṇaṃ kamalaṃ tatra dadyādbrāhmaṇapuṃgave .. 17 ..
16.294.d:
त्रिपुष्करे महादेवि कुण्डे पातकनाशने ..
सौवर्णं कमलं तत्र दद्याद्ब्राह्मणपुंगवे .. 17 ..
16.294.m: in that pool called Tripuṣkara, O great goddess, which destroys sins, / one should give a golden lotus there to an eminent brahmin. (17)

16.294.s:
devaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadgandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ..
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ saptajanmārjitairapi .. 18 ..
16.294.d:
देवं संपूज्य विधिवद्गन्धपुष्पाक्षतादिभिः ..
मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैः सप्तजन्मार्जितैरपि .. 18 ..
16.294.m: Having worshipped the god according to rule with scents, flowers, unbroken grains, and the like, / one is freed from all sins, even those acquired over seven births. (18)

16.294.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye puṣkara māhātmye'jogandheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturṇavatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 294 ..
16.294.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पुष्कर माहात्म्येऽजोगन्धेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुर्णवत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 294 ..
16.294.m: Thus ends the two hundred and ninety-fourth chapter, named the Description of the Māhātmya of Ajogandheśvara in the Māhātmya of Puṣkara, in the first [part], the Māhātmya of the Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa. (294)

16.295.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasmādīśāna digbhāge indrasthānamanuttamam ..
gavyūtipañcamātreṇa yatra candrasaraḥ priye .. 1 ..
16.295.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्मादीशान दिग्भागे इन्द्रस्थानमनुत्तमम् ..
गव्यूतिपञ्चमात्रेण यत्र चन्द्रसरः प्रिये .. 1 ..
16.295.m: Īśvara said: / To the northeast of that is the supreme abode of Indra, / at a distance of five gavyūtis, where the Moon's Lake is situated, O dear one. (1)

16.295.s:
tasmāduttaradigbhāge nātidūre vyavasthitam ..
yatra candrodakaṃ devi jarādāridryanāśanam .. 2..
16.295.d:
तस्मादुत्तरदिग्भागे नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितम् ..
यत्र चन्द्रोदकं देवि जरादारिद्र्यनाशनम् .. 2..
16.295.m: To the north of that, situated not very far away, / is where Candrodaka is, O goddess, which destroys old age and poverty. (2)

16.295.s:
candrānuvṛddhyā tadvṛddhiḥ kṣayastatsaṃkṣaye bhavet..
tasminpāpayuge'pyevaṃ kadācitsaṃpradṛśyate..3..
16.295.d:
चन्द्रानुवृद्ध्या तद्वृद्धिः क्षयस्तत्संक्षये भवेत्..
तस्मिन्पापयुगेऽप्येवं कदाचित्संप्रदृश्यते..3..
16.295.m: Its increase occurs with the waxing of the moon, and its waning with the waning [of the moon]; / even in this sinful age [the Kaliyuga], it is seen thus at times. (3)

16.295.s:
tatra snātvā mahādevi yadi pāpasahasrakam..
kṛtaṃ so'tra samāyāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā..4..
16.295.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा महादेवि यदि पापसहस्रकम्..
कृतं सोऽत्र समायाति नात्र कार्या विचारणा..4..
16.295.m: Having bathed there, O great goddess, even if a thousand sins / have been committed, he attains this [purification] here; there should be no doubt about this. (4)
There, afraid of the great sin arising from his intercourse with Ahalyā, / his mind humiliated by the curse originating from Gautama, (5)

16.295.s:
indreṇa ca purā devi iṣṭaṃ vipuladakṣiṇaiḥ ..
tatra varṣasahasrāṇi saṃsthāpya śivamīśvaram ..
indreśvareti nāmnā vai sarvapātaka nāśanam .. 6 ..
16.295.d:
इन्द्रेण च पुरा देवि इष्टं विपुलदक्षिणैः ..
तत्र वर्षसहस्राणि संस्थाप्य शिवमीश्वरम् ..
इन्द्रेश्वरेति नाम्ना वै सर्वपातक नाशनम् .. 6 ..
16.295.m: sacrifices with generous gifts were performed long ago by Indra, O goddess, / having established Śiva, Īśvara, there for a thousand years / under the name Indreśvara, the destroyer of all sins. (6)

16.295.s:
candratīrthe naraḥ snātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ..
indreśvaraṃ ca saṃpūjya mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 7 ..
16.295.d:
चन्द्रतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः ..
इन्द्रेश्वरं च संपूज्य मुच्यते नात्र संशयः .. 7 ..
16.295.m: A person having bathed in Candratīrtha, having satisfied the ancestors and deities, / and having worshipped Indreśvara, is liberated; there is no doubt about this. (7)

16.295.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye candrodakatīrthamāhātmya indreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcanavatyuttara dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 295 ..
16.295.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये चन्द्रोदकतीर्थमाहात्म्य इन्द्रेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चनवत्युत्तर द्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 295 ..
16.295.m: Thus ends the two hundred and ninety-fifth chapter, named the Description of the Māhātmya of Indreśvara in the Māhātmya of Candrodakatīrtha, in the first [part], the Māhātmya of the Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa. (295)

16.296.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasmādāgneyadigbhāge gavyūtisaptakena ca ..
sthānaṃ devakulaṃnāma devānāṃ yatra saṃgamaḥ .. 1 ..
16.296.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्मादाग्नेयदिग्भागे गव्यूतिसप्तकेन च ..
स्थानं देवकुलंनाम देवानां यत्र संगमः .. 1 ..
16.296.m: Īśvara said: / To the southeast of that, at a distance of seven gavyūtis, / is the place named Devakula, where the gathering of the gods takes place. (1)

16.296.s:
ṛṣīṇāṃ yatra siddhānāṃ purā liṃge nipātite ..
yasmājjāto mahādevi tasmāddevakulaṃ smṛtam .. 2 ..
16.296.d:
ऋषीणां यत्र सिद्धानां पुरा लिंगे निपातिते ..
यस्माज्जातो महादेवि तस्माद्देवकुलं स्मृतम् .. 2 ..
16.296.m: Where long ago, when the liṅga was cast down by the perfected seers, / from which [it] arose, O great goddess, it is therefore called Devakula. (2)

16.296.s:
tasya paścimadigbhāga ṛṣitoyā mahānadī ..
ṛṣīṇāṃ vallabhā devi sarvapātakanāśinī .. 3 ..
16.296.d:
तस्य पश्चिमदिग्भाग ऋषितोया महानदी ..
ऋषीणां वल्लभा देवि सर्वपातकनाशिनी .. 3 ..
16.296.m: To the west of it is the great river Ṛṣitoyā, / dear to the seers, O goddess, destroying all sins. (3)

16.296.s:
tatra snātvā naraḥ samyakpitṝṇāṃ nirvapennaraḥ ..
saptavarṣāyutānyeva pitṝṇāṃ tṛptimāvahet .. 4 ..
16.296.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरः सम्यक्पितॄणां निर्वपेन्नरः ..
सप्तवर्षायुतान्येव पितॄणां तृप्तिमावहेत् .. 4 ..
16.296.m: A man having bathed there properly, a man should offer libations to the ancestors; / it indeed brings satisfaction to the ancestors for seventy thousand years. (4)

16.296.s:
suvarṇaṃ tatra deyaṃ tu ajinaṃ kaṃbalaṃ tathā ..
āṣāḍhe tvamāvāsyāyāṃ yatkiñciddīyate dhruvam .. 5 ..
16.296.d:
सुवर्णं तत्र देयं तु अजिनं कंबलं तथा ..
आषाढे त्वमावास्यायां यत्किञ्चिद्दीयते ध्रुवम् .. 5 ..
16.296.m: Gold should be given there, as well as an antelope skin and a blanket; / whatever is given on the new moon of Āṣāḍha is surely [meritorious]. (5)
It increases sixteenfold by the time the full moon arrives. (6)

16.296.s:
suvarṇaṃ tatra deyaṃ tu ajinaṃ kaṃbalaṃ tathā ..
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ saptajanmakṛtairapi .. 7 ..
16.296.d:
सुवर्णं तत्र देयं तु अजिनं कंबलं तथा ..
मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैः सप्तजन्मकृतैरपि .. 7 ..
16.296.m: Gold should be given there, as well as an antelope skin and a blanket; / one is freed from all sins, even those committed in seven lifetimes. (7)

16.296.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ṛṣitoyānadīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṇṇavatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..296.. ..
16.296.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य ऋषितोयानदीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षण्णवत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..296.. ..
16.296.m: Thus ends the two hundred and ninety-sixth chapter, named the Description of the Māhātmya of the River Ṛṣitoyā, in the first [part], the Māhātmya of the Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa. (296)

16.297.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
devadeva jagannātha saṃsārārṇavatāraka ..
savistaraṃ tu me brūhi ṛṣitoyāmahodayam .. 1 ..
16.297.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
देवदेव जगन्नाथ संसारार्णवतारक ..
सविस्तरं तु मे ब्रूहि ऋषितोयामहोदयम् .. 1 ..
16.297.m: The goddess said: / O god of gods, lord of the world, savior from the ocean of worldly existence, / tell me in full detail of the great glory of the Ṛṣitoyā! (1)

16.297.s:
ṛṣitoyeti tannāma kathaṃ khyātaṃ dharātale ..
kathaṃ sā punarāyātā devadāruvane śubhe .. 2 ..
16.297.d:
ऋषितोयेति तन्नाम कथं ख्यातं धरातले ..
कथं सा पुनरायाता देवदारुवने शुभे .. 2 ..
16.297.m: How did that name, Ṛṣitoyā, become famous upon the earth? / How did she come again to the auspicious Devadāruvana?

16.297.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi sāvadhānā vaco mama ..
māhātmyamṛṣitoyāyāḥ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 3 ..
16.297.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि सावधाना वचो मम ..
माहात्म्यमृषितोयायाः सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 3 ..
16.297.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O goddess, attentive to my words; I shall declare / the māhātmya of the Ṛṣitoyā, which destroys all sins.

16.297.s:
devadāruvane puṇya ṛṣayastapasā yutāḥ ..
nivasaṃti varārohe śataśotha sahasraśaḥ .. 4 ..
16.297.d:
देवदारुवने पुण्य ऋषयस्तपसा युताः ..
निवसंति वरारोहे शतशोथ सहस्रशः .. 4 ..
16.297.m: In the sacred Devadāruvana, seers endowed with austerity / dwell by hundreds and thousands, O fair-hipped lady.

16.297.s:
teṣāṃ nivasatāṃ tatra bahukālo gataḥ priye ..
putrapautraiḥ pravṛddhāste dārukaṃ vyāpya saṃsthitāḥ .. 85 ..
te sarve ciṃtayāmāsuḥ sametya ca parasparam ..
sarasvatī mahāpuṇyā śirasyādhāya vāḍavam .. 6 ..
prabhāsaṃ cirakālena kṣetraṃ caiva gamiṣyati ..
vāpīkūpataḍāgādi muktvā sāgaragāminīm .. 7 ..
nāhlādaṃ kurute cetaḥ snānadānajapeṣu ca ..
brahmāṇaṃ prārthayiṣyāmo gatvā brahmaniketanam .. 8 ..
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evaṃ nimantrya te sarve ṛṣayastapasojjvalāḥ..
gatāste brahmalokaṃ tu draṣṭuṃ devaṃ pitāmaham ..
tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotrairbrahmāṇaṃ kamalodbhavam .. 9 ..
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
namaḥ praṇavarūpāya viśva kartre namonamaḥ ..
tathā viśvasya rakṣitre namo'stu paramātmane .. 7.1.297.10 ..
16.297.d:
तेषां निवसतां तत्र बहुकालो गतः प्रिये ..
पुत्रपौत्रैः प्रवृद्धास्ते दारुकं व्याप्य संस्थिताः .. 85 ..
ते सर्वे चिंतयामासुः समेत्य च परस्परम् ..
सरस्वती महापुण्या शिरस्याधाय वाडवम् .. 6 ..
प्रभासं चिरकालेन क्षेत्रं चैव गमिष्यति ..
वापीकूपतडागादि मुक्त्वा सागरगामिनीम् .. 7 ..
नाह्लादं कुरुते चेतः स्नानदानजपेषु च ..
ब्रह्माणं प्रार्थयिष्यामो गत्वा ब्रह्मनिकेतनम् .. 8 ..
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवं निमन्त्र्य ते सर्वे ऋषयस्तपसोज्ज्वलाः..
गतास्ते ब्रह्मलोकं तु द्रष्टुं देवं पितामहम् ..
तुष्टुवुर्विविधैः स्तोत्रैर्ब्रह्माणं कमलोद्भवम् .. 9 ..
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
नमः प्रणवरूपाय विश्व कर्त्रे नमोनमः ..
तथा विश्वस्य रक्षित्रे नमोऽस्तु परमात्मने .. 7.1.297.10 ..
16.297.m:
As they dwelled there, a long time passed, my beloved. / Having multiplied with sons and grandsons, they remained, occupying the deodar forest.
Gathering together, they all thought among themselves: / 'The greatly holy Sarasvatī, having taken the submarine fire upon her head,
will only go to the sacred field of Prabhāsa after a long time. / Apart from a river going to the ocean, stepwells, wells, ponds, and the like
do not bring delight to the mind in ritual ablutions, gifts, and recitations. / Having gone to the abode of Brahmā, we shall make a request to Brahmā.'
Īśvara said: / Having thus conferred, all those seers radiant with austerity / went to the world of Brahmā to see the god, the Grandfather. / They praised the lotus-born Brahmā with various hymns of praise.
The seers said: / 'Homage to the one whose form is the praṇava, homage, homage to the creator of the universe! / Likewise, to the protector of the universe, homage be to the Supreme Self!

16.297.s:
tathā tasyaiva saṃhartre namo brahmasvarūpiṇe ..
pitāmaha namastubhyaṃ surajyeṣṭha namo'stu te .. 11 ..
caturvaktra namastubhyaṃ padmayone namo'stu te ..
viraṃcaye namastubhyaṃ vidhaye vedhase namaḥ .. 12 ..
cidānanda namastubhyaṃ hiraṇyagarbha te namaḥ ..
haṃsavāhana te nityaṃ padmāsana namo'stute .. 13 ..
evaṃ saṃstuvatāṃ teṣāmṛṣīṇāmūrdhvaretasām ..
uvāca paramaprīto brahmā loka pitāmahaḥ .. 14 ..
svāgataṃ vai dvijaśreṣṭhā yuṣmākaṃ kṛtavānaham ..
stotreṇānena divyena vṛṇudhvaṃ varamuttamam .. 15 ..
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
abhiṣekāya no deva nadī pāpapraṇāśinī ..
vilokyate suraśreṣṭha dehi no varamuttamam .. 16 ..
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ityuktastaistadā brahmā munibhistapasojjvalaiḥ ..
vīkṣāṃcakre tadā sarvā mūrtimatyaśca nimnagāḥ .. 17 ..
16.297.d:
तथा तस्यैव संहर्त्रे नमो ब्रह्मस्वरूपिणे ..
पितामह नमस्तुभ्यं सुरज्येष्ठ नमोऽस्तु ते .. 11 ..
चतुर्वक्त्र नमस्तुभ्यं पद्मयोने नमोऽस्तु ते ..
विरंचये नमस्तुभ्यं विधये वेधसे नमः .. 12 ..
चिदानन्द नमस्तुभ्यं हिरण्यगर्भ ते नमः ..
हंसवाहन ते नित्यं पद्मासन नमोऽस्तुते .. 13 ..
एवं संस्तुवतां तेषामृषीणामूर्ध्वरेतसाम् ..
उवाच परमप्रीतो ब्रह्मा लोक पितामहः .. 14 ..
स्वागतं वै द्विजश्रेष्ठा युष्माकं कृतवानहम् ..
स्तोत्रेणानेन दिव्येन वृणुध्वं वरमुत्तमम् .. 15 ..
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
अभिषेकाय नो देव नदी पापप्रणाशिनी ..
विलोक्यते सुरश्रेष्ठ देहि नो वरमुत्तमम् .. 16 ..
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्तस्तैस्तदा ब्रह्मा मुनिभिस्तपसोज्ज्वलैः ..
वीक्षांचक्रे तदा सर्वा मूर्तिमत्यश्च निम्नगाः .. 17 ..
16.297.m:
Likewise, homage to the destroyer of that very [universe], whose nature is Brahman! / O Grandfather, homage to you; O eldest among the gods, homage be to you!
O four-faced one, homage to you; O lotus-born one, homage be to you! / Homage to Virañci, to the Ordainer, homage to the Dispenser!
O consciousness-bliss, homage to you; O Hiraṇyagarbha, homage to you! / O one whose vehicle is a swan, constantly homage be to you, O lotus-seated one!'
As those seers of vital breath drawn upward were thus praising him, / Brahmā, the Grandfather of the world, exceedingly pleased, said:
'Welcome indeed, O best of brahmins! I have received you. / Through this divine hymn of praise, choose an excellent boon.'
The seers said: / 'For our ablution, O god, a river that destroys sin / is sought, O best among the gods; grant us an excellent boon.'
Īśvara said: / Thus addressed at that time by those sages radiant with austerity, / Brahmā then looked at all the rivers embodied in form:

16.297.s:
gaṅgā ca yamunā caiva tathā devī sarasvatī ..
candrabhāgā ca revā ca śarayūrgaṃḍakī tathā .. 18 ..
tāpī caiva varārohe tathā godāvarī nadī ..
kāverī candraputrī ca śiprā carmaṇvatī tathā .. 19 ..
sindhuśca vedikā caiva nadāḥ sarve varānane ..
mūrtimatyaḥ sthitāḥ sarvāḥ pavitrāḥ pāpanāśinī .. 7.1.297.20 ..
dṛṣṭvā pitāmahaḥ sarvā gatvarā dharaṇīṃ prati ..
devadāruvane ramye prabhāse kṣetra uttame ..
kamaṇḍalau kṛtā dṛṣṭirviviśustāḥ kamaṇḍalum .. 21 .. .
. brahmovāca .. ..
dhṛtāḥ sarvā mahāpuṇyā nadyo brahmakamaṇḍalau..
praviṣṭāḥ pṛthivīṃ yāṃtu ṛṣīṇāmanukampayā .. 22 ..
prahiṇomi yadyekāṃ ca hyanyā ruṣyati me dvijāḥ ..
tasmātsarvāḥ pramokṣyāmi kamaṇḍalukṛtālayāḥ .. 23 ..
.. īśvara uvāca ..
tato brahmā mumocā'tha tatrasthāśca mahāpagāḥ ..
muktvā brahmā munīnsarvānprovācedaṃ punaḥpunaḥ .. 24 ..
16.297.d:
गङ्गा च यमुना चैव तथा देवी सरस्वती ..
चन्द्रभागा च रेवा च शरयूर्गंडकी तथा .. 18 ..
तापी चैव वरारोहे तथा गोदावरी नदी ..
कावेरी चन्द्रपुत्री च शिप्रा चर्मण्वती तथा .. 19 ..
सिन्धुश्च वेदिका चैव नदाः सर्वे वरानने ..
मूर्तिमत्यः स्थिताः सर्वाः पवित्राः पापनाशिनी .. 7.1.297.20 ..
दृष्ट्वा पितामहः सर्वा गत्वरा धरणीं प्रति ..
देवदारुवने रम्ये प्रभासे क्षेत्र उत्तमे ..
कमण्डलौ कृता दृष्टिर्विविशुस्ताः कमण्डलुम् .. 21 .. .
. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
धृताः सर्वा महापुण्या नद्यो ब्रह्मकमण्डलौ..
प्रविष्टाः पृथिवीं यांतु ऋषीणामनुकम्पया .. 22 ..
प्रहिणोमि यद्येकां च ह्यन्या रुष्यति मे द्विजाः ..
तस्मात्सर्वाः प्रमोक्ष्यामि कमण्डलुकृतालयाः .. 23 ..
.. ईश्वर उवाच ..
ततो ब्रह्मा मुमोचाऽथ तत्रस्थाश्च महापगाः ..
मुक्त्वा ब्रह्मा मुनीन्सर्वान्प्रोवाचेदं पुनःपुनः .. 24 ..
16.297.m:
the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā, and also the goddess Sarasvatī, / the Candrabhāgā and the Revā, the Śarayū and the Gaṇḍakī,
the Tāpī, O fair-hipped lady, and also the river Godāvarī, / the Kāverī, the daughter of the Moon, the Śiprā, and the Carmaṇvatī,
the Sindhu, the Vedikā, and all the streams, O fair-faced lady. / They all stood personified, pure, destroying sin.
Seeing all of them about to go toward the earth, / to the charming Devadāruvana in the excellent sacred field of Prabhāsa, / the Grandfather cast his gaze upon his water-pot, and they entered the water-pot.
Brahmā said: / 'All the greatly holy rivers have been held in the water-pot of Brahmā. / Having entered, let them go to the earth out of compassion for the seers.
If I send only one, the others will be angry with me, O brahmins. / Therefore, I shall release all of them, which have made the water-pot their abode.'
Īśvara said: / Then Brahmā released the great rivers stationed there. / Having released them, Brahmā addressed all the sages again and again:

16.297.s:
ṛṣibhiḥ prārthyamānena nadyo muktā mayā yataḥ ..
toyarūpā mahāvegā abhiṣekāya satvarāḥ .. 25 ..
ṛṣitoyeti nāmnā sā bhaviṣyati dharātale ..
ṛṣīṇāṃ vallabhā devī sarvapātakanāśinī .. 26 ..
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evaṃ devi samāyātā devadāruvane nadī ..
ṛṣitoyeti vikhyātā pavitrā ca varānane .. 27 ..
tūryaduṃdubhinirghoṣairvedamaṅgalaniḥsvanaiḥ ..
samudraṃ prāpitā devī ṛṣibhirvedapāragaiḥ .. 28 ..
sarvatra sulabhā devī triṣu sthāneṣu durlabhā ..
mahodaye mahātīrthe mūlacaṃḍīśasannidhau .. 29 ..
samudreṇa sametā tu yatra sā pūrvavāhinī ..
yatrarṣitoyā labhyeta tatra kiṃ mṛgyate param ..7.1.297.30..
manuṣyāste sadā dhanyāstattoyaṃ tu pibaṃti ye ..
asthīni yatra līyaṃte ṣaṇmāsābhyantareṇa tu .. 31 ..
prātaḥkāle vahedgaṃgā sāyaṃ ca yamunā tathā .. 32 ..
16.297.d:
ऋषिभिः प्रार्थ्यमानेन नद्यो मुक्ता मया यतः ..
तोयरूपा महावेगा अभिषेकाय सत्वराः .. 25 ..
ऋषितोयेति नाम्ना सा भविष्यति धरातले ..
ऋषीणां वल्लभा देवी सर्वपातकनाशिनी .. 26 ..

एवं देवि समायाता देवदारुवने नदी ..

16.297.m:
'Because the rivers, embodied as water with great swiftness, / were released by me at the entreaty of the seers for ablution with all haste,
she shall be [known] on the earth by the name Ṛṣitoyā, / the goddess beloved of seers, the destroyer of all sins.'
Īśvara said: / In this way, O goddess, the river came to the Devadāruvana, / renowned as Ṛṣitoyā and holy, O fair-faced lady.
With the sounds of trumpets and kettledrums, and with the auspicious chants of the Vedas, / the goddess was conducted to the ocean by the seers who had mastered the Vedas.
The goddess is easily accessible everywhere, but difficult to attain in three places: / at Mahodaya, in the great sacred ford, in the presence of Mūlacaṇḍīśa,
and where she flows east, uniting with the ocean. / Where the Ṛṣitoyā is reached, what else is sought there?
Those men are always blessed who drink her water, / [and in the place] where bones dissolve within six months.
In the morning the Gaṅgā flows [in her], and in the evening likewise the Yamunā.

16.297.m:
At midday, [she is] the Sarasvatī joined with a thousand rivers; / in the afternoon the Revā flows, and at twilight the daughter of the Sun.
Knowing thus, whatever wise person performs ritual ablution there / and conducts a śrāddha according to the rule, he shall partake of her fruit.
Thus the greatness of Ṛṣitoyā has been declared in brief, / removing all sins of men and granting the fruit of all desires.

16.297.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ṛṣitoyāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptanavatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 297 ..
16.297.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य ऋषितोयामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तनवत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 297 ..
16.297.m: Thus ends the two hundred and ninety-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Ṛṣitoyā,' in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
